title: Doktersassistent dermatologie
description:
Ben jij doktersassistente en toe aan een nieuwe veelzijdige rol?

Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar het werk op de polikliniek Dermatologie? Houd je van afwisseling, neem je graag initiatief en voel je je thuis in een dynamische werkomgeving? Dan is deze veelzijdige functie als doktersassistent misschien iets voor jou.

Op de polikliniek Dermatologie is geen dag hetzelfde. Beschouwende en snijdende werkzaamheden wisselen elkaar af en ook de invulling van de ochtend kan heel anders zijn dan die van de middag. Juist die afwisseling maakt het werk uitdagend en zorgt ervoor dat je continu blijft leren.

Na een goede inwerkperiode krijg je de ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen een specifiek aandachtsgebied. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld zelfstandig patiënten met chronisch eczeem of psoriasis behandelen met lichttherapie. Ook kun je patiënten met huidkanker begeleiden en behandelen met photodynamische therapie (PDT). Daarmee geef je jouw functie extra verdieping en blijf je jezelf professioneel ontwikkelen.

Je komt terecht in een betrokken team van ongeveer twintig collega’s. Het team is continu in beweging en naast de reguliere werkzaamheden lopen er verschillende projecten en verbeterinitiatieven. We zoeken daarom iemand die het leuk vindt om hierin actief mee te denken, kansen te signaleren en projecten samen met collega’s aan te jagen.

Binnen het team helpen we elkaar, denken we met elkaar mee en werken we met enthousiasme en passie samen. Een prettige werksfeer vinden we daarbij minstens zo belangrijk als goede patiëntenzorg.

Wie zoeken wij?
Wij zoeken een proactieve collega die veel waarde hecht aan kwalitatief goede patiëntenzorg en een soepel verloop van de spreekuren. Je ziet wat er nodig is, pakt werkzaamheden zelfstandig op en wacht niet af. Met jouw gastvrije en professionele houding zorg je ervoor dat patiënten zich direct welkom en op hun gemak voelen.

Daarnaast vind je het leuk om mee te bewegen met ontwikkelingen binnen de polikliniek. Je denkt graag mee over hoe het werk slimmer of beter kan en neemt initiatief om ideeën samen met het team verder te brengen.

Wij vragen

  • Je hebt een afgeronde, of bijna afgeronde opleiding tot doktersassistent of verpleegkundige op MBO4-niveau;
  • Je bent bereid tot het volgen van een aanvullende opleiding voor de doktersassistent op de dermatologie;
  • Je houdt er rekening mee dat het werk soms fysiek belastend kan zijn en vindt dit geen bezwaar.

De procedure

Solliciteren naar de vacature van doktersassistent dermatologie? Upload jouw cv en motivatiebrief via de solliciteer button t.a.v. Tess Brakkee, recruiter.

Wil je meer weten over de functie? Jasper van 't Hof, afdelingsmanager Poli Dermatologie (015 260 4750) helpt je graag.

Vragen over de procedure? Bel of stuur een WhatsApp bericht naar Tess via 06 - 82 18 61 16.

Solliciteren kan tot en met 30 augustus 2026. De sollicitatiegesprekken staan gepland op maandag 7 september.

title: Mobile Hydraulic Service Technician
description:
Benefits:
  • Bonus based on performance
  • Company car
  • Competitive salary
  • Free uniforms
  • Opportunity for advancement
  • Paid time off
  • Training & development

This Isn't Your Average Wrench-Turning Job


Imagine this: you roll up to a construction site, a farm, or a manufacturing floor in your own fully-equipped mobile workshop. A machine is down. Everyone's waiting. You open the van, assess the problem, fabricate the part, and fix it — on the spot. The crew is back to work. You're the hero. Then you drive to the next call.

That's life as a Mobile Service & Sales Technician (MSST) with PIRTEK — and it's genuinely as cool as it sounds.

This role is part technician, part problem-solver, part trusted advisor. You're not stuck at a desk or anchored to a shop floor. You own your territory, build real relationships with real customers, and get paid to be the person who shows up when things go sideways. If you love working with your hands, crave variety, and want a career that actually builds into something — keep reading.


About PIRTEK — The Company You'd Actually Want to Work For


PIRTEK is the nation's leading provider of on-site hydraulic and industrial hose assembly and replacement. We operate 24/7/365 with a 1-hour emergency ETA promise — because when a machine goes down, every minute of downtime costs our customers real money.

Our mission is simple: keep the world moving. Construction equipment, agriculture, manufacturing, marine, mining — if it runs on hydraulics, PIRTEK keeps it running. We do this through a network of service centers and a fleet of purpose-built mobile units staffed by technicians who are trained, equipped, and empowered to solve problems fast.

Our core values aren't just wall art — they're how we actually operate:

  • People — We build a culture of mutual trust and respect. You matter here.
  • Integrity — We do what we say. Fair, honest, always.
  • Real — No corporate fluff — we're transparent with everyone we work with.
  • Teamwork — You'll have backup. Always.
  • Excellence — We raise the bar, constantly.
  • Kaizen — We're always improving — and we want people who love to grow.

So... What Exactly Is an MSST?


MSST stands for Mobile Service & Sales Technician. It's a title unique to PIRTEK — and it covers a lot of ground (literally).

You'll be dispatched from our Stockton, CA service center in a purpose-built mobile workshop — think a fully loaded van with fabrication tools, a hose inventory, and everything you need to handle service calls in the field. Your customers range from construction sites and industrial facilities to farms and fleets. When their hydraulic or industrial hose fails, you're who they call.

But you're not just fixing things — you're also building relationships and growing a book of business. That's the sales side. You're an ambassador for PIRTEK in your territory, and the trust you build with customers directly shapes your success.


What You'll Actually Be Doing


Every day is different. Here's the core of what this role looks like:

  • Respond to service calls and sales visits across your assigned Stockton-area territory
  • Diagnose failed or worn hydraulic and industrial hoses on-site
  • Fabricate and install replacement hose assemblies using your mobile workshop
  • Manage fluid spills and environmental containment per safety standards
  • Log service details and generate accurate invoices through our online system
  • Build and maintain relationships with new and existing customers — you're their go-to
  • Conduct proactive follow-up visits to ensure customer satisfaction and encourage Google reviews
  • Keep your mobile unit, tools, and inventory organized and ready
  • Participate in the rotating on-call schedule (with extra incentive pay — it's worth it)
  • Follow all PIRTEK and industry safety protocols — non-negotiable

What You Bring to the Table


You don't need hydraulic experience on day one — we'll train you. What we can't train is drive, character, and a genuine love for hands-on work. Here's what makes someone great at this role:

  • Natural problem-solver — you see a broken thing and your brain immediately starts working on a fix
  • Mechanically inclined and comfortable with hand tools and specialized equipment
  • Self-motivated with a positive attitude, especially when the job gets messy (and it will)
  • Strong communicator — clear, honest, and professional with customers and teammates
  • Able to lift up to 50 pounds and work in diverse environments (indoors, outdoors, industrial sites)
  • Comfortable sitting, standing, kneeling, bending, and stooping for extended periods
  • Can safely operate a large work van in varying road and site conditions

The Basics (Required)


  • High school diploma or GED
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
  • Ability to pass a background check
  • Based in or willing to commute to Stockton, CA
Bonus points (but not required):

  • Experience in industrial, construction, agricultural, marine, or automotive mechanics
  • Familiarity with hydraulic systems, fluid power, or hose fabrication
  • Previous customer-facing or sales experience

Your Home Base: Stockton, CA


This role is based out of our Stockton, California service center. Stockton sits at the heart of the Central Valley — one of the most industrially and agriculturally active regions in the state. That means constant demand for exactly what you'll be doing.

You'll serve a defined territory in and around the greater Stockton area, which means you're home every night. No long-haul travel, no living out of a hotel. You'll get to know your customers and your territory well — and that familiarity is one of the biggest advantages you'll have.


Ready to Build Something Real?


Here's the truth: this job isn't glamorous every day. It's physically demanding, sometimes messy, and you'll face problems that don't have clean solutions. But it's also deeply satisfying — the kind of work where you end the day knowing exactly what you accomplished.

We're building something in Stockton. The PIRTEK name is growing, the demand is real, and the right person in this role has every opportunity to grow with it — financially, professionally, and in their craft.

If you're the kind of person who gets genuinely excited about solving hard problems, who takes pride in doing good work, and who wants to be part of something that matters — we'd love to meet you.

Let's go. Apply today.

title: Product Director (Hybrid Casual)
description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

This role is based within our studio, Belka Games

Belka Games is a game development company ranked by Sensor Tower among the top 30 highest-grossing game developers in Europe. Our games have reached more than 110 million players worldwide

Role Overview

We are looking for a Product Director to lead and strengthen our Hybrid Casual direction, combining ownership and development of existing live products with the creation, validation, and launch of new product initiatives

As part of the Belka Games leadership team, you will contribute to the company’s broader product strategy and long-term development

The role includes responsibility for product strategy, business performance of the Hybrid Casual portfolio, including its revenue, profitability, long-term value, and investment efficiency. You will also build strong product teams and establish a systematic and repeatable approach to creating and scaling successful Hybrid Casual products.

Key Responsibilities

Part 1 - Live product ownership

  • Define and implement the product strategy for the Hybrid Casual portfolio, ensuring sustainable growth and long-term product health
  • Drive the business performance of the direction, including revenue growth, profitability, long-term portfolio value, and investment efficiency
  • Drive improvements in retention, engagement, monetization, product quality, and other key product and business metrics
  • Balance short-term performance priorities with long-term product investments and allocate resources across the portfolio accordingly
  • Define product and LiveOps priorities based on data, business impact, investment efficiency, and growth potential
  • Make decisions on the launch, scaling, transformation, or termination of product initiatives
  • Ensure reliable execution of product updates and scale successful features, mechanics, and practices across live products
  • Build transparent cross-functional decision-making processes and align Product, Development, Analytics, Marketing, and other business functions around shared goals and priorities
  • Partner with the Belka Games leadership team on the company’s product strategy and long-term development
  • Hire and develop senior product leaders, build autonomous and scalable teams

Part 2 - RnD

  • Define and implement the R&D strategy for the Hybrid Casual direction
  • Identify new product opportunities, segments, and mechanics, and manage a pipeline of hypotheses, experiments, prototypes, and product initiatives
  • Apply a data-informed and hypothesis-driven approach to identifying, prioritizing, and validating new product opportunities
  • Own the development of new product concepts from ideation and prototyping through validation, soft launch, global launch, and scaling
  • Define success criteria and evaluate initiatives against relevant product, market, and business benchmarks
  • Develop business cases for new product investments, including the opportunity, expected business impact, required resources, and key risks
  • Make investment decisions on the further development, scaling, transformation, or termination of product initiatives
  • Establish clear validation stages, decision criteria, and investment gates to improve the predictability and efficiency of R&D outcomes
  • Systematize learnings from experiments and launches, scale effective practices across initiatives, and eliminate consistently ineffective approaches

Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Senior product leadership experience in the games industry as a Product Director, Head of Product, Executive Producer, or in a comparable role
  • Strong experience with live mobile F2P games, ideally within Hybrid Casual or adjacent Casual genres
  • Proven experience defining and implementing product strategy
  • Experience managing a portfolio of live products and new product initiatives across the full product lifecycle
  • Experience owning business performance and allocating investment and resources across a product portfolio
  • Deep understanding of F2P monetization, LiveOps, product economies, progression systems, and mobile games market dynamics, with proven experience improving retention, engagement, monetization, revenue, profitability, and long-term product health
  • Strong analytical and business skills, including experience building business cases and making data-informed product and investment decisions
  • Experience building autonomous cross-functional teams and hiring and developing senior Product Managers, Game Producers, or other product leaders
  • Excellent leadership, communication, cross-functional management, and stakeholder alignment skills
  • Ability to make clear decisions in uncertain conditions and take ownership of their business consequences
  • Fluent in English and Russian

What Success Looks Like

  • A strong and scalable Hybrid Casual portfolio with sustainable product and business performance
  • Growth in the key product and business metrics of live products
  • Strong, autonomous product teams led by capable product leaders
  • A predictable and repeatable approach to creating, validating, and scaling new products
  • A continuous pipeline of high-potential R&D initiatives
  • Increased maturity and effectiveness of the product function across the company

Working at Tripledot

  • Hybrid Working
  • 26 days paid holiday in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year
  • 20 days remote working: Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year
  • Regular company events and rewards: Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements and our team spirit
  • Private Medical Cover with Luxmed: Have peace of mind with private medical cover, ensuring your and your family’s health is in good hands
  • Daily Free Lunch: When working in the office order free food from Pyszne.pl
  • Multisport Plus Card: Enjoy access to various sports facilities across Warsaw with the Multisport Plus Card
  • Employee Assistance Program: Anytime you need it, tap into confidential, caring support with our Employee Assistance Program, always here to lend an ear and a helping hand
  • Family Forming Support: Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program [subject to policy]
  • Continuous Professional Development: Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development
  • English & Polish Classes: Improve your language skills with access to English and Polish classes

title: Quality Control Laboratory Supervisor
description:
We are now hiring a QC Supervisor to join our team on our site in North Dublin. The QC Supervisor is a key member of the Quality Control team, responsible for leading day-to-day quality control laboratory operations and ensuring effective support for QA, Technical Service, and Production in line with site schedules and targets. This role supervises a team of QC Chemists, reports to the QC Manager, and may act as deputy when required. The position requires strong leadership, technical expertise, and a commitment to compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, company policies, and cGMP standards.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily QC laboratory operations and ensure work is performed in accordance with regulatory and company requirements.
  • Support daily and weekly production schedules, including participation in Tier 1 and Tier 2 meetings.
  • Escalate laboratory, safety, equipment, process, and systems issues through the site escalation process as needed.
  • Lead, coach, and develop QC staff to build capability, support performance, and strengthen succession planning.
  • Ensure adequate laboratory coverage, timely sample management, and support for internal and external testing activities.
  • Maintain high standards for documentation, data integrity, and timely completion of required records and reports.
  • Oversee laboratory calibration, maintenance, and equipment utilization metrics.
  • Deliver or coordinate training to ensure laboratory personnel are qualified, compliant, and effective in their roles.
  • Promote cGMP, safety, housekeeping, and security compliance while maintaining a safe working environment.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, support method and process development, and contribute to scientific studies and laboratory enhancements.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Chemistry or a related Science discipline.
  • 3–5 years of relevant QC experience, including at least 2 years of direct supervisory experience or demonstrated staff mentoring.
  • Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing operations, cGMP requirements, USP, FDA guidance, and QC laboratory practices.
  • Experience with analytical instrumentation and laboratory methods such as HPLC, GC, Dissolution, FTIR, UV/Vis, wet chemistry, method validation, method transfer, and compendial verification.
  • Proficiency with LIMS, Microsoft Office, TrackWise, EDOCS, and chromatographic software such as Empower, with strong scientific writing and troubleshooting skills.

title: Myyjä (20 h/vko) Kespron Vaasan tukkuun
description:
Oletko energinen ja innostunut tiimipelaaja, joka etsii monipuolista ja toimeliasta työtä? Haluatko kääriä hihat ja tehdä töitä hyvässä porukassa? Tule K-ryhmään ja kirjoita oma kappaleesi eurooppalaisen kaupan alan menestystarinaan.

Etsimme myyjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Vaasan tukkuun ylittämään asiakkaidemme odotukset.

Myyjänä tehtäviisi kuuluu asiakaspalvelu, kuormanpurku- ja keräilytehtävät sekä kassatyöskentely, joten osallistut päivittäiseen asiakaspalvelutyöhön ja tavarankäsittelyyn sen eri muodoissa. Lisäksi tehtäviisi kuuluu kassatoimiston työtehtäviä.

Pääset suomalaisen kaupan etulinjaan kehittämään asiakaskokemusta. K-ryhmässä sinulla on jatkuvasti lukuisia mahdollisuuksia kehittää itseäsi asiakaspalvelun ja kaupan alan ammattilaisena.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työn
  • mahdollisuuden kehittyä tukun eri työtehtävissä
  • tarvittavan perehdytyksen
  • työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan
  • hauskat ja innostavat työkaverit

Kauppa on K-ryhmän intohimo ja teemme sitä kuunnellen asiakkaitamme herkällä korvalla. Tarjoamme laajan kirjon erilaisia tuotteita sekä kehitämme uusia palveluita, jotka tekevät työstä innostavaa ja uudistuvaa. Pystymme tarjoamaan erilaisia tehtäviä useista päivittäistavara-, rauta- ja autokaupoistamme.

Olemme iso ja vahva ryhmä, mutta tarjoamme välittömän, lojaalin ja ystävällisen työyhteisön. K-ryhmässä sinulla on jatkuvasti lukuisia mahdollisuuksia kehittää itseäsi asiakaspalvelun ja kaupan alan ammattilaisena. Meillä kukaan ei jää yksin ja vastuullisena toimijana huolehdimme asiakkaistamme, yhteiskunnasta ja ympäristöstä.

Odotamme sinulta:

  • iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta ja joustavuutta
  • positiivista mieltä ja reipasta, oma-aloitteista työotetta sekä hyviä työyhteisötaitoja
  • työtä pelkäämätöntä asennetta ja vastuunottokykyä sekä täsmällisyyttä
  • mahdollisuutta työskennellä kaikkina tukun aukioloaikoina (Kespron Vaasan tukussa työajat sijoittuvat ma-pe klo 6-18 la klo 8-12)
  • Ms Office -ohjelmien sujuvaa käyttöä
  • sujuvaa suomen kielitaitoa
  • vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

Trukin ajotaito, hygieniapassi sekä kaupan-, ravintola- ja logistiikka-alan kokemus on plussaa, mutta ei pakollista. Meillä tehtävissä menestyminen edellyttää aitoa halua luoda ylivertainen asiakaskokemus.

Kespro on osa K-ryhmää ja johtava Foodservice-alan tukkukauppa Suomessa. Meidän missionamme on tehdä ulkona syömisestä elämyksellisempää, vastuullisempaa ja siten suositumpaa. Asiakkaitamme ovat mm. ravintolat, hotellit, kahvilat, liikenneasemat, julkishallinnon laitokset, K-ryhmän kaupat sekä jälleenmyyntiasiakkaat. Asiakkaita meillä on noin 25 000. Kespron toiminnot muodostuvat viidestä myyntialueesta ja 13 noutotukusta. Liikevaihtomme on yli 800 miljoonaa euroa ja henkilöstöä meillä on yli 500.

Tehdään hyvä kauppa – tule K-ryhmään.

Työt alkavat 01.09.2026.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Johanna Alatalo, johanna.alatalo@kesko.fi.

Lähetä hakemuksesi 04.08.2026 mennessä oheisen linkin kautta. Aloitamme hakemusten käsittelyn jo hakuaikana.

Miten rekrytointi etenee?

Täytä hakemus järjestelmässämme hae tästä -painikkeen kautta ◾ Kutsumme esivalintavaiheessa hakijoita videohaastatteluun ◾ Mahdollinen haastattelu tai rekrytointipäivä ◾ Olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin hakijoihin valintojen ja prosessin edetessä.

Huomioithan, että palkka määräytyy toimittamiesi työ- ja opintotodistusten perusteella. Varaudu toimittamaan ne prosessin aikana. Aloitamme hakemusten käsittelyn jo hakuaikana ja voimme täyttää paikan ennen hakuajan päättymistä. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Meitä Kesprolaisia yhdistää syvä rakkaus ja intohimo suomalaista ruokakulttuuria kohtaan. Meillä jokainen päivä on mahdollisuus tehdä jotain merkityksellistä. Sukellamme rohkeasti uusiin ideoihin ja kokeiluihin, sillä uteliaisuus on polttoaineemme. Asiakas on sydämessämme ja mielessämme kaikessa mitä teemme, ja ratkaisemme haasteet luovasti ja päättäväisesti. Olemme yhteisö, jossa jokainen saa kasvaa, loistaa ja vaikuttaa. Meidän vahvuutemme on yhdessä tekeminen ja se energia, joka syntyy, kun samaan suuntaan kulkee intohimoisia ja positiivisia tekijöitä. Muutoksen keskellä näemme mahdollisuuksia ja uskallamme tarttua niihin. Kespro on paikka, jossa suomalainen ruokakulttuuri kehittyy asiakkaidemme menestyvän liiketoiminnan myötä, ja jossa jokainen meistä on osa sen syntytarinaa.

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

title: Research Study Participant (Paid)
description:
About Tacit

We are an early-stage, deep tech startup based in San Francisco, developing innovative hardware that rethinks human-computer interaction. We are backed by General Catalyst, Khosla Ventures, and Greylock Partners, with a founding team from Stanford, BrainGate, Oculus, and Tesla. While we can’t reveal too much just yet, our team is tackling cutting-edge engineering challenges to bring revolutionary products to life.

Seeking volunteers for a human-computer interaction research study in San Francisco and San Jose!

We're seeking volunteers for an in-person study on how people engage with text while using a new wearable interface. We're looking for readers of all kinds, avid or occasional. No technical or research background is needed.

Time Commitment

  • One session in San Francisco (SOMA) or San Jose, lasting 1 to 4 hours depending on the study tasks

  • No ongoing or minimum time commitment. You can take part once and be done.

What to expect

  • Wear a non-invasive, wearable prototype during the session

  • Read English-language materials we provide

  • Follow instructions from the study team

  • Share brief feedback at the end

The session takes place in a quiet, distraction-free room. You can remove the device at any time, and before you agree to participate we'll walk you through exactly how it works and how data is recorded.

Eligibility

  • Adults 18 and over

  • Able to attend sessions in person in San Francisco or San Jose

  • Fluent English speaker, comfortable reading English-language materials

  • Able to follow instructions and completing simple tasks on your own

As a thank you for your time

Participants receive $20 for every hour of the study they complete, sent via PayPal after the session.

Voluntary Participation

This is a voluntary research study, not employment. You can withdraw at any point and still be paid for the hours you completed.

As a thank-you for your time

Participants will receive $20 for every hour of a session they complete. Payment goes out via PayPal within a few days after completing your session.

Voluntary participation

This is a voluntary research study, not employment. You can withdraw at any point and still be paid for the time you completed.

Interested? Fill out our short screening form and we'll follow up with more details!

title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Strategy, Amazon Business Marketplace
description:
Come be a part of a rapidly expanding $100 billion-dollar global business. At Amazon Business, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We are disrupting Business to Business (B2B) by delivering new, efficient purchasing solutions to individual proprietors, to small-medium businesses, to global organizations (and everything in between).

Amazon Business (AB) Marketplace has built strong horizontal programs across selection, pricing, delivery, and seller management that serve B2B customers broadly. The next wave of growth requires going deeper: identifying underpenetrated industry verticals where B2B customers have specialized needs that our horizontal programs do not fully address, and building end-to-end 3P seller strategies tailored to those verticals.

As a Product Manager on the Amazon Business 3P team, you will own the vertical strategy for underpenetrated B2B categories in Japan. You will identify where our current 3P seller ecosystem falls short of meeting vertical-specific customer needs, define what it takes for sellers to succeed in those verticals, and drive execution across the full seller lifecycle: recruiting the right sellers, closing selection gaps, designing competitive pricing approaches, improving delivery experience, enabling value-added services, and launching go-to-market initiatives. Target verticals include areas such as medical supplies, food service, heavy and bulky goods, and softlines, and you will prioritize focus areas based on opportunity sizing and strategic fit.

This role requires working across organizational boundaries. You will partner closely with Retail category teams (CBD) who own vertical buyer strategy, the AB buyside team responsible for customer experience, and functional PM owners within the 3P team who manage horizontal programs (selection, pricing, DEX). You will also work directly with 3P Account Management teams responsible for seller recruiting and existing seller management. Your job is to connect these stakeholders around a shared vertical roadmap, define the 3P contribution, and drive measurable progress.

The ideal candidate is analytically strong, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and effective at influencing partners without direct authority. You should be energized by building something from a blank page rather than optimizing an existing program, and be willing to get hands-on with data, seller conversations, and partner team negotiations to move from problem definition to execution.

Key job responsibilities
Identify and prioritize underpenetrated B2B verticals based on customer demand signals, competitive landscape, and 3P seller ecosystem readiness.
Define end-to-end 3P vertical strategies covering seller recruiting, selection acquisition, pricing, delivery, services, and GTM.
Partner with Retail CBD, AB buyside, and AB3P functional PMs to align vertical roadmaps and secure cross-team commitment.
Work with 3P Account Management teams to translate vertical strategy into actionable seller recruiting and engagement plans.
Conduct market analysis, seller and customer research to understand vertical-specific requirements and barriers.
Define success metrics, build tracking mechanisms, and report progress to leadership.
Write business cases and strategy documents to secure investment and alignment for vertical initiatives.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. title: Senior Executive - Compliance, Health & Safety
description:
Senior Executive - Compliance, Health & Safety

(Based at Unichela-Koggala)

The Bodywear Value Stream of MAS Holdings delivers end-to-end design, innovation and manufacturing solutions across lingerie, swimwear and next-to-skin categories. It brings together broad expertise in fit, comfort, performance and aesthetics to serve leading global brands at scale.

title: Client and Work Winning Lead – Civil Infrastructure
description:
What if you could shape a career as unique as you?

At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.

A little more about your role…

The Civil Business Unit has a diverse portfolio of work, across multiple sectors, clients and geographies. It comprises two business streams, responsible for all Civil focused activities in the following Sectors:

  • Civil Transport – Road and Rail Sectors.
  • Civil Infrastructure – Aviation, Maritime, Energy (including Nuclear), Defence and Water, which also includes pavement engineering and asset management services.

The Client and Work Winning Lead for Civil Infrastructure will report directly to the Head of Discipline for Civil Infrastructure and will fulfil a key leadership role with particular focus on client engagement, pipeline and work winning across the Civil Business Unit. They will work in close collaboration with other members of the Civil Strategic and Operational Leadership Teams.

The Client and Work Winning Lead will embed a strong culture of growth, client engagement, business development and bidding to win in accordance with the UK and Business Unit Strategic Plan.

This is a highly visible role for someone who wants to shape the future growth of Civil, influence major client relationships and play a direct role in securing the opportunities that matter most to our business. It requires someone who can set direction, create confidence, roll their sleeves up when the opportunity demands it and has a strong domain knowledge and experience of at least one of the Civil Infrastructure sectors and / or services.

The role will be accountable for improving pipeline confidence, win probability, capture discipline, bid quality, strategic opportunity conversion and client plan ownership.

What’s Involved in Your New Role?

  • Providing leadership that promotes growth and ownership for client engagement and work winning in Civil Infrastructure.
  • Managing and strengthening our pipeline of opportunities to provide confidence in sustainable workload, long-term business performance and business planning.
  • Leading capture planning and delivering winning proposals for our strategic opportunities including personally leading priority pursuits from early positioning through to submission.
  • Embedding best practice and lessons learned with our regional Civil growth leads to develop pipeline visibility and work winning excellence across our regional portfolio of clients.
  • Working directly with teams to shape win themes, client messaging and commercial strategy.
  • Driving the development and active use of strategic client plans for priority clients and sectors.
  • Supporting disciplined bid/no-bid decision-making to focus effort on opportunities where Civil has a credible route to win.
  • Leading collaboration & cross-selling within our Strategic Business Units & wider WSP developing new offerings for our clients.
  • Developing relationships and forming teams with contractors and other consulting partners for major opportunities.
  • Supporting the development and recruitment of our work-winning resources to meet future discipline, project and client need.
  • Ensuring robust standards for our governance processes are maintained for our bids and opportunities.
  • Undertake role of Bid Director for strategic opportunities, responsible for quality, commercial, contractual and all aspects of developing a winning proposal.
  • Work collaboratively with your counterpart Client and Work Winning Lead for Civil Transportation, supporting growth across the full portfolio of opportunities within the whole Civil Business Unit.

Your Team

  • You will be part of our Civil Business Unit which sits within WSP’s Transport and Infrastructure portfolio with, Roads, Rail, Water and Intelligent Infrastructure Business Units.
  • With over 800 people, our Civil Business Unit provides engineering, advisory and asset management services across multiple sectors with a client base including all National and Local Government agencies, Local Authorities, Asset Owners, Contractors and international Authorities.
  • You will report directly to the Head of Discipline for Civil Infrastructure enabling delivery of our current and future strategy.
  • You will work closely with our regional leadership structure to embed a culture of client engagement, pipeline strength and bidding to win across our teams with direct involvement in strategic opportunities.
  • You will lead and inspire those within Civil who want to develop their career in clients, work winning, sales and growth.

What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…

  • Strong Civil engineering, transport and / or infrastructure experience, with a strong domain knowledge and experience in at least one of the Civil Infrastructure sectors and / or services.
  • Established networks across clients, contractors and stakeholders.
  • The ability to move comfortably between strategic leadership and hands-on delivery, bringing pace, judgement and resilience to complex client and work-winning situations.
  • A strong track record in securing new work through capture planning, client insight, market positioning, competitor understanding and proactive bidding.
  • Experience of using client insight, market intelligence and competitor understanding to shape positioning and improve win probability.
  • Strong commercial awareness and a robust understanding of public and private sector procurement.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and constructively challenge senior colleagues, build rapport and present compelling proposals to clients, partners and internal teams.
  • Experience leading initiatives that strengthen client-centric delivery, pipeline ownership, market profile, continuous improvement and business success.
  • A passion for leadership, with proven capability to support, motivate and develop people.
  • Membership of an engineering professional body is preferred but not essential

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?

With us, you can. Apply today.

title: Junior Kostendeskundige
description:
Wat ga je doen

Bij Hurks in Eindhoven zoeken we een Junior Kostendeskundige die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich wil ontwikkelen tot een volwaardig adviseur binnen onze projectteams. Je hoeft nog niet alle antwoorden te hebben; belangrijker is dat je leergierig bent, graag wilt begrijpen hoe bouwprojecten tot stand komen en interesse hebt in cijfers, techniek en bouwprocessen.

Onder begeleiding van ervaren collega's werk je mee aan de voorbereiding van uitdagende bouw- en ontwikkelprojecten. Je ondersteunt bij het opstellen van kostenramingen en begrotingen, analyseert ontwerpen en leert hoe je risico's en kansen binnen projecten kunt signaleren. Zo draag je bij aan het maken van de juiste keuzes nog voordat de uitvoering start.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van planontwikkeling, bedrijfsbureau, engineering en uitvoering. Hierdoor krijg je een breedbeeld van het bouwproces en ontwikkel je jezelf stap voor stap tot kostendeskundige.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Ondersteunen bij het opstellen van kostenramingen en begrotingen in verschillende projectfasen;

  • Analyseren van ontwerpen en bouwmethodieken samen met ervaren collega's;

  • Signaleren van risico's en kansen binnen projecten;

  • Verzamelen en verwerken van kostengegevens en marktinformatie;

  • Werken met BIM-modellen voor het bepalen van hoeveelheden;

  • Vergelijken van marktprijzen en ontwikkelingen binnen de bouwsector;

  • Ondersteunen van projectteams met kostenanalyses en rapportages;

  • Samenwerken met collega's van planontwikkeling, bedrijfsbureau, engineering en uitvoering.

Wat breng jij mee

  • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Bouwkunde, Built Environment of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Interesse in bouwkosten, calculaties en bouw-en vastgoedontwikkeling;

  • Analytisch vermogen en affiniteit met cijfers;

  • Leergierigheid, nieuwsgierigheid en een proactieve houding;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een teamgerichte instelling;

  • Ervaring met calculatie- of BIM-software is mooi meegenomen, maar geen must.

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Salaris van € 3.500- tot € 4.500,- bruto per 4 weken (€ 3.791,- tot € 4.875,- bruto per maand) op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Je krijgt naast je salaris een vast bedrag voor duurzame inzetbaarheid die eraan bijdraagt om gezond te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra);

  • 43 vrije dagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

  • Mogelijkheid om in overleg tot 40 % van de werktijd thuis te werken;

  • Jouw ontwikkeling doet ertoe. Met Grow, ons leer- en ontwikkelplatform, krijg je alle ruimte om te werken aan je persoonlijke en professionele ambities;

  • Veel afwisseling en vrijheid in je functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid;

  • Werken aan uitdagende en afwisselende bouwprojecten;

  • 1 week verplichte bouwvakvakantie, overige vrije dagen kunnen met uitzondering van de vastgestelde landelijke feestdagen vrij worden ingepland;

  • Je kunt deelnemen aan diverse (sport) activiteiten en initiatieven, zoals zomerevents, padel toernooien, het Young Professionals-programma voor jouw ontwikkeling en Hurks Helpt, een initiatief waarmee je de kans krijgt om naast je werk iets terug te doen voor de maatschappij.

title: Tjej i Torslanda söker personlig assistent!
description:
God Assistans erbjuder personlig assistans till kunder över hela Sverige. Vi är ett företag med stort hjärta, hög kompetens och ett genuint engagemang för det vi gör. Med lång erfarenhet inom personlig assistans strävar vi alltid efter att förenkla vardagen för våra kunder och skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö för våra medarbetare.
Vi tror på vikten av ett personligt bemötande, hög tillgänglighet och snabb service – och vi arbetar varje dag för att leva upp till detta.
För våra medarbetare erbjuder vi:

Kollektivavtal
Friskvårdsbidrag upp till 4000 kr/år
Kontinuerlig utbildning och kompetensutveckling

Inför en intervju ber vi dig att styrka din rätt att arbeta i Sverige genom att visa upp giltiga dokument, såsom svenskt pass/personbevis, uppehållskort (EU) eller uppehålls- och arbetstillstånd/LMA-kort (utanför EU). Enligt lagen om registerkontroll behöver du även uppvisa ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister (Utdrag för arbete med barn med funktionsnedsättning) om du ska arbeta med minderårig. Du kan enkelt beställa detta digitalt via polisens hemsida.
Vill du veta mer om oss? Besök gärna vår hemsida: http://www.godassistans.se

Nu söker jag fler personliga assistenter!

Jag är en flicka på nio år som nu söker fler personliga assistenter till mitt team. Jag bor i ett hus i Torslanda tillsammans med min mamma, pappa, lillasyster och vår hund Gustaf.  Min diagnos (Krabbes sjukdom) gör att jag har stort behov av hjälp dygnet runt.

Som min assistent kommer du att hjälpa mig med allt gällande min livsföring. Du kommer också hantera min gastrostomi (PEG) och min slemsug. Eftersom jag inte har något tal eller några större känslouttryck, är det viktigt att du är nära mig hela tiden för att kunna lyssna och se efter så att jag mår bra.

Jag går inte i skolan, så det är du som assistent som kommer vara den som aktiverar mig. Böcker, fotbad och sång är saker jag tycker om. Kyla och regn är dock inte min grej, så ute hänger jag mest när det är varmt och skönt.

Vi ser att du som söker...
en tjänst som vikarie hos mig är intresserad både av främst dag— och nattpass. Du bör vara duktig på praktisk omvårdnad, det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av slemsug, PEP-mask och gärna vara kvinna. Körkort är önskvärt men inget krav då det är bra bussförbindelser hem till mig.

Krav:
Erfarenhet av arbete inom omsorg eller liknande
God förmåga att samarbeta och kommunicera med andra
Stor flexibilitet och förmåga att anpassa sig till förändrade situationer

Schema: Kunden har assistans dygnet runt med aktiv tid under natten. Kunden har även dubbelassistans vissa dagar under dagtid.

Passen kommer vara förlagda mellan kl. 08:00-16:00 och kl. 21:00-07:00, även arbete under helg förekommer.

title: Technical Program Manager, GPS Delivery, Google Data Centers
description:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Network Infrastructure Engineering (NIE) is responsible for the planning, evaluation, design, and construction of Google's space in data center facilities across the globe. We're looking for Technical Program Managers (TPMs) and engineers who can help us to evaluate, plan, design, cost, and build new and enhanced space in data center facilities. We are constantly in a state of evaluations, design, and construction across the globe, we need team members who can help us execute on our goal to design and build spaces that last us multiple years.

Google Public Sector brings the magic of Google to the mission of government and education with solutions purpose-built for enterprises. We focus on helping United States public sector institutions accelerate their digital transformations, and we continue to make significant investments and grow our team to meet the complex needs of local, state and federal government and educational institutions.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate physical infrastructure demands (space, power, cooling, fiber) to requirements of building designs.
  • Work closely with design engineering firms, construction contractors, DC providers, and other partner teams to develop solutions that can be deployed to support Google’s Public Sector (GPS) ICD-705 data center demands.
  • Review design and construction plans, providing technical input on MEP systems.
  • Provide reporting and project tracking of Google Public Sector (GPS) data center design and construction projects.
  • Coordinate necessary financial/technical approvals and manage budget/schedule for multiple concurrent projects.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in program management.
  • Experience with data center physical infrastructure (e.g., space, power, cooling, fiber).
  • Experience with ICD-705 Sensitive Compartmentalized Information Facility (SCIF) requirements.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • Experience in an engineering or program management role involving multi-disciplinary fields such as network, fiber, electrical, or mechanical (cooling).
  • Experience working on defining and designing data center infrastructure.
  • Experience in construction management.
  • Network engineering experience or familiarity with network architectures.

title: .NET Engineer
description:
Ciklum is looking for a .NET Engineer to join our team full-time in Poland.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a .NET Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

  • Utilise automated deployment methods for software delivery
  • Communicate effectively with both technical peers and delivery team stakeholders
  • Forge close links with architects, developers, analysts and wider team members within the development team
  • Prioritise individual workloads and maintain self-sufficiency
  • Identify and escalate key issues as required to maintain project momentum

Requirements:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in this role and of developing .Net applications
  • Competent proficiency in .Net Core, C#, REST APIs, HTML/CSS, React, ASP.Net MVC, and Unit Testing / TDD
  • Competent knowledge of AWS components: API Gateway, Lambda, ECS, Fargate, S3, Aurora RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation, Load Balancers, Route 53, SQS, SNS, EC2, Kinesis, and IAM
  • Competent proficiency in Azure DevOps Pipelines and Docker
  • Mandatory Certification: Valid AWS Certified Developer – Associate certificate required within 6 months of start
  • Soft skills: Expert level fluent English and attention to detail

Desirable:

  • Competent proficiency in AWS monitoring tools: Elastic Search service & Kibana, and CloudWatch
  • Competent proficiency in Git/source control and JIRA / Confluence

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Flexibility: Enjoy flexibility – full remote working possibilities
  • Care: We've got you covered with company-paid premium medical package through Luxmed
  • Benefits: Access the MyBenefit cafeteria platform, allowing you to choose perks that best suit your lifestyle and needs

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

With delivery centers in Wrocław and Gdańsk, our 300+ professionals in Poland drive forward-thinking solutions for global clients. Join a community where collaboration sparks innovation—and your impact reaches millions.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

title: Global Custody - Asset Servicing Analyst
description:
Make post-trade events work when accuracy and timing matter most. You’ll help clients navigate complex voluntary corporate actions and proxy voting across Asia-Pacific markets, where details and deadlines drive real impact. We’ll support your growth through exposure to diverse markets, partners, and operational risk topics. You’ll bring curiosity and sound judgment, and we’ll count on you to help strengthen controls and improve how we work. If you enjoy solving problems and improving processes, you’ll thrive here.

As an Asset Servicing Analyst within Securities Services Operations, you manage the end-to-end processing of complex voluntary corporate actions and support oversight of proxy voting services across Asia-Pacific markets. You partner with internal teams and service providers to deliver accurate, timely outcomes and clear client communications. You identify exceptions early, escalate effectively, and help reduce operational risk through strong controls and documentation. You contribute to continuous improvement by strengthening processes and sharing knowledge across the team.

You’ll work closely with regional processing teams, product partners, client-facing teams, and external vendors to deliver consistent service outcomes across multiple markets. The team focuses on disciplined execution, transparency, and continuous improvement to protect clients and improve the operating environment.

Job responsibilities

  • Process complex, high-risk voluntary corporate action events from announcement through completion
  • Reconcile client instructions, investigate breaks, and drive timely resolution through appropriate escalation
  • Execute daily controls, checks, instruction processing, and query management with accuracy and timeliness
  • Validate proxy voting data and meeting information received from vendors to support accurate client communications
  • Escalate issues to vendors and internal partners when exceptions, data gaps, or risks are identified
  • Document processing, controls, and issue resolution evidence in line with operational standards
  • Monitor proxy voting service quality and support governance activities by tracking issues and trends
  • Partner with regional processing, product, and client-facing teams to deliver consistent service outcomes
  • Identify and implement process improvements that reduce risk and improve efficiency
  • Coach peers through guidance and knowledge sharing to strengthen team capability and client experience
  • Serve as a point of contact for corporate actions and proxy-related queries to support timely stakeholder resolution


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • 3 years of experience in financial services operations with hands-on transaction processing responsibilities
  • Experience supporting corporate actions and/or asset servicing operational workflows
  • Ability to apply controls, validate inputs, and identify exceptions with strong attention to detail
  • Strong analytical skills and judgment to assess issues, risks, and required actions
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills to explain issues, risks, and resolutions to stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver accurate outcomes in a high-volume environment
  • Experience working in a control-focused environment with evidence of supporting operational risk reduction
  • Ability to learn, document, and implement new processes effectively in a changing environment

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience supporting proxy voting operations and/or proxy oversight activities
  • Experience performing user acceptance testing (UAT) for operational applications or workflow enhancements
  • Knowledge of Asia-Pacific market practices related to corporate actions and post-trade processing
  • Experience contributing to process change initiatives and operational improvement delivery

title: Integration Specialist
description:
Are you ready to connect complex systems and make data flow seamlessly across a dynamic IT landscape? As an Integration Specialist, you play a central role in designing and building integrations that support critical processes in domains such as finance, supply chain, marketing and HR.

You work at the heart of the organization, where applications, platforms and teams come together. Using modern integration technologies relying on our Integration Platform (Mulesoft), you help shape a scalable and future-proof integration landscape. You contribute not only by delivering solutions, but also by improving the way the team works and by helping define the technical direction for the future (think of the use of AI).

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing integration architectures and creating API specifications aligned with team standards.
  • Developing and implementing MuleSoft integrations, including reusable and deployable assets.
  • Delivering high-quality Unit tests as part of integration solutions.
  • Creating clear and structured technical documentation according to team guidelines.
  • Contributing to integration improvements from the backlog and supporting ongoing changes.
  • Helping improve processes, ways of working and the long-term integration vision.

You are an integration professional who thrives in a collaborative environment, is able to work independently, and takes ownership of delivering reliable and scalable solutions. You combine technical expertise with a proactive mindset and a drive to continuously improve.

Additionally, you bring the following:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in designing and developing integrations.
  • Strong knowledge of APIs and web services, including XML and JSON.
  • Experience with CI/CD implementation and deployment processes.
  • Experience working with integration platforms such as MuleSoft.
  • Ability to translate requirements into scalable technical designs.

If you recognize most of these points but not every single one, we still encourage you to apply. We value your potential and your willingness to grow.

For this position, a pre-employment screening is required, consisting of a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and a background/integrity check. Due to the access to sensitive (financial) information and customer data, we place great importance on a careful assessment. The screening must be successfully completed before you can start your employment with us. We reimburse the cost of the VOG application and, of course, handle your data with care in accordance with our privacy statement.

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You play a key role in future-proofing the agricultural sector, and we ensure you have all the space, resources, and support needed to do so.

  • An international work environment with plenty of room for initiative and entrepreneurship.
  • Excellent employment conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a strong pension scheme.
  • A salary within the range of €5,015 – €7,163 gross per month, with clear room for growth from your starting salary over time.
  • Strong career development opportunities: you are in control of your own growth and can choose from a wide range of training programs through our Lely Academy—from personal development to role-specific education.
  • Our modern Lely Campus offers daily access to extensive sports facilities: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, basketball and volleyball courts, table tennis, and table football. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training—and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
  • Enjoy fresh coffee and tea from our in-house barista, made with milk sourced directly from our own farm, as well as a healthy and affordable company restaurant.
  • A free shuttle bus takes you to and from the metro in Maassluis, ensuring your workday starts and ends smoothly.
  • Success should be celebrated: from anniversaries to Christmas parties—we know how to do it at Lely!
  • We are also proud that our commitment and vision have been recognized with the Rotterdam Business Award 2025.

Recruitment & selection agencies, consultancies, and/or staffing agencies?

We appreciate your interest, but we recruit all candidates directly. We understand that as an intermediary you may wish to introduce candidates for our vacancies and contribute to our ambitions, but this is not how our recruitment process is structured. This means that any unsolicited profiles submitted for Lely vacancies will be treated as direct applications.

title: Data Solution Architect
description:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients.

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

Role Mission

The Data Solution Architect defines and owns the design of scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions that support customer and operational systems. This role is responsible for setting architectural direction, ensuring alignment with business needs, and guiding teams to deliver robust, production-grade solutions.

The Data Solution Architect works across engineering, product, and data teams to ensure solutions are well-designed, maintainable, and aligned with standards for performance, security, and governance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and own end-to-end data solution architectures that meet defined requirements for scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.

  • Translate complex business and product requirements into clear architectural designs, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and future scalability needs.

  • Define and enforce technical standards for data architecture, including data modelling, integration patterns, and system design.

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams, supporting implementation and ensuring adherence to architectural principles.

  • Review and approve solution designs, code, and implementations to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment with standards.

  • Ensure solutions meet defined performance and reliability benchmarks (e.g. system throughput, latency, fault tolerance).

  • Lead the identification and resolution of complex technical issues, including performance bottlenecks and architectural limitations.

  • Drive improvements in system design, scalability, and maintainability through proactive refactoring and architectural evolution.

  • Define and support implementation of CI/CD, testing, and deployment strategies to ensure reliable and efficient delivery.

  • Ensure all solutions adhere to security, privacy, and compliance requirements, including secure data handling practices.

  • Maintain clear architectural documentation, including system designs, decision records, and operational guidance.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional and global teams to align on architecture, standards, and delivery priorities.

Skills & Competencies

  • Data Architecture & System Design – Strong experience designing scalable, distributed data systems, including data models, storage, and processing layers.

  • SQL & Data Processing – Deep understanding of SQL and data querying, with ability to design efficient data structures and transformations.

  • Data Integration & Pipelines (ETL/ELT) – Expertise in designing and optimising data pipelines (e.g. SSIS or equivalent tools and frameworks).

  • Programming (e.g. Python) – Experience using Python or similar languages for data processing, automation, or pipeline development.

  • Cloud & Platform Technologies – Familiarity with modern data platforms and cloud-based architectures (desirable).

  • Performance & Scalability Optimisation – Ability to design and tune systems to meet performance, reliability, and scalability requirements.

  • Security & Compliance – Strong understanding of secure system design, data protection, and regulatory requirements.

  • DevOps & CI/CD – Experience implementing automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to support reliable delivery.

  • Technical Leadership – Provides architectural guidance, reviews work, and supports teams in delivering high-quality solutions.

  • Cross-Team Influence – Works across teams and regions to align on standards, resolve dependencies, and drive consistency.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven experience in a data architecture, software engineering, or technical leadership role (typically 7+ years).

  • Strong experience designing and delivering scalable data solutions in production environments.

  • Expertise in data modelling, system design, and integration patterns.

  • Strong experience with SQL and data processing at scale.

  • Experience working with data pipeline and ETL tools (e.g. SSIS or equivalent).

  • Experience with programming languages (e.g. Python) for data processing or automation.

  • Experience defining or contributing to technical standards and architecture frameworks.

  • Proven ability to lead technical design and guide delivery across teams.

  • Strong communication skills, including translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.​

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Online Assistant
description:

  • Picking and selecting the best quality products on the shop floor that online customers have ordered ready for it to be delivered to their doorsteps – or providing brilliant substitutions where products are out of stock
  • Using a handset that plans your route around the store, what you need to select and how long you have to complete each shop

  • Always ready to serve our customers brilliantly, supporting with any questions, and proactively offering help
  • Build great knowledge about our products, services and promotions to help provide recommendations
  • Working flexibly across the store as required

  • Friendly and welcoming with a genuine enthusiasm for helping customers
  • Enjoys working in a fast-paced, physical and high energy environment, using initiative to solve problems and taking responsibility for owning tasks
  • Always ready to work flexibly and productively to a high standard across the store - you’ll be fully trained in a variety of skills, so you have opportunities to learn, develop and try new things

Working for us has great rewards:

If you need an update on your application, you should contact the store that you have applied to. You can find contact details for all Sainsbury's stores here.

Working in our stores:

Our stores are fast-paced environments where no two days are ever the same. They are at the heart of the local community providing outstanding value, quality and great service. As one of our Online Assistants, you’ll be the special ingredient that supports a joyful shopping experience for our online customers, so they get everything they shop at Sainsbury’s for.

Eligibility:

  • You must be above the school-leaver age in your country School leaving age - GOV.UK

  • You must have Right to Work eligibility in the UK

An inclusive place to work and shop

We are dedicated to being a truly inclusive retailer, where every colleague can achieve their full potential, and every customer feels welcome when they shop with us.

To support this commitment, our colleagues may be entitled to a range of enhanced discretionary leave for families, as well as support for carers. We provide our colleagues resources to help them understand and support their role and their team effectively. Our internal colleague networks seek to ensure true representation for everyone, helping us identify and remove barriers that our colleagues may face.

We are proud to offer a range of development opportunities, including mentorship, training, and career progression pathways, to help our colleagues grow and succeed. We also celebrate diversity through various initiatives and events, fostering a culture of inclusion and respect. If you would like to learn more about our commitment to inclusivity, please take a look here.

As part our commitment as a Disability Confident Leader, all candidates will have the opportunity to be offered an interview through our online assessment which will prioritise those candidates who achieve the highest score and therefore most closely match the essential criteria for the role.

Should you require any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview stages, please let us know, and we will endeavour to support you.

title: Strategy & Operations Associate
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Own

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions


Location

  • This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Korea. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Korea.


Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: RN Staff - 5 N Tele - Full Time 12 Hour Days (Non-Exempt) (Union)
location: Los Angeles, CA - Health Sciences Campus
description:
As an integral part of the interdisciplinary team, the Registered Nurse utilizes the nursing process to provide therapeutic care to patients. The Registered Nurse is accountable for the coordination of patient care and education to the patient and family in accordance with the standards, policies, and practices in a compassionate, supportive, and therapeutic environment.


Essential Duties:

title: Executive – Regional Network Control Centre- BTH
description:
Position Overview:
The Executive – Regional Network Control Centre is responsible for real-time monitoring and control of surface network movements within the region. The role focuses on tracking vehicle movements, monitoring schedule adherence, managing exceptions, and coordinating with operations teams to minimize delays and service disruptions.
This role acts as the first line of operational control and escalation for regional surface network performance. Job Purpose:
To ensure uninterrupted surface network operations by providing real-time monitoring, exception management, and coordination support, enabling adherence to committed TATs and service standards across the regional logistics network. Key Roles & Responsibilities:
Network Monitoring & Control
•
Monitor real-time movement of surface vehicles across regional routes using tracking and telematics systems.
•
Track adherence to planned schedules, departure times, and arrival timelines.
•
Identify delays, deviations, and exceptions impacting network performance.

Exception Management & Escalation
•
Flag transit delays, route deviations, vehicle breakdowns, and operational disruptions.
•
Coordinate with fleet, hub, and line-haul teams to initiate corrective actions.
•
Escalate critical exceptions to Regional SFC Fleet & Network Manager as per defined protocols.
Schedule & TAT Adherence
•
Track key TAT milestones across first-mile, middle-mile, and last-mile handovers.
•
Support recovery actions to minimize service impact during delays.
•
Ensure timely communication of potential service risks to stakeholders.
Data Tracking & MIS Support
•
Maintain accurate logs of network movements, delays, and exceptions.
•
Support preparation of daily and periodic network performance MIS.
•
Track key control metrics such as on-time departures, arrivals, and exception closure.
Coordination with Operations Teams
•
Coordinate with hubs, delivery centers, fleet teams, and surface line-haul operators.
•
Support smooth handovers between network legs through timely information sharing.
•
Assist operations teams during peak periods and high-volume days.
Process Adherence & Compliance
•
Follow defined network control SOPs and escalation matrices.
•
Ensure accurate data capture and compliance with control centre processes.
•
Support audits and reviews by providing movement and exception data. Qualifications & Experience:
Education
•
Essential: Graduate degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field.
•
Preferred: Diploma or certification in Logistics, Transportation, or Operations Management.
Experience
•
1–3 years of experience in logistics operations, network monitoring, fleet coordination, or control tower–type roles.
•
Exposure to surface transportation, line-haul operations, or express logistics environments preferred.
•
Experience working in shift-based or time-critical operations is an advantage Skills & Capabilities:
