Enterprise Connectivity Business Operations team translates those strategic choices into tangible business propositions. We represent the voice of the customer as we build distinctive, always-on connected vehicle technologies and services that transform the ownership experience.

The Software Quality Assurance Engineer is responsible for applying advanced quality methodologies and tools to proactively identify, analyze, and eliminate potential defects throughout the product lifecycle. This role champions a "shift-left" approach, embedding prevention strategies into every stage of software and product development.


You will translate quality principles and defect prevention vision into concrete action — acting as a trusted technical partner to cross-functional stakeholders and collaborating closely with engineering teams to embed robust, systemic defect prevention practices across our automotive platforms.

  • Document RCA findings, clearly capturing contributing factors and systemic weaknesses
  • Define robust Prevent Recurrence Actions (PRAs) with relevant teams to eliminate root causes
  • Establish and maintain a systematic tracking mechanism for PRAs, monitoring progress to closure
  • Verify implemented actions achieve the desired quality improvement without introducing new issues
  • Document identified non-conformances and potential issues
  • Collaborate with responsible teams to resolve non-conformances, track progress, and verify corrective measure effectiveness
  • Plan, schedule, and perform quality audits across processes and products
  • Identify non-compliance, risks, and improvement opportunities
  • Generate audit reports, communicate findings to stakeholders, and drive timely closure; escalate as needed to resolve open findings
  • Establish and maintain data collection processes for key quality measures
  • Apply statistical methods to monitor quality metrics and identify trends
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to implement targeted actions, bringing processes and product quality back within control limits
  • Synthesize Software Quality Assurance (SWQA) data and activities into clear, actionable summaries

  • Collaborate with supplier quality management teams to ensure externally sourced components meet Ford eSoW requirements and support overall defect prevention

Experience in verification & validation is a plus but is not a substitute for direct defect prevention/quality engineering experience.
  • Proven expertise in software defect prevention methodologies, including within embedded software systems
  • Hands-on experience with structured problem-solving tools (8D, 5 Whys, Root Cause Analysis facilitation, PDCA)

  • Strong background in Failure Mode Avoidance (FMA) for software systems
  • Strong embedded software development expertise

  • Excellent communication, coaching, and training skills to drive cultural and technical improvements

title: Powertrain Control's Integration Engineer
description:
You will be responsible for delivering control software and integration solutions that directly impact the performance of physical vehicles, taking ownership from development through successful program execution. In this role, you will lead commissioning activities, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and drive milestone reviews, with the autonomy to own decisions and deliver results. You will serve as the Controls department representative at key program and vehicle launch meetings, communicating technical progress and challenges to stakeholders and leadership with varying levels of technical expertise. Working closely with cross-functional teams—including Brakes, Body Controls, and Calibration—you will gain broad systems engineering experience while contributing to the successful integration and launch of vehicle features.

  • Lead Vehicle-Level Integration & Commissioning
  • Lead the physical commissioning process for prototype vehicles (both High Voltage and Low Voltage systems), breadboards, and dynos.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive Vehicle and Breadboard Test Plans for each vehicle application.
  • Perform high-level Function Design Verification, analyze testing results, and develop DVP&R (Design Verification Plan and Report) as needed.
  • Drive Software & Program Delivery
  • Serve as the Powertrain Software Applications Engineer, ensuring seamless integration of powertrain software across various platforms.
  • Drive powertrain controls commonality across diverse vehicle applications.
  • Maintain Lead requirement signoff to secure official program signoffs.
  • Track and report progress on program deliverables, updating status in the Global Integrator.
  • Lead preparation and assessments for critical Engineering milestone reviews (FDJ, PEC, FEC).
  • Hands-On Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis
  • Lead deep-dive troubleshooting efforts for vehicle controls issues, bringing in supporting teams as needed to resolve complex issues.
  • Own the investigation, root cause analysis, and permanent corrective action (PCA) process for xEV and traditional controls-related concerns.
  • Collaborate, Present & Plan
  • Represent the PTEC team at program and launch meetings, capturing and communicating key timing and program changes.
  • Support timing and vehicle studies for both existing and next-generation vehicle programs.
  • Develop and deliver technical presentations for PTEC Controls Integration to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Education: Bachelor of Science in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, Computer Science, or a related field).
  • Vehicle Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience troubleshooting and debugging physical vehicles.
  • Software Literacy: 2+ years of experience in roles requiring a strong understanding of embedded software code
  • Calibration Tools: 2+ years of experience with calibration and diagnostic toolsets (e.g., ATI Vision, CANalyzer, PTDIAG, EOL tools, or equivalent major automotive tools).
  • Quality & Validation: 2+ years of experience with Design Verification (DV) and the Failure Mode Analysis (FMA) processes.
  • Agile Methodology: 1+ years of experience working in a Scaled Agile framework utilizing Jira.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills with a proven track record of successfully interfacing cross-functionally across multiple engineering disciplines
  • Exceptional communication skills and a self-motivated drive to manage multiple complex tasks simultaneously.

title: Product Manager, Production Insights
description:
At Factbird, we're redefining how manufacturing runs. By combining hardware, firmware, cloud, and AI, we turn raw production data into real, measurable impact on factory floors around the world. This is a product built by and for people who understand what happens on the shop floor — which is why we're looking for a Product Manager who has lived that reality.

We're building fast, scaling with purpose, and solving problems that matter. Now, we're looking for a Product Manager who wants to bring our product into the future by expanding upon how we create real value on the factory floor — someone who has stood on that floor, owned its numbers, and knows exactly what "real value" means to the people running it.

About the role
This is a high-impact, hands-on product role at the core of Factbird’s growth. As our Product Manager, you’ll set direction, own the roadmap, and drive execution from idea to launch and beyond.

You’ll work closely with cloud development teams, IoT & firmware engineers, and product leaders to connect operations teams with their physical production environment, enabling data driven decision making to drive shop floor improvements. Reporting to the Director of Product, you’ll play a key role in shaping how our platform scales and how our customers succeed.
  • Turn strategy into shipped products: Define roadmaps, prioritize ruthlessly, and work closely with stakeholders to ensure we solve the biggest problems our customers are facing.
  • Lead across disciplines: Act as the glue between product, firmware, cloud, UX, and business stakeholders - making sure everyone is aligned, focused, and moving fast.
  • Identify signals in noise: Clarify customer needs, outline their jobs to be done and translate findings into clear and concise user stories.
  • Spearhead continuous discovery: Build and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders to gather key insights.
  • Launch, learn, iterate: Drive product launches, gather customer feedback, and continuously evolve features based on real-world usage.
  • Own performance & outcomes: Define and track key performance metrics aligned with product objectives.
You have experienced first-hand how a shop floor is operated to ensure targets are met and continuous improvements are realized. You thrive in environments where ownership is high, pace is fast, and impact is visible. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and love turning complexity into clarity, because you've had to do exactly that on a production floor before.

You are curious about technology and are keen to figure out what it enables for people who live and breathe shop floor realities every day. You care deeply about understanding the underlying problem before working on a solution. You want to build products that drive real value, something customers depend on, not just move on to the next shiny thing.


Requirements
  • Direct shop floor operations experience (required): You've worked hands-on running or supporting manufacturing operations, not just observing them from the outside. You've been accountable for ensuring performance meet expectation by collaborating with the likes of operators, process engineers, continuous improvement leads, plant or operations managers. This operational depth is what lets you translate real production pain into product decisions, and it is a hard requirement for this role — without it, the rest of the role is very difficult to do well.
  • Product management experience: 3+ years in product management, ideally
    within SaaS, industrial tech, or production-focused products.
  • A continuous discovery mindset: You talk to customers constantly, map their jobs to be done, and identify commonalities. You're comfortable sitting with ambiguity until the real problem surfaces.
  • Strong data and analytics instinct: Comfortable working with data and understanding how to turn analysis into concrete actions.
  • A natural communicator: You speak the language of engineers, designers, operators, and leadership alike, adapting how you communicate to whoever's in the room.
People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:
  • Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.
  • Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.
  • Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.
  • Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.
  • A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.
  • Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.
  • A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

We’d love to hear from you
If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at khma@factbird.com



At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

title: ADAS Design & Release Engineer
description:
In this position...

You will use your technical expertise to make driving safer, easier and better for our customers. The Advance Driver Assistance Technology (ADAS) team develops state-of-the-art software and algorithms to deliver best-in-class features like adaptive cruise control, automatic emergency braking, blind spot monitoring, driver monitoring, and 360 camera systems.

We are seeking a highly driven engineer responsible for the program application work for ADAS sensors. You would lead hardware and software application and vehicle integration work of these systems that control ADAS features on several vehicle programs.

What you'll do...

  • Lead Design and Release work for ADAS component per the Global Product Development System (GPDS) process on various vehicle programs.
  • Provide cost-efficient and quality parts on time, maintaining ownership and governance of component-specific robustness quality documentation (DFMEA, DVP&R, SCAAF, etc.).
  • Support the Sourcing Process, including investment, piece price, and tooling cost reviews, and prepare initial and final sourcing documents including ESOW, Engineering Specifications, System and Component requirements.
  • Manage and execute hardware releases for prototype, production, and service
  • Lead and perform Failure Mode Avoidance and Functional Safety analyses to examine potential failure modes and design suitable prevention strategies.
  • Conduct Technical Design Reviews, interfacing with Ford core activities and supplier engineering (software, hardware, mechanical, etc.).
  • Support the electrical distribution team by submitting related E/E information like Design Transmittals, specifications, and electrical diagrams.
  • Support Vehicle Operations activities to determine appropriate assembly and testing processes.
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with required specifications and efficient critical decision-making.
  • Complete program-related work such as Bill of Materials (BOM), integration and packaging, parts release, requirements compliance, Engineering Signoff, 2-pagers, and AIMs. Ensure program deliverables are met on time and with the highest quality, including FEDEBOM, Global Integrator DRP, Packaging/Digital Buck, DPA Checks, WERS, FMA, Subsystem/Supplier work plans, DVP&R, and Engineering Sign-off.
  • Analyze data, identify root causes of issues, and develop corrective actions to optimize processes and achieve desired outcomes. Strong systems engineering approach to problem-solving and design. Drive troubleshooting and development of solutions for Hardware, Software, and packaging issues found during validation and launch using problem-solving best practices (Is/Is not, 3L5W, fishbones, etc.) with various experts.
  • Support prototype and vehicle launches, which may require travel.
  • Identify validation, durability, and functional testing required for a given program’s change scope.
  • Support ongoing warranty reduction and improvements.
  • Support Total Vehicle Management activities.

You'll have...

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or related field of study
  • 1+ years of experience in Design and Release of E/E components.
  • 1+ years of experience with Automotive Component or Subsystem Product Development tools and processes.
  • 1+ years of CAD packaging experience.
  • Experience with Teamcenter PLM for releasing engineering drawings and managing BOMs.
  • Strong understanding and application of engineering disciplines (engineering specifications, systems engineering, design validation, failure mode analysis, 8D, Six Sigma, etc.).
  • Ability to clearly and concisely communicate and interact with others, both orally and in writing.
  • Motivation to bring new technologies from concept to production in a short time period.
  • Ability to travel, as necessary.

Even better, you may have...

  • Master's Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or related field of study
  • 3+ years of experience in Design and Release of E/E components.
  • 3+ years of experience with Automotive Component or Subsystem Product Development tools and processes.
  • 3+ years of CAD packaging experience.
  • Experience with ADAS technologies (e.g., camera, radar, lidar, ultrasonic, domain controller).
  • Strong understanding of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and component design principles in controlling packaging into vehicles
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, self-motivated, proactive, eager to take responsibility, and deliver results with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills.

title: Battery Pack Technical Specialist
description:
The Battery Pack Technical Specialist provides deep technical expertise and hands-on engineering support for high-volume battery pack assembly systems. Reporting to the Battery Pack Assembly Manufacturing Engineering Manager, this individual contributor role serves as the technical authority on assembly processes, joining technologies, dispensing expertise and equipment performance—supporting the value stream from concept and Simultaneous Engineering through equipment runoff, installation, commissioning, and Rate of Climb (RoC).

As a key technical resource within our skills-based organization, you will drive resolution of complex engineering issues, provide subject-matter expertise to engineering teams, and support launch excellence across battery pack assembly programs.

What you'll be able to do:

1. Technical Expertise & Mentorship

  • Serve as the go-to technical resource for manufacturing engineers on battery pack assembly systems, processes, and equipment.
  • Mentor and coach engineers on best practices, troubleshooting techniques, and emerging assembly technologies.
  • Support technical training initiatives and contribute to the development of internal technical standards and guides.

2. Pack & Program Manufacturing Engineering Support

  • Provide technical input on Design for Assembly / Design for Manufacturing (DFA/DFM) during early concept and feasibility studies.
  • Support Core Program Team requirements, including OneSpot/Functional Specifications, process sheets, build sequences, and equipment takt time.
  • Provide hands-on technical support for the design, procurement, and integration of assembly stations, transport systems (conveyance, robotics, material handling), and test equipment.
  • Support make-like-production and machine tryout part procurement strategies for physical build phases.

3. Quality, Safety, & Process Governance

  • Contribute to the development and governance of PFMEAs, and collaborate with Product Development on Safety and Critical Characteristics Association Forms (SCCAFs) and Control Plans (DCP).
  • Ensure technical alignment with Bill of Process (BoP), Equipment Standard (E2KS), and Manufacturing Delivery/Program Standards (MDS/MPS).
  • Provide technical expertise on GDT, dimensional stack-up analysis, vision systems, error-proofing, and end-to-end component traceability.
  • Support MIDAS deliverables for equipment validation and lead technical issue resolution (PDCA) from builds through Rate of Climb (RoC).
  • Collaborate with Product Engineering team to ensure compliance with bill of design and bill of process requirements, supporting Design for Manufacturing initiatives.

4. Advanced Manufacturing, Digital Validation, & Joining Technologies

  • Support Simultaneous Engineering (SE) and Digital Job 1 (Virtual Validation) activities, utilizing simulation, digital line validation, and virtual commissioning.
  • Provide technical input on cycle line layouts, facilities layouts, labor modeling, and throughput optimization.
  • Serve as subject-matter expert for specialized joining processes, including fastening (bolt feeders/feed systems), adhesives/sealants (dispense systems), welding, and riveting.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to joining process performance and equipment reliability.
  • Support transition of department from project-based to skillset-based organization.

5. Supplier & Technical Collaboration

  • Provide technical review support for Statements of Work (SOW) and Enquiry Specifications tied to equipment Design and Build.
  • Participate in supplier technical reviews and quoting recaps, providing technical guidance to support PO readiness.
  • Support OEM runoff, installation planning, on-site commissioning, and final capability demonstrations, ensuring technical conformance to Ford standards.
  • Contribute technical input to cost study submissions and capture program lessons learned for future process developments.
  • Travel outside of the Southeast Michigan region as required to support supplier runoffs and plant launches.

The minimum requirements we seek:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or related).
  • 5+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in assembly, automation-intensive, or launch environments, with demonstrated deep technical expertise in battery pack or similar high-volume assembly systems.


Our Preferred Requirements:

  • Masters degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial) or equivalent advanced technical training.
  • Direct experience supporting greenfield, brownfield, or major retool battery module or battery pack assembly manufacturing facilities.
  • Strong technical understanding of automated assembly systems, conveyance, and robotics.
  • Deep technical proficiency in joining technologies (adhesives, sealants, fastening, welding).
  • Demonstrated experience with virtual engineering tools, simulation, virtual commissioning, AutoCAD, TeamCenter, and Aurora.
  • Proven familiarity with Ford BME governance, DPA5 engineering workflows, and MDS/MPS.
  • Understanding of Industrial Engineering and ergonomic principles; experience in Program Delivery preferred.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

title: Python Software Engineer - Product team
description:
What’s in it for you (to start with):

  • Gross monthly salary ranging from € 3.600 to € 5.000 based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework.

  • 8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with your May salary.

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

And many more benefits that you can read about at the bottom of the job description!

Your challenges:

In this position, you will be part of our diverse product team that works on our main application. Your day-to-day challenges will include:

  • Research external eCommerce APIs, understand their value for our customers and build Python integrations with them

  • Work together with Product Managers and own feature or project implementation from initial design to production delivery

  • Collaborate with team members in agile software development by actively contributing to code reviews, sprint planning and retrospectives

  • Improve the reliability and robustness of our application

  • Work with varying technologies, such as strictly typed Python (3.14), SQL, Postgres, GCS, mypy, asyncio, aiohttp, pytest, Sentry, Grafana, Redis and many more!

Who are you?

You are an enthusiastic developer, a critical thinker, and an excellent collaborator. Besides the skills you currently have, an eager-to-learn mindset is just as important. You don’t shy away from taking ownership and responsibility for your projects.

You also have:

  • A drive to build with Python, professional experience preferred.

  • Good understanding of HTTP and REST / GraphQL frameworks.

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases, as we use Postgres heavily.

  • Good working knowledge of Linux, Git, and the command-line.

You would stand out from the crowd if you had:

  • Experience with concurrent applications, because we do a lot of IO via asyncio!

  • Having worked with distributed systems before

  • DevOps mentality: at Channable engineers complete the software development cycle themselves, bring their own code to production, and do so every day.

  • Experience with the LGTM stack from Grafana labs (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mirmir) as we use this for monitoring, alerting and visualization

Practical requirements:

  • EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands

  • Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office

Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

The team:

In this position, you will be joining our Marketplaces Product group. The group is responsible for our API integration channels like Amazon, Bol, and eBay, through which we process hundreds of millions of products and orders every day for our customers. The team is responsible for its own roadmap and works on a Python and React codebase. The group is split into several specialized sub-teams and consists of a skilled and diverse group of Backend, Frontend and Full-stack engineers who work hand-in-hand with QA Engineers, Product Managers, and UI/UX designers to deliver value to our customers.


If this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.

More benefits:

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport.

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM.

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway.

How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? Please apply by clicking on the "apply now" button below. Please send your application in English. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Interview steps:

  1. If it's a match, Ioana (Tech Talent Acquisition Partner) will get in touch with you for an introductory call (30 minutes)

  2. Then you are going to have a live coding interview (1h)

  3. After, we will schedule a culture and role fit interview with the Marketplaces team leads (1h)

Please note that after the interviews, and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.


Interested in more than one Python team? Applying to a single vacancy is enough. We review every candidate for all our current openings to find the best match for your skills.


Important note: We know that in the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the screening process, so we can get to know the real person behind the resume.

Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration and we believe in diverse and inclusive teams

Vil du være med til at sikre sammenhængende og effektive patientforløb inden for hæmatologien? Har du stærke koordinerende kompetencer og lyst til at bidrage til høj kvalitet i patientforløbene, så er denne stilling måske noget for dig.

Afdeling for Blodsygdomme på Rigshospitalet søger en sygeplejefaglig forløbskoordinator til koordinering af hæmatologiske udrednings- og kræftpakkeforløb. Stillingen er primært administrativ med patientkontakt hovedsageligt via telefon. Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. oktober 2026 og er indtil videre uden vagt- og weekendforpligtelse.

Om stillingen

Som forløbskoordinator får du en central rolle i planlægningen og koordineringen af patientforløb i tæt samarbejde med afdelingens læger, sygeplejersker og øvrige samarbejdspartnere. Du bidrager til, at patienter oplever et veltilrettelagt og sammenhængende forløb fra henvisning til behandlingsstart, samtidig med at gældende kvalitets- og tidsfrister overholdes.

Du bliver en del af afdelingens team af sygeplejefaglige forløbskoordinatorer, som sammen arbejder for at sikre effektive og patientcentrerede forløb. Teamet er kendetegnet ved høj faglighed, tæt sparring og et godt kollegialt fællesskab.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

· Koordinering og planlægning af patientforløb inden for udrednings- og kræftpakker.

· Sikring af, at patientforløb gennemføres i overensstemmelse med gældende retningslinjer og nationale krav.

· Tværfagligt samarbejde om tilrettelæggelse af undersøgelser og behandlingsforløb.

· Kontakt til patienter og pårørende i den indledende del af forløbet.

· Opfølgning på forløb, monitorering af aktivitet og understøttelse af kvalitetsudvikling.

· Bidrag til udvikling og optimering af patientforløb lokalt og regionalt.

Vi søger en kollega, som

· Er autoriseret sygeplejerske med dansk autorisation.

· Gerne har erfaring inden for hæmatologi, onkologi eller lignende specialer.

· Har stærke organisatoriske og administrative kompetencer.

· Trives med koordinering af komplekse patientforløb.

· Kommunikerer professionelt og samarbejder konstruktivt på tværs af faggrupper.

· Har fokus på kvalitet, struktur og patientperspektiv.

Om Afdeling for Blodsygdomme:

Afdeling for Blodsygdomme er Danmarks største hæmatologiske afdeling og varetager udredning og behandling af patienter med blandt andet leukæmi, lymfekræft, myelomatose og benigne blodsygdomme. Afdelingen er højt specialiseret og internationalt anerkendt for forskning og udvikling af nye behandlingsmuligheder inden for hæmatologien.

Vi tilbyder

· En central funktion i en højt specialiseret afdeling.

· Et stærkt fagligt miljø med engagerede og kompetente kolleger.

· Et tværfagligt samarbejde med gode muligheder for faglig udvikling.

· Fokus på trivsel, arbejdsfællesskab og balance mellem arbejds- og privatliv.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Stillingen er på 32-37 timer ugentligt efter nærmere aftale og ønskes besat pr. 1. oktober 2026.

Ansøgningsfrist: 20/8-2026 Samtaler afholdes: uge 35

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst mellem Dansk Sygeplejeråd og Regionernes Løn- og Takstnævn.

Ønsker du at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte forløbskoordinatorteamet på telefon 35 45 49 16 eller chefsygeplejerske Hanne Merete Pedersen på telefon 35 45 11 22. Du er også velkommen til efter aftale at besøge afdelingen.

Læs mere om Afdeling for Blodsygdomme på Rigshospitalets hjemmeside eller følg os på Instagram: @afdelingforblodsygdomme.

title: Maskinoperatör | Lernia | Vetlanda
description:
Är du noggrann, tekniskt intresserad och trivs med praktiskt arbete i en industriell miljö? Vi söker flera engagerade och nyfikna maskinoperatörer för kommande uppdrag.

Om tjänsten

  • Placeringsort: Vetlanda

  • Arbetstider: oregelbundna tider och skiftgång förekommer

  • Anställningsform: Visstidsanställning 6 månader- med chans till förlängning (heltid)

  • Tillträde: Omgående / enligt överenskommelse

Som maskinoperatör inom metallindustrin ansvarar du för att köra, övervaka och sköta olika typer av maskiner i produktionen. Du säkerställer att arbetet utförs enligt ritningar, mått, instruktioner och gällande kvalitetskrav. Rollen innebär att ställa in maskiner, byta verktyg eller komponenter, utföra löpande kontroller samt genomföra nödvändiga justeringar för att processen ska fungera stabilt.

Du arbetar efter etablerade rutiner och säkerhetsföreskrifter, dokumenterar eventuella avvikelser och deltar aktivt i förbättringsarbete. Tillsammans med kollegor bidrar du till en effektiv, säker och kvalitativ produktion.

Om dig

Som person är du noggrann, ansvarstagande och strukturerad, med förmåga att hålla fokus även i ett högt tempo. Du arbetar metodiskt, löser problem på ett lugnt och genomtänkt sätt och tvekar inte att ställa frågor när det behövs. Du trivs i en miljö där kvalitet, säkerhet och samarbete står i centrum, och du bidrar till ett positivt arbetsklimat genom att vara hjälpsam, kommunikativ och lätt att samarbeta med.

Formell kompetens

  • Körkort B & tillgång till bil

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska

  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med industrirobotar eller automatiserade produktionsceller inom metall-, verkstads- eller tillverkningsindustrin

Meriterande

  • Truckkort A+B

  • Traverskort

  • Erfarenhet av att läsa och tolka ritningar, mått och arbetsinstruktioner

  • Erfarenhet av enklare maskininställningar eller verktygsbyten

Som en av oss

Som anställd bemanningskonsult hos oss får du alltid en marknadsmässig lön, semester, pensionsavsättning, försäkringar och anslutning till vårt kollektivavtal. Vi vill att du ska må bra hos oss så självklart erbjuder vi våra konsulter friskvårdsbidrag och företagshälsovård. Under din anställning har du en konsultchef som ansvarar för ditt uppdrag, stöttar och utvecklar dig i din yrkesroll och ser till att du trivs på din arbetsplats.

Om Lernia

Lernia är ett av Sveriges ledande bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och finns över hela landet. Med vårt omfattande nätverk erbjuder vi spännande jobb hos attraktiva arbetsgivare och varumärken som hjälper dig att utveckla din kompetens och karriär, både på lång och kort sikt.

Hur du söker tjänsten

För att söka tjänsten, scrolla ner till ansökningsformuläret nedan. Om du har några frågor eller funderingar, vänligen kontakta oss via e-post på bemanning.vetlanda@lernia.se. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Bakgrundskontroll

För vissa tjänster ingår bakgrundskontroll som en del av rekryteringsprocessen. Om du går vidare i processen kommer du att behöva verifiera din identitet via BankID innan kontrollen genomförs.

title: Deputy Program Manager – Program Operations (iWork)
description:
Who we are

SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia is an International Non-governmental organization and a member of SOS Children’s Villages International Federation. We started our humanitarian work in Ethiopia with the opening of our first Village in Mekelle, Northern part of Ethiopia in 1974. Since then, we have expanded our programs to different regions where there are significant needs for intervention and where we believe we can work in partnership with all relevant actors to bring sustainable positive outcomes for children’s and young people.

Today, we have grown significantly to meet the persistent challenges that confront Ethiopian children who have lost parental care and those that are at risk of losing their parental care. Working in close collaboration with international donors, local government and community-based organizations across eight program locations; we aspire that every child grows up with love, respect and security.

Want to know more about life at SOS?

🌟 Explore our Employee Value Proposition Here

👉 Follow our journey on LinkedIn

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

At SOS Children's Villages, safeguarding isn't just a policy, it's a foundational value embedded in everything we do. We are unwavering in our commitment to protecting the children, young people, adults, and communities we serve, as well as our workforce and resources.

We cultivate an environment of trust and accountability where every voice is heard and respected. All successful candidates will be expected to champion our holistic safeguarding principles, actively upholding our Child & Youth Safeguarding Policy, Code of Conduct, and regulations against sexual misconduct, fraud, and corruption.

By joining our team, you commit to integrating these vital standards into your work, ensuring the highest levels of safety, ethics, and integrity in every action and partnership.

Together, we create a world where everyone feels safe, respected, and protected

Join Our Mission:

We are looking for a Deputy Program Manager – Program Operations to work under the supervision of the Program Manager. This position drives operational leadership for the iWork Programme across all locations, overseeing programme implementation, supervising Cluster Coordinators, ensuring consistent standards, and supporting the timely achievement of programme targets.

Serving as the operational bridge between national programme management and field implementation, ensuring harmonized delivery across locations while upholding donor compliance, organizational policies, safeguarding standards, and quality assurance frameworks.

The Deputy Program Manager enables adaptive programme management through ongoing monitoring of implementation progress, technical backstopping, operational problem‑solving, and strengthening collaboration across programme teams and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Programme Operations Coordination

  • Coordinate day-to-day implementation of programme activities across all programme locations.
  • Translate annual operational plans into coordinated implementation schedules.
  • Monitor implementation progress across clusters and ensure timely achievement of programme milestones.
  • Ensure consistency in programme implementation approaches across locations.
  • Coordinate operational planning meetings with Cluster Coordinators.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support rollout of new programme initiatives and operational procedures.

Technical Supervision of Programme Implementation

  • Provide technical guidance to Cluster Coordinators throughout programme implementation.
  • Ensure programme activities comply with approved implementation guidelines and SOPs.
  • Support quality implementation of all programme pillars.
  • Review implementation plans and provide technical feedback.
  • Ensure consistent interpretation of programme standards.
  • Conduct regular technical support visits to programme locations.

Operational Performance Management

  • Track programme implementation against annual targets.
  • Develop operational dashboards and implementation tracking systems.
  • Review monthly implementation reports from programme locations.
  • Monitor performance indicators and identify implementation gaps.
  • Coordinate implementation review meetings.
  • Recommend corrective actions for underperforming programme areas.

Quality Assurance

  • Ensure implementation complies with programme quality standards.
  • Coordinate programme quality assurance visits.
  • Monitor adherence to approved Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Verify quality of internship implementation.
  • Ensure standardized documentation across programme locations.
  • Promote continuous quality improvement initiatives.

Workforce Development Operations

  • Coordinate implementation of participant recruitment and selection processes.
  • Ensure harmonized beneficiary targeting across clusters.
  • Monitor implementation of life skills and employability training.
  • Review participant enrolment and completion rates.
  • Coordinate participant transition tracking.
  • Support implementation of inclusive youth participation strategies.

Internship Operations and Host Institution Management

  • Coordinate internship placement processes across programme locations.
  • Monitor availability of internship opportunities.
  • Review host institution performance.
  • Ensure compliance with internship standards.
  • Support resolution of operational issues affecting internship placements.
  • Coordinate improvement of host institution engagement mechanisms.

Partnership and Operational Coordination

  • Support coordination with national government institutions.
  • Facilitate collaboration among programme partners.
  • Coordinate operational engagement with TVET institutions and employers.
  • Support organization of programme events, job fairs and stakeholder meetings.
  • Strengthen communication between programme locations.

Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL)

  • Coordinate programme performance monitoring.
  • Ensure timely submission of programme reports.
  • Review data quality across programme locations.
  • Support implementation of evaluations and assessments.
  • Coordinate learning and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Promote evidence-based programme improvement.

Financial and Operational Compliance

  • Monitor implementation against approved operational budgets.
  • Review operational expenditure trends.
  • Ensure compliance with procurement and financial procedures.
  • Support budget forecasting and resource planning.
  • Monitor efficient utilization of programme resources.
  • Coordinate operational compliance reviews.

Safeguarding, Gender Equality and Inclusion

  • Ensure safeguarding standards are consistently implemented across all programme locations.
  • Monitor implementation of Gender Equality and Social Inclusion commitments.
  • Support safeguarding capacity-building for programme teams.
  • Review safeguarding compliance reports.
  • Ensure timely reporting of safeguarding concerns.
  • Promote safe and inclusive programme implementation.

Staff Supervision and Capacity Development

  • Provide functional supervision to Cluster Coordinators.
  • Conduct regular coaching and mentoring sessions.
  • Review cluster performance against agreed objectives.
  • Identify staff capacity gaps.
  • Coordinate technical capacity development activities.
  • Promote teamwork and cross-location learning.
  • Support performance appraisal processes.

Risk Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor operational risks affecting programme implementation.
  • Coordinate implementation of mitigation measures.
  • Document lessons learned and good practices.
  • Recommend operational improvements.
  • Support innovation and adaptive programme management.
  • Ensure business continuity during implementation challenges.

Our Ideal Candidate?

Let's find out if we're a match. The next step in our process depends on how your background closely align with the below criteria’s.

Essential Requirements (Must-Have):

Education:

  • Master’s degree in project management, Development Studies, Economics, Business Administration, Sociology, Social Work, Education, Labour Studies, or related fields

Experience:

  • Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience in youth employment, workforce development, internship programs, TVET, livelihoods, private sector engagement, or economic empowerment programs out of whcih 4 years in programme management or operational leadership roles.

  • Experience supervising multi-location programme implementation.

  • Experience managing donor-funded programs.

  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary programme teams.

Role Specific Competencies:

  • Programme Operations Management
  • Project Cycle Management (PCM)
  • Youth Employment and Workforce Development
  • Internship Programme Management
  • Operational Planning and Coordination
  • Performance Monitoring and Quality Assurance
  • Partnership and Stakeholder Management
  • Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning
  • Financial and Budget Management
  • Risk Management
  • Safeguarding and Child Protection
  • Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI)
  • Leadership and Team Development
  • Report Writing and Documentation
  • Digital Programme Management Systems

Desired Assets (Nice-to-Have):

  • Experience with Mastercard Foundation-funded programs.
  • Experience managing national programs implemented across multiple regions.
  • Experience leading operational quality assurance systems.
  • Experience in adaptive programme management.
  • Experience using digital programme management and beneficiary information systems.

SOS Lead and Core Competencies

Lead Competency

  • Role model: Act as a role model for the organization, living our values and inspiring and learning from others
  • Collaboration: Remove barriers to participation, share decision making and build partnerships
  • Empowerment: Promote inclusion and equitable sharing of power
  • Strategic Thinking: Live the values and mission, setting realistic goals and translating them into actionable plans

Core Competency

  • Kindness: Act with empathy towards everyone he/she works with.
  • Continuous Learning: Make an effort to learn, understand and grow as a person, admitting your own mistakes.
  • Inclusiveness: In any actions show respect and care for others.
  • Initiative: speak up when things are not right, do not hesitate to act, and adapt to change when necessary.
  • Results Orientation: look for solutions and focus on desired results.

Does This Sound Like You?

To apply, please submit your updated resume via SOS Children's Villages Application portal (ICIMS)

We actively champion diversity and inclusion and strongly encourage women to step forward and apply. As part of our unwavering commitment to holistic safeguarding protecting children, youth, adults, and assets our selection process emphasizes value alignment and includes thorough background checks for all potential hires.

SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia is an equal opportunity employer, providing fair consideration to all applicant regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, ancestry, national origin, age, disability, marital status, or class.

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: Tripledot Games

About Tripledot Games

Tripledot Games is a leading developer and publisher of casual and puzzle games, with a strong presence in London, Warsaw, and Barcelona. The studio is responsible for multiple top 10 titles, including Woodoku, Woodoku Blast, Solitaire, and TripleTile. Our best-in-class data-driven approach spans the entire lifecycle from publishing to machine learning puzzle levels, helping us make fast, smart decisions at every stage of development.

We are also one of the largest IAA operators worldwide. Tripledot Games is a diverse and collaborative studio, home to people from over 36 nationalities. We take pride in our craftsmanship, strong focus on outcomes, and continuous improvement, building high-quality, scalable games that players around the world love.

Role Overview

This role offers the exciting opportunity to lead high-impact projects. With extensive data at your disposal and a culture that champions experimentation, you’re encouraged to bring complex statistical methods to the forefront of our business operations.

You will be working closely with the Product and Monetisation teams to deliver insights that shape key business strategies.

You’ll also be deeply involved in developing and enhancing our internal A/B testing frameworks, while also consulting with the Product Team to optimise their experimental approaches.

You’ll have autonomy and the unique chance to craft the tools you use, such as developing bespoke web applications via Streamlit.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with the Product/Monetisation teams to deliver insights that drive business decisions.
  • Promote a hypothesis-driven insights culture. Ensure that key learnings are captured from new feature and content releases; consult on A/B test setup and analysis, as well as appropriate statistical methods (e.g. sample size estimation, handling pre-allocation bias).
  • Design and build internal self-service experimentation and analytics tooling.
  • Work with data engineers to ensure proper dimensions and metrics are incorporated into our pipelines. Develop a thorough understanding of relevant internal and external data sources.
  • Collaborate with other data scientists to develop and promote best practices in analytics and experimentation across the company

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • A Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative subject or equivalent experience.
  • Typically 2-5 years relevant work experience.
  • Experience articulating product questions, identifying and querying big datasets (SQL) and using statistics to arrive at an answer.
  • A comprehensive understanding of statistics (e.g. hypothesis testing, sampling, probability distributions) and experience in applying these concepts in real-life problems.
  • Experience programming using python or R.
  • AB testing experience, preferably in an online context.
  • Excellent communication skills to understand business needs of cross-functional stakeholders, deliver findings and recommendations, as well as to drive collaboration.
  • Ability to own analytics work from formulation of hypotheses to communicating actionable insights.

Working at Tripledot

  • Hybrid Working
  • 20 days of remote working: Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year.
  • Regular company events and rewards: Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements, and our team spirit.
  • Breakfast & Lunch: Relish daily breakfast and lunch provided in the office to keep you fueled and focused.
  • BPJS HEALTH: Elevate your well-being and peace of mind, ensuring robust health security with seamless enrolment in BPJS Health.
  • BPJS SOCIAL: Secure your employment rights with BPJS Social.
  • Festivity Allowance: Celebrate festive occasions with an additional festive allowance.
  • Private Health Insurance: Stay covered with comprehensive health insurance for you and your loved ones.
  • Employee Assistance Program: Anytime you need it, tap into confidential, caring support with our Employee Assistance Program, always here to lend an ear and a helping hand.
  • Family Forming Support: Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program [subject to policy]
  • English Classes: Enhance your English skills with our provided English classes

title: Energy Analyst (Open to all applicants)
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

Office/Unit/Project Description

UNDP is committed to achieving workforce diversity across gender, nationality, and culture. Individuals from minority groups, indigenous groups and persons with disabilities are equally encouraged to apply. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence.

UNDP does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of harassment, including sexual harassment, and discrimination. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks.

UNDP is the leading United Nations organisation in fighting to end the injustice of poverty, inequality, and climate change. Working with our broad network of experts and partners build integrated, lasting solutions for people and the planet. Learn more at undp.org or follow at @UNDP.

Project background

The European Union Delegation (EUD) in Lesotho, in partnership with the Government of Lesotho, is implementing the Renewable Lesotho programme aimed at contributing to a green and resilient economy by promoting energy security, access to reliable and affordable clean energy, and growth. The Renewable Lesotho aims to increase renewable energy generation capacity and energy efficiency, promote a more equitable and gender-transformative access to clean energy, and improve Lesotho’s energy sector leadership and institutional capacity. This will be achieved through the implementation of the following programme components:

  • Component 1: Market preparation through provision of technical assistance and mobilisation of private investments in renewable energies.
  • Component 2: Granting Facility to provide results-based financing for off-grid energy solutions.
  • Component 3: Lending Facility to provide financial support to project development.

The EUD is collaborating with different development partners to implement the mentioned progamme components. Component 2 of the Renewable Lesotho programme will be implemented by UNDP in partnership with the Ministry responsible for energy. This component has a specific objective aiming at promoting a more equitable and gender-transformative access to clean energy to be achieved through the following four outputs:

  • Output 2.1: Establishment and operationalisation of the Results-Based Finance (RBF) funding mechanism.
  • Output 2.2: Improved energy access window providing energy-efficient solutions for households.
  • Output 2.3: Establishment of an energy application window to provide public service, commercial, and industrial facilities with renewable energy and energy efficiency solutions.
  • Output 2.4: Effective and efficient programme management.

In light of the above, UNDP requires the services of the Energy Analyst to form part of the Result-Based Financing (RBF) funding facility management team responsible for the successful implementation of the facility.

Duties and Responsibilities

Coordinate effective project planning and implementation.

  • Provide technical input into the project planning process and ensure the work plan and a fully costed budget are prepared based on sound capacity assessments and in accordance with UNDP POPP/PPM Guidelines. Support coordination/management of the day-to-day activities of the assigned portfolio and the overall implementation process, including planning and monitoring, in order to optimise the use of resources and to ensure the successful achievement of project objectives and results specified in the project document. Provide subject matter technical advice and support and ensure outputs are delivered on time, within the set budget and specified constraints, and to high-quality standards;
  • Support RBF management with implementation activities to ensure alignment with UNDP policy and programme management procedures and all project interventions integrate a gender equality perspective/gender equality mainstreaming to the extent local context allows;
  • Facilitate participatory engagement of stakeholders on project-related activities and priorities.

Establish partnerships and open channels of communication.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships and strategic linkages with implementing and development partners, government officials, businesses, NGOs, other national stakeholders, and beneficiaries to support key objectives and ensure inclusive implementation and participation of key stakeholders in the assigned portfolio;
  • Develop and maintain stakeholder mapping and analysis to identify stakeholder needs and how best to leverage their participation and/or strengthen their engagement. Prepare substantive briefs on potential areas of cooperation and joint initiatives. Make recommendations to the management team on activities with potential for scale-up, replicability and synergies;
  • Provide technical support to the implementing partners and act as a liaison between UNDP and the partners;
  • Support resource mobilisation efforts and project development;
  • Act as a liaison between stakeholders from various institutions, including line Ministries, the private sector, NGOs and academia;
  • Identify opportunities for synergies with other developmental activities/projects currently ongoing and clearly highlight the areas for collaboration.

Monitor and report on progress in implementing project activities and in achieving the set targets.

  • Support implementation of M&E for RBF, including the development of clear strategies and an effective system for data collection, means of verification, and information sharing and reporting;
  • Monitor implementation and progress in achieving goals and targets in accordance with the established quality criteria and UNDP rules, regulations, and standards. Identify, analyse, and take adequate measures to manage emerging issues, problems, and risks. Conduct verification of set milestones for RBF facility-supported activities and field visits to project location sites;
  • Provide input to management and technical reports and support preparation of corporate, donor and government reports in line with the reporting schedule and UNDP and EU requirements;
  • Keep a record of all interactions conducted with various stakeholders and provide a summary report to the RBF manager on a monthly basis.

title: Coördinator Duurzaamheid
description:
Kom jij duurzame impact maken? Bevlogenheid is ook een vak.

Wil jij jouw steentje bijdragen aan het realiseren en borgen van onze duurzaamheidsambities en heb jij meerdere jaren ervaring in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van duurzaamheidsplannen? Solliciteer dan snel als Coördinator Duurzaamheid!

Bij Gilde Opleidingen zetten we ons in voor het ontwikkelen van vakmensen met een stevige basis voor de toekomst. Samen met ruim 1.100 bevlogen collega’s, ieder vanuit hun eigen vakgebied, werken we dagelijks aan deze missie. Iedere collega, of je nu docent of instructeur bent, loopbaanadviseur, conciërge of stafmedewerker, vormt daarin een onmisbare schakel: dankzij jouw bijdrage maken we het verschil voor studenten, werknemers en werkgevers in de regio.

Wil je meer weten over Gilde Opleidingen? Bekijk hier wat het echte werk voor ons betekent!

Als Coördinator Duurzaamheid draag je bij aan het realiseren en borgen van onze duurzaamheidsambities. Vanuit de Whole School Approach werk je aan de integratie van duurzaamheid in beleid, organisatie, cultuur en gedrag. Je werkt nauw samen met een andere Coördinator Duurzaamheid. Waar deze zich richt op de verankering binnen het onderwijs, ligt jouw focus meer op de organisatie en het beleid binnen Gilde Opleidingen. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat duurzaamheid zichtbaar en structureel onderdeel wordt van alles wat we doen.

Jij wordt blij van:

  • Ontwikkelen en implementeren van een meerjarig professionaliseringsplan gericht op duurzaamheid.

  • Vertalen van de duurzaamheidsvisie naar tactisch en operationeel beleid.

  • Ontwikkelen van structurele vormen van studentparticipatie rondom duurzaamheid.

  • Ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van een communicatieplan rondom duurzaamheid en circulariteit; gericht op vergroten bewustwording en gedragsverandering.

  • Overbrengen van complexe duurzaamheidsvraagstukken op een begrijpelijke en inspirerende manier.

  • Het samenbrengen en creëren van draagvlak voor veranderingen.

  • Overzien van ontwikkelingen op het gebied van duurzaamheid en het vertalen van deze naar concrete kansen en acties voor de organisatie.

Ruim­den­kend, spontaan en bevlogen?

Dan ben jij de vak­idi­oot die wij zoeken! Verder voldoe je aan het volgende:

  • Minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld richting organisatieontwikkeling, communicatie, HRM, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.

  • Meerdere jaren werkervaring met duurzaamheidsvraagstukken en/of veranderprocessen binnen een organisatie.

  • Ervaring met beleidsontwikkeling, projectmatig werken en het realiseren van organisatie brede verbeteringen.

  • Ervaring binnen het onderwijs of een complexe organisatie is een pré.

Jij maakt van elke dag een feestje:

Maar, dit doe je na­tuur­lijk niet alleen! Samen met jouw collega’s op onze locatie in Roermond, werk je elke dag aan de toekomst van de stu­den­ten én van jezelf. Met jou erbij bestaat dit creatieve en bevlogen team van uit 2 personen. Naast hard werken is er ook tijd voor ont­span­ning en ge­zel­lig­heid. Kom jij dit enthousiaste team versterken?

Voor dit alles, bieden wij jou:

  • Het salaris is ingedeeld in schaal 11, minimaal € 4.226,- en maximaal €6.210,- bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime contract. Dit vullen we aan met 8% vakantietoeslag en een 13e maand (de hoogte hiervan is afhankelijk van je startdatum).

  • Een contract op basis van 0,6 fte voor de duur van in eerste instantie een jaar, met de intentie hierna te verlengen.

  • Voldoende vakantiedagen om optimaal te genieten van je vrije tijd.

  • Belastingvoordeel (FiscFree). Jouw fitnessabonnement of nieuwe fiets wordt een stuk goedkoper en je thuiswerkplek krijgt een mooie bureaustoel!

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding en fijne werklocaties die eenvoudig te bereiken zijn met het openbaar vervoer.

  • Groeimogelijkheden. Door het volgen van (online) trainingen via GO!cademy en GoodHabitz staat jouw ontwikkeling nooit stil.

  • Een telefoon en een laptop.

  • Samen werken aan jouw toekomst – nu én later. Daarom nemen wij 70% van jouw pensioenpremie voor onze rekening.

  • Als kers op de taart kun je op jouw locatie elke week van gratis vers fruit genieten.

Heb je vragen?
Nieuwsgierig geworden? Wij vertellen je er graag meer over! Neem contact op met Guusje Toemen, Coördinator Duurzaamheid, via 06 10 83 62 09. In verband met de zo­mer­va­kan­tie is het alleen mogelijk om via Whatsapp contact op te nemen.

Kom meewerken!
Ben jij de Coördinator Duurzaamheid die we zoeken? Solliciteer dan uiterlijk zondag 30 augustus 2026.


We houden je op de hoogte

Zodra je gesolliciteerd hebt, houden we je op de hoogte. De eerste gesprekken staan gepland op woensdag 16 september 2026.

title: Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT Partner Platform
description:
LocationOur Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT PartnerOps will be an integral part of our Product Management team. This role is based remotely in the East US, Canada, the UK or Ireland.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity
We’re hiring a Principal Technical Product Owner to drive the strategy, rapid delivery, and iteration for the DoiT Partner Platform. This platform enables cloud partners, resellers, and service providers to operate, monetize, and scale their cloud businesses across major hyperscalers. The platform is designed to help partners manage the operational and financial complexity of the cloud ecosystem, including cloud billing, margin management, customer lifecycle workflows, and partner-led service delivery.

This senior role is built for a leader with a "technical founder" mindset. You will act as the tip of the spear for all DoiT Partner Platform initiatives, serving as a leader amongst the product team to guide the broader product vision and set the standard for execution. You will bring relentless curiosity about how the cloud ecosystem works, a deep understanding of hyperscaler partner programs, and the confidence to test ideas directly with domain experts. The right leader will have held hands-on roles within the cloud ecosystem—such as cloud operations, cloud billing / FinOps, or partner operations—and will bring direct experience working with channel business models. In addition to hands-on execution, you will help direct strategy, align cross-functional teams, and mentor other technical product owners across the organization.

Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Delivery

  • Act as the "tip of the spear" for the DoiT Partner Platform: Serve as the foremost product authority and a leader amongst peers, driving alignment across multiple product squads and setting the bar for product excellence.
  • Own the overarching strategy, delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for major platform components.
  • Partner with VP-level leadership to define strategic direction, translating it into clear problems to solve and shippable scope.
  • Direct and mentor other Technical Product Owners to elevate product management practices, ensuring cohesive execution across the entire platform portfolio.
  • Drive the feedback loop across teams: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
  • Review technical designs, reason about complex tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer.

Deep Partner & Ecosystem Understanding

  • Leverage your hands-on experience within the cloud ecosystem and understanding of channel, reseller, and partner business models.
  • Develop deep empathy for the workflows of cloud partners: billing operations, margin management, reseller customer management, support operations, and service delivery.
  • Use direct partner conversations and operational insight to identify friction, gaps, and strategic opportunities to improve how partners run their cloud businesses.

Cloud Billing & Partner Operations Expertise

  • Bring strong understanding of cloud billing constructs, marketplace programs, margin models, and partner incentives across hyperscalers.
  • Help shape complex platform capabilities that manage or abstract complexity in areas such as:
    • Multi-cloud billing aggregation.
    • Partner margin and discount models.
    • Customer invoicing and revenue operations.
    • Usage and cost transparency.
    • Marketplace and private offer workflows.

Executive & Partner Validation

  • Speak frequently with key partners (aiming for 3–5 conversations a week) and internal stakeholders to validate ideas, refine workflows, and test assumptions.
  • Engage deeply with executive stakeholders at cloud partners, MSPs, SIs, and resellers to understand how they operate their cloud businesses.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into strategic decisions, and explain "why" in a way that builds trust and consensus among peers and leadership.

Engineering-Embedded Technical Product Ownership

  • Operate as a core leader working closely with Engineering leaders—present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
  • Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning—ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
  • Ensure components are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior, supporting partner-grade reliability and scalability.

Quality, Outcomes, Trust & Governance

  • Define what “success” means for the platform portfolio with clear metrics (partner adoption, onboarding speed, billing accuracy, workflow completion, retention, reliability signals, partner-reported impact).
  • Instrument learning: ensure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into portfolio prioritization.
  • Ensure platform capabilities account for the operational realities of the cloud partner ecosystem, including billing accuracy, financial reconciliation, and auditability.

Qualifications

  • Extensive product leadership experience with 10+ years of direct experience in the cloud ecosystem, ideally across roles such as cloud operations, FinOps, partner operations, or building platforms that serve cloud customers or partners.
  • Proven ability to act as a "player-coach"—driving high-level strategy, executing hands-on alongside engineering, and directing/mentoring other product owners as a respected peer leader.
  • Strong experience with cloud billing systems, cost and usage data, or revenue operations within cloud environments.
  • Deep understanding of the cloud partner ecosystem (resellers, MSPs, SIs, distributors, marketplaces). Candidates have likely worked within the partner ecosystem at some point in their careers.
  • Experience building or operating platforms that serve channel or partner-driven business models.
  • Strong product sense for turning messy operational problems into clear scope and shipped value with an excellent user experience.
  • Technical fluency in cloud fundamentals and APIs across AWS, Google Cloud, and/or Azure.
  • Coding experience is a plus—enough to collaborate effectively with engineers, reason about feasibility, and understand system behaviors.
  • Must have demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate product specifications and development.
  • Excellent communication skills: ability to engage deeply with partners, cloud experts, and internal stakeholders at the executive level.
  • A bias for action and continuous improvement: you ship, measure, learn, and iterate.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • You are universally recognized by your peers and leadership as the driving force and primary authority ("tip of the spear") for the Partner Platform's product direction.
  • Platform capabilities ship frequently with clear partner value.
  • Partner feedback loops are strong and visibly influence the overarching roadmap.
  • Adoption across the partner ecosystem increases and partner operational workflows improve measurably.
  • Billing accuracy, financial transparency, and operational scalability improve for partners using the platform.
  • Engineering teams consistently have clarity on the next most valuable increment to build—and why.
  • Other product owners on the team are effectively mentored, aligned, and elevated through your leadership.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

title: CISO
description:
TL;DR: We're looking for an exceptional security leader and executive to build and run the function that will make Lovable the most trusted AI-powered software creation platform

Why Lovable?

Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works.
