title: Portfolio PMO Co-ordinator
description:
Job Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for a Project Coordinator to join our Portfolios Programme Management Office (PPMO) team. This role will support project and programme governance across global portfolios, ensuring projects follow the Product Lifecycle Process (PLP) and are delivered in line with established standards and business practices.

Working closely with project managers, programme managers, product managers, and key stakeholders, you will play an important role in supporting reporting, documentation, administration, project controls, and continuous improvement activities across the business.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Support project and programme teams in the application of the Product Lifecycle Process (PLP) across global portfolios.
  • Assist with project governance activities by monitoring project/programme progress, reporting, milestones, finances, and key deliverables.
  • Support global programme reporting cycles, reviews, and communications to ensure timely and accurate reporting.
  • Coordinate PLP Gate Review Triage activities and arrange review meetings in accordance with PPMO work instructions.
  • Maintain and support the Portfolio of Record (PoR), including project/programme financials, milestones, progress updates, and issue resolution tracking.
  • Provide support to Project Offices and Project Controllers/Coordinators throughout the project lifecycle, from initiation through to close-out.
  • Manage the PPMO mailbox and ensure stakeholder requests are acknowledged and supported within agreed timelines.
  • Coordinate and maintain the PPMO calendar, meeting schedules, invitations, distribution lists, and attendance tracking.
  • Complete routine administrative activities including raising purchase requisitions, maintaining registers, preparing meeting materials, capturing meeting minutes, and updating documentation.
  • Create and maintain reports, presentations, training materials, and communications to support the PPMO team.
  • Maintain document repositories and stakeholder matrices, ensuring information remains accurate and up to date.
  • Support continuous improvement and change management initiatives under the guidance of the Technology Programmes Operational Excellence Director and PPMO team.
  • Promote the consistent application of standardised project controls and PLP processes across the business.

What You'll Bring

  • 2–4 years of experience in a Project Coordinator, PMO, Project Administration, Project Controls, or similar project support role.
  • HNC qualification or equivalent in a relevant discipline such as Business, Project Management, Technology, or Engineering.
  • Understanding of cost management, data management, and reporting methodologies.
  • Awareness of planning methodologies, project controls, and earned value management concepts.
  • Strong administrative experience supporting stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
  • Good experience with MS SharePoint Lists.
  • Strong organisational skills with a focus on completing tasks and delivering results.
  • Exposure to project planning, cost control, risk management, and change management within a project environment.
  • Awareness of forecasting, estimating, scheduling, and resource management principles.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build effective working relationships.
  • Ability to produce clear and concise meeting minutes and project documentation.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with an understanding of how data supports decision-making.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, matrix environment.
  • English language proficiency at C1 level (verbal and written).

Nice to Have

  • Awareness of data science and business intelligence technologies.
  • Exposure to continuous improvement initiatives and change management activities.
  • Understanding of product development, including product introduction, enhancement, and sustaining activities.
  • Appreciation of complex integrated technology-based sensor systems.
  • Knowledge of critical path analysis, risk tracking, corrective action planning, and project reporting practices.

We offer…

Join us and we’ll help build your career, with excellent training and opportunities for career growth across the business, both locally and globally. You’ll experience an inclusive environment, with strong leadership and a focus on safety and wellbeing. You’ll also have the flexibility to choose from a wide range of benefits to suit your lifestyle, offering you and your family support from a health and wellbeing, financial and lifestyle perspective.

Join us and work for a world-leader, with the benefits and training to reward your dedication and skills. Be part of a team where we are making the world a safer place.

We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity.

title: Software Engineer (Python, React, TypeScript)
description:
About Cargobase

Cargobase is changing how enterprise shippers like Bosch, Reckitt Benckiser, Goodyear, and Textron, along with logistics providers like DHL, DSV, and FedEx, run spot-buy freight. This is a multi-billion dollar corner of logistics, and we're bringing the whole process online: quoting, tracking, invoice audit, and data insights.


Role Overview

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on full-stack engineer who loves shipping across the stack and working AI-natively. You'll be a core builder on our small, high-trust team, helping us build agentic AI right into the product. You'll write the features our enterprise customers rely on and help set the technical bar for how we build and review code.


Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Ownership & Execution

  • Ship meaningful full-stack features end to end, from design through to production, spanning both the UI and the services behind it.
  • Bring agentic AI into the product (for instance, extracting structured data from unstructured sources like emails and documents) and help figure out where AI genuinely makes the experience better.
  • Keep the codebase healthy through pragmatic architecture, sensible data modeling across relational and NoSQL stores, and a steady habit of tackling tech debt.


2. Process & Operational Excellence

  • Work AI-natively by using agentic coding tools like Cursor or Claude Code fluently, applying them with smart, context-aware judgment rather than brute force.
  • Help shape the engineering practices and standards that keep us shipping quickly and reliably.


3. Internal & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Level up the whole team through thoughtful, high-quality code reviews, setting the bar for how we build and review.
  • Work closely with teammates and partners across Product and QA, turning real customer needs into solid technical solutions.


Requirements

We're looking for someone who is:

  • You have over 5 years of experience shipping production software as a full-stack engineer, with a genuine balance between frontend and backend work.
  • On the frontend, you're strong with React and TypeScript, with enough depth to guide and review frontend work effectively.
  • On the backend, you're strong with Python and have experience with Django, FastAPI, or Flask.
  • You're comfortable with data modeling across both relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Working with Docker and in containerized environments like Kubernetes feels like second nature to you.
  • You already work AI-natively, or you have a clear enthusiasm and fluency for that way of working.


Nice to have:

  • It's a bonus if you've built agentic or LLM features into a product: things like RAG, vector search, structured extraction, or agent tool-calling, even if just through side projects.
  • Experience with AWS (especially EKS), CI/CD ownership, and observability tools is definitely a plus.
  • A background in enterprise B2B SaaS is great, especially if it's in logistics or supply chain.


Our Stack:

We use Python (Django, FastAPI, Flask), React, and TypeScript. Our data lives in relational and NoSQL databases, and we run on Docker and AWS (EKS) with solid CI/CD. We also love AI-native tools like Cursor and Claude Code.


What We Offer

  • Exposure to global enterprise customers across Europe and North America
  • Hybrid working environment
  • Competitive salary with performance incentives
  • Friendly and international work environment
  • Service Leave
  • Health Insurance
  • 21 days of annual leave
  • Flexi Benefit

title: Head of North Island
description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.


About the role

We are searching for an elite growth leader, ready to play the game of their career. You will be leading a passionate and highly motivated team of over 30 reps across the North Island to a scale that very few businesses ever achieve, whilst having an impact on one of New Zealand’s most vital industries, Agriculture.

Leading the North Island, you will be covering the full customer cycle from new sales through to Account Management. We’re looking for someone with commercial nous, X-factor, charisma, highly competitive yet technically strong as a sales leader… and the ability to hit a target nobody can yet see possible. This is a rare opportunity to play a pivotal role in leading the region's growth past the hundreds of millions of ARR. Roles of this scale, in a hyper-growth business, simply don’t come around often. Could be a bit of you?

You’ll be excited by exponential growth, and feel right at home leading on ambitious strategies. When the pressure is on in the biggest moments, you’ll be someone who wants to be in the game. You might find yourself juggling time on farm with customers, coaching and developing your team, through to driving growth strategy and cross-functional priorities within Halter. You’ll be masterful at building trusting relationships, driving sales processes, managing large pipelines and enabling a team, whilst advocating for customers with a solutions-oriented mindset.

Aside from jumping on the Halter roller coaster, you will be making a real world impact, making farming more productive and sustainable. You will build relationships across New Zealand's most influential farming leaders, who also happen to be some of the most down to earth, genuine humans you will ever meet. This is a high-stakes role, spearheading Halter’s growth in the North Island.


Who we are looking for

  • Someone who doesn’t believe in glass ceilings and walks towards the pressure of large targets and thrives on hard problems.

  • Experience in growing new and existing businesses, developing market strategies and more importantly, a track record of delivering high growth.

  • Experience working with customers, navigating complex sales cycles and expanding value over time.

  • Strong ability to work cross-functionally and lead teams.

  • A deep passion for helping farmers succeed. Experience in farm systems or within the agricultural sector would be a bonus.

  • A phenomenal attitude and a team player with the ability to consistently overcome challenges.

  • The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy.

  • A hunger for success and personal growth to be able to evolve quickly alongside a world-class sales team.


What your day could look like

  • Sales Leadership: Lead sales strategy, setting headcount requirements, regions and working closely with Halter leaders to form targets before laying that out to your team into an inspiring vision.

  • Manage your team’s inputs on a week to week basis, set the team’s cadence, set and track KPI’s and develop excellent pipeline hygiene.

  • Coach and develop your team to become better every week. Adapt Halter’s existing processes to develop and implement training programs for the North Island team, ensuring continuous skill enhancement and alignment with company objectives. Foster a culture of knowledge sharing and collaboration within the sales organisation.

  • Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop the North Island team. Set clear performance expectations, KPIs and provide regular feedback. Lead on hiring and performance management. Foster a positive and collaborative team culture that promotes vulnerability and learning.

  • Account Management: Ensure a seamless and positive customer experience across the entire customer lifecycle. Monitor customer satisfaction levels and implement improvement initiatives continuously. Work closely with the Account Management team to resolve any issues and ensure customer retention and expansion. Work in lock step with the Launch, Support and Product functions to ensure tight collaboration across every customer touchpoint.

  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement a comprehensive regional strategy to expand our market presence and achieve growth objectives. Identify new market opportunities and drive initiatives to increase market share. Collaborate closely with leaders across Halter to align on goals and objectives.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with senior leaders, and product and support teams to ensure exceptional results for the North Island region.

  • Networking: Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand.

Our Benefits

  • Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

  • We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

  • Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

  • Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

title: DevSecOps Full Stack Engineer
description:

This role is responsible to leverage AI/ML wherever feasible to build intelligent automation into security tooling, including vulnerability triage, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and self-service security workflows, while embedding security best practices across the SDLC.

title: Pædagogmedhjælpere - vikarer
description:
Boenheden Delfinen søger vikarer

Delfinen er en mindre boenhed med beliggenhed på Feriecenter Slettestrand – omgivet af smuk natur og med højt til loftet både fysisk og menneskeligt.

Hos os bor 11 voksne med nedsat funktionsevne. Vores opgave er at skabe trygge rammer, meningsfulde fællesskaber og understøtte livskvalitet samt, at støtte den enkelte beboer i at realisere ønsker, drømme og et godt hverdagsliv.

Beboerne er alle mobile; nogle er selvhjulpne, mens andre har behov for støtte og guidning i forhold til personlig pleje og daglige opgaver. De fleste har dagbeskæftigelse på feriecentret.

Om jobbet

Vi søger vikarer, som kan træde til ved ferie og sygdom – ofte med kort varsel. Du bliver en del af en engageret personalegruppe, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om beboernes trivsel.

Arbejdsdagen er varieret og kræver overblik, fleksibilitet og en god fysik. Du vil indgå i en hverdag med både praktiske opgaver, relationelt arbejde og aktiviteter med beboerne.

Vi søger dig, som:

  • arbejder anerkendende og relationsorienteret

  • har lyst til en aktiv hverdag (fx vandreture, cykling og svømning)

  • er indstillet på at hjælpe med personlig pleje og medicinhåndtering

  • trives med skiftende arbejdstider

  • har kørekort (B)

Vi tilbyder:

  • et meningsfuldt job med stor menneskelig værdi

  • en arbejdsplads i naturskønne omgivelser

  • engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • nærværende og tilgængelig ledelse

Vores tilgang

Vi arbejder ud fra KRAP og en mentaliserende tilgang samt Feriecenter Slettestrands vision om, at alle har ret til at føle sig velkomne – uanset forudsætninger.

Kunne dette være noget for dig, så send en kort ansøgning vedlagt CV til Jeannette Fischer på jfn@slettestrand.dk. Du er også velkommen til at kontakte mig på tlf.: 66447974 på hverdage mellem kl.10 og kl. 14. Sidste frist for ansøgning er d. 12/8-2026. Samtaler afholdes løbende.

title: Senior lösningsarkitekt
description:
För kunds räkning söker vi efter en senior lösningsarkitekt.

Kunden står inför stora tekniska förändringar inom integrationsområdet. Nya plattformar och koncept etableras, där en stor del utgörs av nya förmågor baserade på moderna IT-stöd. I detta arbete eftersöks arkitektkompetens med god kännedom om och erfarenhet från Region Skåne eller annan region och dess integrationslandskap.

De nya komponenterna är byggda på en Kubernetes-baserad driftsmiljö och inkluderar även en betydande andel egenutveckling för att sammanföra de standardprodukter som ska ersätta regionens nuvarande integrationsmiljö.

I rollen förväntas du kunna agera över hela integrationsspannet, från att förstå och omsätta verksamhetsbehov till arkitektur, design och vidare till implementering, inklusive förståelse för och förmåga att driva förändring i den underliggande infrastruktur där lösningen realiseras.

Uppdraget spänner över ett brett tekniskt område där profilen förväntas kunna inhämta behov och etablera design i samverkan med omgivande intressenter samt följa gällande processer för att säkerställa godkännande inom organisationen.

Profilen ska kunna identifiera och driva problemlösning hela vägen, både på strategisk och operativ nivå. I det dagliga arbetet finns stöd av produktägare, men ansvaret att driva lösningar hela vägen till dokumenterad implementering ligger på konsulten. Detta kan även inkludera aktivitetsplanering tillsammans med tredje part.

Som exempel kan följande aktivitet förekomma:

”Etablera plattformsövervakning av komponent X och Y tillräcklig för inledande övertag av produktionsdriftspartner.”

Obligatoriska kvalifikationer

  • Senior profil, med förmåga att självständigt identifiera behov och föreslå lösningar att implementera.
  • Mycket god arkitekturell kompetens på lösningsnivå.
  • Kunskap om informationsklassning och riskhantering enligt relevanta lagkrav, samt hur detta påverkar lösningsdesign.
  • Erfarenhet från Region Skåne eller annan större region eller landsting och dess integrationslandskap.
  • Erfarenhet av styrning, förvaltning och beslutsprocesser inom region eller landsting.
  • Erfarenhet av modern systemutveckling samt förmåga att själv implementera vid behov.
  • Förmåga att arbeta genom hela integrationslivscykeln, från behovsanalys till implementering och driftnära etablering.

Meriterande kvalifikationer

  • Erfarenhet av Ineras tjänsteutbud, ur ett tekniskt perspektiv.
  • Erfarenhet av tekniker som Kubernetes, YARP och Frends.
  • Erfarenhet av närliggande tekniker såsom GitHub, Azure och OpenShift.
  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av framgångsrika IT-satsningar inom region eller landsting.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the GTM Program Director.

Responsibility

  • Support the GTM Planning Director in operationalising the global GTM planning, including building and maintaining timelines, milestones and status trackers for key planning Projects

  • Drive Planning execution by taking primary ownership of execution-team discussions (status forums, preparing agendas and pre-reads, capturing decisions and action items, and following up with owners until closure)

  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Customer Success, Partners, Marketing, Product, Finance, HR) to ensure they are clear on deliverables, due dates and dependencies

  • Improve GTM operational velocity by designing and implementing agentic workflows and proactive AI-driven process modeling to automate routine reporting and autonomously resolve planning bottlenecks

  • Optimize technical tools and potential AI solutions to improve overall team productivity and solve complex problems

  • Organise forums, prepare agendas and pre-reads, capture decisions and action items, and follow up with owners until closure

  • Maintain Project documentation and the SSOT (single source of truth) for your workstreams, including decision logs, status dashboards, RAID (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and meeting notes

  • Build and maintain basic planning artifacts (slides, spreadsheets, dashboards) that translate complex information into simple, consumable views for GTM and Finance leaders

  • Track adherence to decision-lock dates, highlight slippage, and escalate risks or dependency issues to the GTM Planning Director for resolution

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of planning templates, checklists and ways of working based on retrospectives and feedback

  • Apply deepening functional AI expertise to deliver both routine and non-routine work with increasing autonomy


Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Project coordination, project management, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations or similar roles

  • Experience supporting GTM or planning processes (for example, territory carving, quota or capacity updates, or cross-functional Project rollouts)

  • Experience working with GTM systems and tools such as Salesforce, spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets), and work management tools

  • Experience using AI-powered tools or workflows (for example, AI copilots in spreadsheets or work management tools) in a professional setting

  • Experience coordinating global and cross-functional stakeholders, including scheduling, agenda preparation, note-taking and follow-up on action items

  • Experience building clear, concise slides and summaries for business stakeholders

  • Experience using AI for routine tasks, independently evaluating, optimising, and leveraging AI solutions to tackle more complex challenges and uplift your team's workflows

Preferred

  • Experience in B2B SaaS GTM planning or Revenue Operations, including exposure to segmentation, coverage, territory and quota or capacity planning

  • Experience with AI and analytics tools such as BI dashboards, advanced spreadsheet modeling, or AI copilots, especially for status reporting and summarization

  • Experience with project collaboration tools to track complex, cross-functional Projects

  • Experience working in a global or matrixed environment, coordinating teams across regions and time zones

  • Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and comfort working with multiple simultaneous projects and deadlines


Life at Docusign



Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

title: Technisch projectleider beweegbare bruggen
description:
Als technisch projectleider kun je bijdragen aan een veilige en optimaal functionerende spoorinfrastructuur.

Werk om trots op te zijn

Als technisch projectleider ben je het technisch geweten en de technisch coördinator van diverse onderhouds- en vernieuwingsprojecten binnen ProRail. In deze functie ligt het accent op beweegbare spoorbruggen, waar civiele techniek, werktuigbouwkundige onderdelen, bediening, besturing en elektrische installaties samenkomen. Met jouw technische kennis en ervaring vertaal je de klantvraag naar haalbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige oplossingen. Dit dient als basis voor het onder jouw regie opstellen van een maakbaar contract. Gedurende dit proces schakel je waar nodig klanten, omgevingspartijen en diverse in- en externe experts in. Realisatie van het contract vindt plaats door de geselecteerde aannemer binnen de regelgeving en passende uitvoeringskaders die jij mede hebt bepaald. Daarnaast houd jij je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het vertalen van regelgeving en klanteisen (denk aan gemeentes, NS, bewoners) door middel van het opstellen van klantspecificaties. Dit doen wij voor en/of met klanten, ingenieursbureaus en aannemers. Altijd vanuit de onderlinge samenhang van (deel)systemen, techniek en randvoorwaarden.
  • Het aansturen van ontwerpen (van ingenieursbureaus) op scope en kwaliteit en bijkomende onderzoeken, in de rol van opdrachtgever.
  • Het aanvragen en plannen van de benodigde bouwtijd ten behoeve van stremming van het treinverkeer (treinvrije periode).
  • Na gunning van een contract aan de bouwende partij, vervul jij een technisch ondersteunende rol richting de bouwmanager, die vanuit ProRail het contract in de uitvoering aanstuurt.
  • Je brengt risico’s zo vroeg mogelijk in kaart, met name op de aspecten veiligheid, betrouwbaarheid en duurzaamheid.

Jouw plek

We bieden graag ruimte aan iedereen. Daarbij zien we talent als basis en diversiteit als kracht om samen betere resultaten te behalen. Voor jou als technisch projectleider beweegbare bruggen is er plek in onze afdeling Civiele Techniek en Utilities (CT&U). De afdeling CT&U bestaande uit ongeveer 60 specialisten, waarvan zes op het gebied van beweegbare bruggen. In de afdeling wordt nauw samengewerkt om zowel projectinhoud als projectprocessen aan te scherpen. Blijven ontwikkelen en verbeteren is het uitgangspunt.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.091,- en € 7.262,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week, schaal 9.
  • Daarbovenop 13,61% van jouw bruto salaris in de vorm van een Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Dit budget is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag en 3,25% decemberuitkering.
  • Direct een vast contract. Wij hebben vertrouwen in jou.
  • 170 vakantie-uren én de optie om tot 185 extra vakantie-uren bij te kopen vanuit jouw IKB.
  • Een NS-Business Card met Treinvrij (en een NS-Businesscard Daluren voor directe gezinsleden). Of een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km onbelast bij maximaal 120 kilometer per dag.
  • Een goed pensioen bij Rail & OV: een sterk fonds dat vooroploopt in duurzaam beleggen. Zit je nu in een ander fonds? Houd er rekening mee dat Rail & OV op 1 januari 2026 al overstapte op het nieuwe pensioenstelsel.

Wij kozen voor een kleine selectie uit onze arbeidsvoorwaarden. Maar we bieden je meer. Voor alle arbeidsvoorwaarden en onze CAO klik op deze link.

Jouw inbreng

Bij ProRail vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Daarom zijn wij benieuwd naar wie jij bent. Voor deze functie breng je sowieso mee:

  • Minimaal technisch hbo- werk- en -denkniveau, aangevuld met ten minste 5 jaar ervaring in stalen civiele constructen, besturingstechniek, werktuigbouwkunde en installatietechniek.
  • Ervaring in het aansturen van engineeringsprocessen in een technisch complexe projectomgeving en weet projecten te begeleiden in het toepassen van systems engineering.
  • Je bent een verbindend leider, conflictvaardig en hebt het vermogen om goed om te gaan met politiekgevoelige situaties en tegenstrijdige belangen.
  • Mondelinge communicatie: Je spreekt duidelijk, kan je mening overbrengen en past je taal aan de luisteraar aan.
  • Resultaatgerichtheid: Je gaat altijd voor het beste resultaat en stuurt bij waar nodig.

Jouw sollicitatie

Wil je als technisch projectleider beweegbare bruggen werken aan de toekomst van Nederland én aan die van jezelf? Solliciteer vóór 16 augustus. Toch eerst nog een vraag? Stel deze gerust aan Steven de Jong via steven.dejong@prorail.nl. Voor inhoudelijke vragen kun je contact opnemen met Ron van der Zwan via ron.vanderzwan@prorail.nl.

Binnen 5 dagen na de sluitingsdatum krijg je onze reactie. De gesprekken staan gepland op donderdag 27 augustus. Uitgenodigd voor het kennismakingsgesprek? Dan vragen we je een online assessment te maken als aanvulling op je cv en motivatie. Een referentiecheck is mogelijk onderdeel van deze procedure.

title: Strategy & Operations Associate
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Own

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions


Location

  • This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Thailand. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Thailnd.


Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Lead Software Engineer - Risk Technology
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Python Developer to join our Athena Rates development team to work on a Risk and PnL delivery for Rate Line of Business. In this role, you will design, develop, and integrate sophisticated solutions that support trading desks and back office functions across rates products. You will work at the intersection of technology and finance, delivering high-impact systems that enable critical risk management and profit & loss analysis for our trading operations.

As a Senior Python Developer on our team, you will build and maintain robust software solutions for rates trading activities.Your work will directly support trading operations across multiple Rates product types starting with Swap Derivative products and Options products.

Job responsibilities

  • Develop scalable, performant code that handles large volumes of market data and complex financial calculations. This includes implementing risk metrics, PnL attribution frameworks, and data pipelines that connect trading systems with downstream consumers.
  • Participate in architectural decisions, code reviews, and technical design sessions, contributing your expertise to shape the evolution of this automated risk platform.
  • Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied Python experience
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • Solid understanding of software engineering principles including object-oriented design, testing methodologies, and version control practices
  • Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable code and work effectively within large, complex codebases
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Proven ability to gather requirements from business users and collaborate across multiple teams and functions
  • Capability to translate business needs into technical solutions and explain technical constraints in business terms
  • Willing to understand and work on legacy applications when required
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
  • Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
  • Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Prior experience with other financial risk stack platforms such as SecDB, Quartz, or Athena
  • Strong preference for candidates with financial services background
  • Knowledge of rates products including Swaps, Securities, Options, and Repo
  • Familiarity with risk methodologies and PnL calculation frameworks
  • Experience with distributed systems and real-time data processing
  • Proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Knowledge of modern development practices including CI/CD pipelines and containerization
  • Exposure to quantitative finance concepts and market risk measures
  • Understanding of regulatory reporting requirements in financial services
  • Working knowledge of usage of Agentic AI in Software analysis , development and testing

title: Group Strategy Senior Analyst
location: South Jakarta, South Jakarta City, Indonesia
description:
At Amartha, we empower micro-businesses across Indonesia, enabling growth and equal prosperity. We’ve supported over 2.7 million entrepreneurs—mostly women—by disbursing IDR 22.8 trillion in funding. As we step into 2025, Amartha is evolving into a technology-driven financial ecosystem, expanding our reach in lending, funding, and payments. Through innovation and digital solutions, we aim to enhance accessibility, streamline processes, and create a seamless user experience.

About The Team

We are hiring a Strategy Analyst to support a high-performing Strategy team that works directly with the CEO. You will work across a wide range of topics -- long-term corporate strategy, investment analysis, financial performance, market research, and organizational priorities -- providing the research, data, and analytical foundation that the team builds on.

This is an early-career role designed for someone who is sharp, structured, and hungry to grow fast. You will be exposed to the most consequential decisions in the company from day one.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct market research, industry analysis, and competitive benchmarking across a wide variety of strategic topics
  • Build and maintain data models, financial trackers, and analytical frameworks that support ongoing strategy work
  • Develop a working understanding of Amartha's P&L, business model, and financial drivers to support investment and performance analyses
  • Produce first-draft slides, data summaries, and written sections for review by the Senior Strategy Manager and VP Strategy
  • Turn raw data and research into clean, insight-ready charts, tables, and executive-friendly visualizations
  • Support preparation for high-stakes meetings with C-suite and senior stakeholders across the organization
  • Respond to ad hoc requests from VP Strategy with fast, accurate, and well-structured outputs

Requirements

  • Bachelor Degree rom a reputable Indonesian university (UI, ITB, UGM, UNPAD, Prasmul, BINUS or equivalent)
  • Economics, Management, Engineering, or quantitative disciplines preferred; strong academic record expected
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in consulting, investment banking, corporate finance, or a structured analytical role
  • Strong quantitative skills -- Excel proficiency, financial modeling basics, and comfort with data analysis
  • Ability to structure ambiguous problems and communicate findings clearly in both written and slide format
  • Exposure to or genuine interest in financial services, fintech, or lending businesses
  • Fast learner who takes feedback well, improves quickly, and takes initiative without being asked
  • Ambition to grow into a Senior Strategy Manager role over time

At Amartha, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, ensures equity, and fosters inclusion. We believe that diverse perspectives—shaped by factors such as gender, age, race, ethnicity, education, culture, and life experiences—drive innovation and growth.

We actively welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us in building an environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities and foster a sense of belonging that enables our employees to thrive and make meaningful contributions.

title: Jeugdzorgwerker | Flexpool Jeugdzorg | Noord-Brabant en Limburg
description:
Hou jij van afwisseling en wil je jouw talent inzetten op verschillende locaties en doelgroepen? Als Jeugdzorgwerker in de Flexpool van Pactum heb je niet alleen de keuze waar je werkt, maar verbreed je ook je ervaring binnen verschillende vormen van jeugdhulp. Van de JeugdzorgPlus tot aan beschermd wonen: geen dag is hetzelfde.

Ben jij flexibel, sta je stevig in je schoenen en krijg je energie van uitdagingen? Dan is de Flexpool iets voor jou.

Jouw rol, jouw impact

Als Jeugdzorgwerker binnen de Flexpool stap je steeds weer in een nieuwe situatie. Juist daarin ligt jouw kracht. Je weet snel aansluiting te vinden bij jongeren, collega's en de werkwijze van een locatie. Of je nu een losse dienst werkt of een team voor langere tijd ondersteunt, jouw aanwezigheid maakt direct verschil.

Je biedt jongeren de begeleiding, rust en structuur die zij nodig hebben en draagt bij aan een veilige leefomgeving. Daarbij kun je te maken krijgen met uiteenlopende hulpvragen en complexe situaties. Je bent flexibel, handelt professioneel in crisissituaties en weet wanneer je moet aansluiten, begrenzen of doorpakken.

Voor de ene jongere ben je een luisterend oor, voor de andere een duidelijke begeleider of stabiele factor. Dankzij jouw brede inzetbaarheid lever je een waardevolle bijdrage aan zowel de ontwikkeling van jongeren als de continuïteit van onze teams.

Je werkzaamheden samengevat:

  • Je begeleidt en behandelt jongeren individueel en in groepsverband binnen verschillende zorgvormen.

  • Je draagt bij aan een veilige, gestructureerde en leerzame leefomgeving.

  • Je stimuleert jongeren in hun ontwikkeling en zelfstandigheid.

  • Je schakelt adequaat in complexe en onverwachte situaties.

  • Je werkt samen met collega's en andere betrokken professionals rondom de jongere.

  • Je springt bij waar jouw inzet het meest nodig is.

Jouw team, jouw plek

Werken in de Flexpool betekent werken op verschillende locaties en met uiteenlopende doelgroepen. Je kunt worden ingezet binnen onder andere open behandelgroepen, JeugdzorgPlus behandelgroepen of beschermd wonen locaties in de regio Noord-Brabant en Noord- en Midden-Limburg.

Geen enkele werkweek hoeft hetzelfde te zijn. Juist die afwisseling maakt het werk uitdagend en leerzaam. Je krijgt de kans om kennis te maken met verschillende methodieken, teams en doelgroepen, waardoor je jezelf blijft ontwikkelen als professional. Binnen de Flexpool kijken we samen naar wat bij jou past. Werk je het liefst met een specifieke doelgroep of wil je juist zoveel mogelijk verschillende ervaringen opdoen? Samen met je manager bespreek je jouw wensen, talenten en ambities. We houden hier zoveel mogelijk rekening mee. Daarnaast is jouw rooster zes weken van tevoren bekend, zodat flexibiliteit en duidelijkheid hand in hand gaan.

title: TE - Gbl Diesel Fuel & SCR Sys
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

At Ford, the Vehicle Hardware Engineering teams are using Design Thinking & User Experience methods to deliver breakthrough products and services that will delight our customers. Our employees are laser-focused on bringing innovative, exciting, and sustainable ideas to life. From autonomy and electrification to smart mobility technologies, our teams around the world are working together with excitement to make smart vehicles for a smart world.

Ford Motor Company is seeking a highly skilled Fuel System Core Diesel and SCR Technical Expert to join our Powertrain Engineering team. This role serves as the technical authority for diesel fuel system architecture, design, and integration across Ford's diesel engine platforms. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in diesel fuel delivery systems, injection technology, and emissions compliance to support the development of next-generation diesel powertrains that meet performance, durability, fuel economy, and regulatory requirements.

This position collaborates cross-functionally with application design, calibration, validation, manufacturing, and supplier quality teams to ensure robust, cost-effective, and high-performing fuel system solutions from concept through production and field support.

In this position...

  • Serve as the lead technical expert for diesel fuel system components, including SCR system, injectors, filtration systems, and low-pressure fuel supply systems.
  • Lead TechClub signoff process for all diesel programs through GPDS milestone deliveries
  • Maintain and update DFMEA and Quality documents for Diesel and SCR systems within FEDE
  • Define fuel system architecture and specifications for new diesel engine programs, ensuring alignment with performance, emissions, durability, and cost targets.
  • Lead root cause analysis and resolution of fuel system-related issues during development, validation, and production, including field and warranty concerns.
  • Collaborate with calibration engineers to optimize fuel injection strategies for combustion efficiency, emissions compliance, and drivability.
  • Provide technical guidance on fuel system compatibility with alternative and renewable diesel fuels, biodiesel blends, and future fuel standards.

What you'll do...

  • Interface with suppliers to evaluate, select, and develop fuel system components, ensuring technical requirements and quality standards are met.
  • Support DVP&T (Design Verification Plan and Report) development and execution for fuel system components and subsystems.
  • Ensure compliance with global emissions regulations (EPA, CARB, Euro standards) as they relate to fuel system design and function.
  • Conduct FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), DFMEA, and reliability assessments for fuel system components.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers within the fuel systems team.
  • Represent Ford in industry forums, standards committees, and supplier technical reviews related to diesel fuel systems.
  • Support cost reduction initiatives while maintaining system performance, durability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing and quality teams to resolve production and assembly-related fuel system issues.

You'll have...

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years of experience in diesel fuel system design, development, or integration within the automotive or heavy-duty vehicle industry.
  • Deep technical knowledge of high-pressure common rail (HPCR) fuel injection systems, fuel pumps, injectors, and related hardware.
  • Strong understanding of diesel combustion, emissions systems (SCR, DPF, EGR), and their interaction with fuel system design.
  • Knowledge of global diesel fuel quality standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Proven track record of leading root cause analysis and problem-solving for complex technical issues.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and present technical findings to leadership.

Even better, you may have...

  • Ph.D. degree in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with alternative diesel fuels (biodiesel, renewable diesel, synthetic fuels).
  • Familiarity with Ford or OEM product development processes (e.g., Global Product Development System, GPDS).
  • Six Sigma or similar quality/reliability certification.
  • Experience working directly with fuel system suppliers (e.g., Bosch, Denso, Delphi/BorgWarner) on component development.
  • Publication or patent history related to diesel fuel system innovation.
  • Experience with fuel system simulation and modeling tools (e.g., GT-Power, AMESim, or similar).

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
• Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
• Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more

• A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day

title: Junior Simulation Engineer
description:
Job Title

Junior Simulation Engineer

Job Description

Do you enjoy solving and optimizing logistic puzzles? Are you a communicative analyst who wants to develop his/her technical knowledge in a young and enthusiastic team?

Our drive is not to simply simulate and confirm that the system meets performance requirements. No, our drive is to always look for the better solution and to develop tools and processes to do so. What can be improved? Where are the bottlenecks? Which system parts are over-designed? How do we optimize for sustainability? Can we challenge the (internal) customer on assumptions, operation, design, process etc?
Everything supports our why: We help create the best Material Handling Solutions by solving the world’s coolest puzzles!

Your position

As a Simulation Engineer, you conduct studies on the dynamic interaction in - and the logistics performance of - the complex material handling systems sold by Vanderlande. You use 3-D simulation software to analyse and solve complex logistic problems.

With your analytical skills and proactive attitude, you optimize the system and identify bottlenecks prior to installation at the customer site. You develop conceptual improvements to control strategies and provide customers with tailored advice by thinking creatively when developing your simulation model. After you have gained more experience, your communication skills will enable you to act as a link between the different disciplines involved when working on larger projects.

Your department

Within the Simulation team of the Digital Lifecycle Performance department, you will become part of a group of enthusiastic and highly skilled young professionals. The team provides simulation support across all market segments and a wide range of processes within Toyota Automated Logistics, from sales and service to project execution and technology development. Personal development is a key focus within the department, supporting simulation engineers in continuously building skills, expanding expertise and progressing in their roles.

Your profile

  • A master in a relevant technical discipline like Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Aerospace Engineering

  • Knowledge of simulation, queuing theory quantitative analysis techniques, logic thinking skills.

  • Understanding of programming and at least some experience in programming languages like Matlab, VBA, JAVA, python, etc.

  • Preferably 0-2 years relevant experience.

  • Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English and a proactive attitude

  • Willing to travel occasionally

What we offer
In this challenging and responsible position, you will have the chance to make a significant contribution to industry-leading projects and be connected to our dedicated people and customers. We offer a position in an informal, international and professional working environment with a lot of scope for personal development. By joining our profitable and growing company you will be able to reach your goals and focus on your future.

title: Bliv en nøglespiller i driften på to plejecentre
description:
Vesterled Plejecenter søger en tjenestetidsplanlægger pr. 1. oktober 2026.

Ældreloven stiller nye krav til den nære ledelse. Derfor ønsker vi på Vesterled Plejecenter, at vores afdelingsledere skal bruge endnu mere tid tæt på beboere, pårørende, medarbejdere og kerneopgaven. For at understøtte den ambition styrker vi nu vores planlæggerfunktion.

Vi søger derfor en tjenestetidsplanlægger, der vil være med til at sikre, at planlægning, bemanding og daglig drift fungerer i praksis.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt planlæggerteam bestående af to tjenestetidsplanlæggere. Sammen understøtter I ledere og medarbejdere med alt fra langsigtet vagtplanlægning til den daglige håndtering af ændringer, sygdom og akut opståede behov.

Samtidig får du et særligt ansvar for planlægningen på Sørvad Plejecenter. Her bliver du en vigtig samarbejdspartner for både leder og medarbejdere, og du skal derfor være indstillet på at arbejde på Sørvad Plejecenter 1-2 dage om ugen.

Mere end vagtplanlægning
Hos os handler tjenestetidsplanlægning om meget mere end at placere vagter i et system.
Du får en central rolle i at skabe sammenhæng mellem drift, økonomi, medarbejdernes ønsker, overenskomster og behovet for en stabil bemanding.
Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:
  • Udarbejdelse og vedligeholdelse af vagtplaner
  • Daglig håndtering af sygdom, fravær og ændringer i bemandingen
  • Sikring af den rette bemanding og de rette kompetencer på de rette tidspunkter
  • Tæt dialog med medarbejdere, afdelingsledere og øvrige samarbejdspartnere
  • Understøttelse af ledelsen i forhold til planlægning og ressourcestyring
  • Overholdelse af arbejdstidsregler, lokalaftaler og overenskomster
  • Bidrag til udvikling og optimering af arbejdsgange inden for planlægningsområdet
  • Hjælpe på tværs af alle plejecentre hvis der opstår et behov
Du bliver med andre ord en vigtig medspiller i at få hverdagen til at fungere for både beboere, medarbejdere og ledere.

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Har erfaring med tjenestetidsplanlægning eller lignende koordinerende opgaver
  • Har kendskab til arbejdstidsregler og overenskomster
  • Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer
  • Trives med at have mange bolde i luften uden at miste overblikket
  • Er god til at skabe relationer og samarbejde med mange forskellige mennesker
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar
  • Har gode IT-kompetencer og let ved at lære nye systemer
  • Er løsningsorienteret og ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger

Derfor skal du vælge os
På Vesterled bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed, stærkt fællesskab og en kultur præget af ordentlighed, samarbejde og udvikling.
Vi tilbyder:
  • En nyoprettet stilling med mulighed for at præge funktionen
  • Et tæt samarbejde med en erfaren tjenestetidsplanlægger
  • Stor kontaktflade til medarbejdere og ledere
  • En afvekslende arbejdsdag med ansvar og indflydelse
  • En vigtig rolle i implementeringen af Ældrelovens ambitioner om mere nærværende ledelse
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
Vi tror på, at god planlægning ikke er et mål i sig selv. God planlægning gør det muligt for ledere at lede, medarbejdere at lykkes og beboere at opleve en tryg og sammenhængende hverdag.

Vil du vide mere?
Kontakt centerleder Gerd Bang Madsen på telefon 22 18 68 61 eller vedgbm@herning.dk.

Ansøgningsfrist den 23. august, ansættelsessamtaler forventes at blive afholdt den 25. august

I Herning Kommune lægger vi vægt på ligestilling og diversitet og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst, herunder de fastsatte bestemmelser i forhold til lokal løndannelse. Vi følger principperne for løngennemsigtighed, og du kan finde oplysninger om lønniveauet i Herning Kommune via dette link: KRL. Vi behandler dine personoplysninger i overensstemmelse med GDPR og modtager derfor kun ansøgninger gennem vores rekrutteringssystem. Klik på SØG STILLINGEN øverst for at søge denne stilling.

title: Content Specialist
location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
description:
Company Overview

Engage Video Group is a technology-driven social media video business combining data and creativity to create content people really care about. We have worked with global corporations such as Unilever and NESTLÉ to produce the most engaging, shareable content for some of the world’s largest brands, and have built and own the largest food and recipe social media platform in Africa, Foodies of SA.



The Content Lead is the strategic and creative owner of campaigns from client brief through to performance. This role is responsible for translating client objectives into platform-first creator video strategies, overseeing creator execution, maintaining creative quality throughout production, and driving continuous optimisation through performance insights. Working predominantly across food and FMCG brands, this individual combines strategic thinking, food and recipe ideation, creator content management, production oversight, and reporting to ensure every campaign delivers both creative excellence and measurable business results. The Content Lead acts as the central point of accountability across strategy, creators, production and reporting, ensuring campaigns are delivered to the highest creative and brand standard.



Key Responsibilities

1. Campaign Strategy & Creative Leadership

  • Own campaign strategy from initial client brief through to campaign delivery.
  • Translate client briefs into insight-led, platform-first creator strategies.
  • Lead creator strategy and recipe ideation, ensuring concepts are culturally relevant and brand aligned
  • Identify food trends, cultural moments and consumer behaviours that unlock strategic opportunities.
  • Present strategic thinking confidently to internal teams and clients.

2. Creator Sourcing, Briefing & Direction

  • Lead creator sourcing and recommend creators based on audience fit, creative style and campaign objectives.
  • Develop creator briefs that balance strategic messaging with authentic creator storytelling.
  • Brief creators and manage briefing sessions
  • Own creator feedback and sign-off prior to go-live

3. Production Oversight & Quality Assurance

  • Oversee production across campaigns to ensure strategic intent is maintained from concept through delivery.
  • Work closely with Foodies of SA and production teams to ensure content aligns with campaign objectives and brand standards.
  • Act as the quality gate for all campaign assets before client delivery.
  • Ensure campaign deliverables meet Engage Video Group's creative standards before publishing.

4. Campaign Performance & Optimisation

  • Monitor campaign performance throughout the campaign lifecycle.
  • Recommend creative pivots or reinvestment opportunities based on performance.
  • Ensure learnings are documented and applied to future campaigns.

5. Reporting & Strategic Insights

  • Lead strategic reporting across campaigns.
  • Develop meaningful reporting narratives that explain campaign performance beyond the metrics.
  • Produce actionable insights and recommendations for clients.
  • Identify long-term learnings across brands and categories.
  • Contribute strategic commentary to reporting decks and presentations.



Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic thinker with the ability to balance creativity and commercial objectives.
  • Excellent understanding of food culture, recipe content and FMCG purchasing behaviour.
  • Strong creative judgement with a high standard for content quality.
  • Experience briefing and directing creators.
  • Ability to oversee multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Confident interpreting campaign data and translating insights into action.
  • Strong storytelling ability across strategy, reporting and presentations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Meta and YouTube content ecosystems.
  • Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to act as a quality gate across campaign deliverables.



Experience & Qualifications

  • 2-3 years' experience in content strategy, influencer marketing, digital marketing, social strategy or FMCG brand marketing.
  • Experience developing content strategies for food, beverage or FMCG brands.
  • Experience overseeing creator campaigns from briefing through to delivery.
  • Experience working closely with production teams and creative talent.
  • Experience contributing to campaign reporting, optimisation and case study development.
  • Previous team leadership or mentoring experience.
  • Relevant qualification in Marketing, Communications, Media, Advertising or a related field.

title: Strategy & Operations Associate
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Own

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions


Location

  • This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam.


Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Member Experience and Policy Specialist, Vinted Pay
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

We are building a payments organisation that moves billions of euros across our markets, supported by a strong foundation of Member Support. As a Member Experience and Policy Specialist, you will play a critical role in establishing and enhancing the Vinted Pay member support segment. You will be responsible for developing and improving support policies, also ensuring efficiency and high-quality solutions for ticket escalations and legal complaints. Join us in making a significant impact on our global payments ecosystem and enhancing the trust of our members through exceptional support and compliance.

In this position, you’ll

  • Co-own the establishment of Vinted Pay member support segment.
  • Deliver launch and scale activities for member support.
  • Develop and improve policies and procedures in wallet services related support processes.
  • Ensure compliance for legal complaint handling processes and deliver reporting activities for Bank of Lithuania.
  • Own efficiency and high quality solutions for ticket escalations.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (e.g. product, community support operations etc.) and manage stakeholders (e.g. partners, payment providers etc.)

About you

  • Proven experience in customer support preferably within payments, fintech, banking, e-money, marketplaces, or another regulated environment.
  • Have experience with costumer complaint handling to financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of anti-money laundering (AML) and know your customer (KYC) regulations and knowledge how to apply them to customer support operations.
  • Confident using Excel/Google Sheets to analyse data and make informed decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes, improve workflows, and propose scalable solutions.
  • Prior experience with cross-departmental stakeholder management.
  • Strong verbal communication and negotiation skills, with fluency in English.
  • Strong time management and organisational skills.
  • Confident in operating within ambiguously defined structures with an ability to deliver tangible results.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with risk assessment and mitigation strategies, as well as experience using BI tools such as Looker or similar platforms, would be considered an advantage.

Work perks

title: Automotive Engineering Intern - Formula Student Simulation & Dynamics
description:
Role description

Are you a participant of Formula Student (Formula SAE) who wants to understand exactly how real-world vehicle physics translates into a cutting-edge virtual simulator?

This one-semester internship is designed as a hybrid of hands-on vehicle development and technical storytelling. You will learn the full BeamNG vehicle creation pipeline by helping build a Formula Student race car model and tuning it for core dynamic disciplines such as skidpad, acceleration, autocross, and endurance.

Just as importantly, you will document the process. Your notes, guides, and tutorials will help create a reference project for Formula Student teams who want to use BeamNG for virtual testing, setup evaluation, and early-stage vehicle development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the physics model of a Formula Student race car in BeamNG using JBeam
  • Create or adapt the vehicle’s 3D mesh for visual representation
  • Select and integrate chassis, suspension, wheel, and powertrain configurations
  • Implement simulation scenarios for core Formula Student dynamic events
  • Develop documentation and tutorials to support future Formula Student teams in using BeamNG for virtual vehicle testing

Requirements

  • Education: Currently pursuing a degree in Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • The SAE Spirit: Active or past involvement in a Formula Student team ideally in chassis and suspension design or vehicle dynamics simulation. Familiar with Formula Student rulebook and design constraints
  • Curiosity Over Expertise: You don’t need to be a coding wizard yet, but you must be eager to learn text-based physics configuration (Jbeam) and basic scripting.
  • Strong Communication: You enjoy explaining how things work. You can take a complex engineering problem you just solved and write it down clearly for others to learn from.
  • Software knowledge: Familiarity with BeamNG, VSCode, Blender, GIT/SVN is an advantage but not mandatory

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Language courses
  • Talent development program (training budget, participation in seminars/conferences, and etc)
  • Personal development program (feedback, leadership, conflict engagement, etc)
  • Parental leave
  • Employee assistance program
  • Relocation assistance (if applicable)

Our recruitment process

Our recruitment process starts with an introductory call with our HR team, continues with a coding challenge/assessment, a technical interview, and finally a stakeholder interview

About us

Our journey began in 2013 and we've continued to expand as an independent studio since then. We are a team of over 90 employees of 29 nationalities with a headquarters in Bremen, Germany, and we are always on the lookout for expert talent to join us!

We consider our employees to be our most valuable assets, and all of them play a vital role in helping us establish and nurture the company's culture and values. We are a guild of innovators, artists, engineers, and designers, who appreciate and embrace the diversity of our perspectives and know-how to apply them to grow together as a community and foster a healthy work environment.

Together, we are building a safe and inclusive atmosphere, with transparent processes to amplify individuality, empathy, respect, creativity, and continuous learning for all employees. Regardless of your identity or background, we would be happy to welcome your application if you feel inspired and want to become a part of our team! Skip writing lengthy cover letters and tell us more about your passion for gaming and why specifically BeamNG. Do not be discouraged if you don’t meet all the criteria for a specific role, feel free to submit an unsolicited application.

To minimize bias throughout the hiring process, please submit your application in English.

Als coördinator ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse coördinatie van de opleiding Autonome Beeldende Kunst. Je ondersteunt het docententeam bij de organisatie en verdere ontwikkeling van het onderwijs en bewaakt de kwaliteit en samenhang van het curriculum.

Samen met het docententeam, de studentbegeleiding en de opleidingsmanager werk je aan een veilige en inspirerende leeromgeving waarin studenten zich artistiek, professioneel en persoonlijk kunnen ontwikkelen.

Je zorgt ervoor dat onderwijs, artistieke praktijk, organisatie en communicatie elkaar versterken.

  • het coördineren van de dagelijkse organisatie van de opleiding;
