title: Project Coordinator
description:
Join a tech company that’s making a difference in healthcare

At Sectra Canada, our objective is to introduce a leading global medical IT solution to the Canadian market, with the aim of establishing ourselves as the top provider of Enterprise imaging and PACS solutions in the country. Our customers operate in some of Canada’s most critical functions, and we are uniquely positioned to help them optimize patient-centered care. Our modular and scalable enterprise imaging solutions allow healthcare providers to grow from ology to ology, while providing efficiencies and advanced technology to modernize Canada’s medical imaging systems, all while protecting the most sensitive information for patients and care providers.

As the newest Sectra operation, Sectra Canada has the best of both worlds. We embody the energy of a young startup yet enjoy the stability of a well-established brand with vast global experience and a product backed by 40+ years of innovation. The result? An agile, invigorating, highly supportive and fun environment that empowers our team to do their best work and make a difference in people’s lives every day.

What’s exciting about this position?

Are you passionate about coordinating dynamic projects that impact the healthcare industry? Do you enjoy facilitating communication, organization, and collaboration to ensure successful project delivery? This is an opportunity to work on impactful projects that enhance patient care, security, and technological efficiency for our customers. Join us as a Project Coordinator, where you’ll be key in supporting our team and ensuring the successful completion of projects that make a difference in healthcare. This position is a temporary full-time, 12-month contract, with the potential to transition to a permanent full-time role.

As a Project Coordinator, you will:

  • Project Assistance: Aid in planning and tracking customer operations projects to ensure they remain on schedule and align with team objectives. Monitor milestones, deadlines, and assist with coordinating project and customer meetings.
  • Resource Coordination: Support Project Managers and Program Portfolio Managers by tracking resource allocation and identifying potential capacity issues.
  • Stakeholder Support: Prepare and organize regular updates for internal teams, and occasionally external stakeholders, under supervision.
  • Requirements & Project Documentation: Assist in gathering and documenting project requirements from various teams (e.g., Technology, Sales, Marketing) for easy access. Support project documentation through meeting notes, lessons learned, and the maintenance of project plans for smaller projects.
  • Risk Identification: Help update risk and issue logs, notifying Project Managers of any observed concerns.
  • Meeting Coordination: Schedule and organize Sprint Planning, Review, and Retrospective sessions to maintain the team’s agile workflow.
  • Agile Documentation: Record notes and action items during Scrum meetings to ensure clear follow-up tasks.
  • Performance Tracking: Assist in gathering data on sprint performance metrics and compiling simple reports to support continuous improvement.
  • Sectra One Journey Application: Use the Sectra One Journey methodology to promote standardization and drive process improvements.
  • Special Projects: Coordinate internal departmental projects as needed.
  • 10%-15% travel required.

So, are you a fit?

We hire for attitude and ability, train for skill. Our people have the knowledge to meet expectations, but more importantly the passion to exceed them consistently. We’re all about learning from and challenging each other and going all in for every customer. To add to our amazing team, these attributes will be crucial to your success:

  • A drive to make things happen
  • A longing to make a difference in the healthcare industry
  • A hunger to learn and improve at every opportunity
  • A true team player eager to share your knowledge with the team

Think you’ve got what it takes? Great! Here are a few more boxes we’re hoping you can tick:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Project Management certificate.
  • Minimum of 2-3 years’ experience in project coordination or similar roles.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, with a service-oriented mindset.
  • Self-starter with a proven ability to work independently.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies.
  • Highly adaptable in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual: English and French.
  • Working toward PMP certification.
  • Familiarity with Scrum and Agile methodologies.
  • Experience with project management software (e.g., MS Project, Wrike, time reporting applications, Microsoft Office Suite).
  • Interest in healthcare IT and technology-driven project management.
  • Basic understanding of healthcare imaging solutions is a plus.

Our salary range for this role falls between $66,700 and $82,400.The final salary offer will depend on several key factors, including the candidate's level of experience, their specific skill set, and the overall alignment with the job requirements. Other considerations may include the candidate’s education, certifications, and any additional relevant qualifications. We aim to offer a competitive salary that reflects the value each individual brings to our team.

Equal opportunity employer

Healthcare is a universal priority, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a healthier and safer society. Our employees are people with different strengths, interests, experiences and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. We embrace our differences and celebrate our uniqueness, and we respect and value all of our employees' points of views. Our non-discrimination policy extends beyond recruitment practices to encompass all terms, conditions and privileges of employment as well as the use of all company facilities, participation in all company-sponsored activities, and all employment actions such as promotions, compensation, benefits and termination of employment.

title: Construction Planner
description:
Overview

We are recruiting for a Planner to join our Delivery team in Beverley.

  • Up to £70k doe
  • Company car / £7k car allowance

We specialise in sustainable water asset management solutions, delivering exceptional value outcomes in potable water, wastewater and the environment.

There’s never been a more exciting time to join us. With increasing investment in water, wastewater, and environmental infrastructure, we’re growing fast - and we’re looking for passionate people to grow with us.

What you'll be doing

Reporting to the Contracts Director, you will be responsible for supporting the planning and delivery of water and environmental projects from tender through to completion. The role involves developing and maintaining project programmes, monitoring progress, identifying risks, and supporting project teams to ensure delivery is achieved safely, efficiently, and in line with agreed schedules. The role requires close collaboration with project managers, engineers, commercial teams, and clients, and includes hybrid working with occasional travel to project sites and client locations. Duties and Responsibilities • Develop, maintain, and update project programmes using Microsoft Project and Netsuit ProScope ERP. • Produce baseline, detailed, and short-term look-ahead programmes to support project delivery. • Monitor project progress and update programmes to reflect actual performance. • Analyse critical path activities and identify risks, delays, and opportunities. • Recommend and support implementation of mitigation measures where required. • Collaborate with project, engineering, commercial, and site teams to gather accurate programme information. • Support tender planning activities and programme development for new projects. • Produce regular progress reports and planning updates for internal and external stakeholders. • Ensure programmes align with project milestones, contractual requirements, and delivery objectives. • Support change management processes by assessing programme impacts of variations and delays.

Who we’re looking for

• Experience in a Project Planner role within engineering, construction, infrastructure, or utilities.• Proficiency in Microsoft Project.• Strong understanding of project planning principles, scheduling methodologies, and critical path analysis.• Strong organisational, analytical, and communication skills.• Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

What we're offering

Holidays• You will receive 24 days’ paid holiday per annum, rising to 25 after two years’ service.• Options to buy five extra days using the Holiday Scheme.• Volunteering day - up to two days per year to contribute to our local communities.• Enhanced occupational maternity leave policy.

Finance / Rewards• Up to £70k, plus a company car / car allowance • Pension – You will receive a 6% company pension contribution.• Life Assurance.• Income protection• Car or car allowance for all roles that require significant travel.• Benifex Platform - including the Technology Scheme, Dental Plan, and the Bike SchemeHealth and Wellbeing• Private Medical Insurance• Eyecare Scheme

Our vision is to be the best water and environment sustainability specialist.

title: RN Staff - 5 W ICU - Full Time 12 Hour Days (Non-Exempt) (Union)
location: Los Angeles, CA - Health Sciences Campus
description:
As an integral part of the interdisciplinary team, the Registered Nurse utilizes the nursing process to provide therapeutic care to patients. The Registered Nurse is accountable for the coordination of patient care and education to the patient and family in accordance with the standards, policies, and practices in a compassionate, supportive, and therapeutic environment.

Essential Duties

  • Follows policies and procedures; demonstrates ability to access online manuals.
  • Transfers learned scientific knowledge into practical application in applying the Nursing Process.
  • ASSESSMENT Appropriately completes Nursing Assessment upon patient admission, at each shift and with change of condition. Completes patient acuity by 0200/1400 daily.
  • DIAGNOSIS Interprets assessment information and formulates Nursing Diagnoses.
  • PLAN Develops Plans of Care with individualized interventions. Documents expected/projected patient outcomes. Reviews/Revises/Updates Plans of Care daily based on evaluation and interpretation of patient outcomes.
  • INTERVENTION Administers medication and IV therapy appropriately at prescribed intervals. Completes patient care procedures correctly per policy at prescribed intervals. Delegates tasks based on others’ scope of practice and competency. Acts as patient advocate. Manages restraint use per policy Attempts alternative non-restraint measures first. Assures complete MD order per policy. Ensures MD assessment per policy. Assures patient monitoring per policy. Ensures Restraint Audit Form is completed each shift.
  • DOCUMENTATION Documentation is complete and correct on all flow sheets and chart forms: Admission Assessment Pain scale assessment and reassessment before and after intervention Daily flow sheet Restraint flow sheet Diabetes flow sheet Room/unit orientation Plan of Care Identifies knowledge deficits related to diagnoses and care Uses and provides MICROMEDEX information to patients and families. Educational flow sheet Kardex Care Plan Risk Assessment & Reassessment upon Fall MAR Equipment & Supplies Intra and Inter Facility Transfer Forms Belonging Tracking Form Ensures orders are transcribed and signed off prior to the end of the shift. Completes 12h/24h chart checks
  • EDUCATION Provides patient/family education as needed • Room/unit orientation • Plan of Care • Identifies knowledge deficits related to diagnoses and care Uses and provides MICROMEDEX information to patients and families
  • TRANSFER & DISCHARGE • Collaborates with Case Manager and/or physician regarding discharge planning. • Ensures all transfer paperwork is completed. • Ensures belongings are sent with patient.
  • EQUIPMENT Utilizes patient care equipment appropriately and safely according to manufacture guidelines • IV pump • Feeding pump • PCA pump • Epidural pump • Sequential compression device • Wound VAC • Heating pad/pump
  • COMMUNCATION Communicates effectively with all members of the healthcare team including patient and family: • Shift to shift report • Physician Rounds • Patient/family interactions • MDP Rounds • Hand-Off reports • Facility E-mail Student/New employee/Contract employee
  • ORGANIZATION • Manages time effectively. Able to organize and prioritize responsibilities. • Takes meal breaks without incurring overtime. • Completes shift on time.
  • OBSERVES REGULATORY AGENCY REQUIREMENTS: • National Patient Safety Goals ◦ Patient identifiers ◦ Unapproved abbreviations ◦ Universal Protocol (Procedural Time Out) ◦ Hand-Off ◦ Medication Reconciliation ◦ Clinical Alarms ◦ Other • Hazardous waste management ◦ Biohazard ◦ Medication ◦ Sharps • HIPAA • OSHA requirements (i.e. no food or drink in clinical areas) • JCAHO – continuous survey readiness ◦ Critical Values ▪ Write Down ▪ Read Back ▪ Follow up ◦ Telephone order ▪ Appropriate ▪ Documented ▪ Signed, Timed and Dated ▪ Stamped ▪ Entered into unit log ◦ Maintains safe practice in the work environment ▪ Correct body mechanics ▪ Electrical safety ▪ Infection Control Procedures ▪ Hand Washing
  • MANAGEMENT OF THE CARE OF MEDICAL SURGICAL PATIENTS • (6N) Demonstrates the ability to manage patients with THA. • (6N) Demonstrates the ability to manage patients with TKA. • (6N) Demonstrates the ability to manage patients with spinal surgery • (6S) Demonstrates the ability to maintain isolation precautions, respiratory and nutrition care specific to cystic fibrosis patients. • (6S) Demonstrates the ability to manage medications and maintain protective isolation precautions for patients with abdominal organ transplants. • (6S) Institutes safety precautions and skin care for patients with hepatic encephalopathy.
  • MANAGEMENT OF THE CARE OF PATIENTS IN THE INTENSIVE CARE UNIT/S • Demonstrates the ability to manage complex critically ill patients. Neurosurgery, thoracic-forgut, gastric bypass, orthopedic. Liver/kidney/pancreas transplants, hepatobiliary. Open heart, heart and lung transplants. • Demonstrates the ability to manage advanced therapeutic modalities. Hemodynamic monitoring. Continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT, CVVHD). Ventriculostomy, intracranial pressure monitoring. Ventricular assist devices, balloon pumps.
  • MANAGEMENT OF THE CARE OF PATIENTS IN THE STEPDOWN/TELEMETRY UNITS • Demonstrates the ability to manage high acuity patients requiring specialized monitoring and care. Status post open heart, heart transplant, lung transplant. Status post liver/kidney transplants, orthopedics, hepatobiliary, general surgeries. Status post thoracic-forgut, gastric bypass, neurology, neurosurgery. • Demonstrates the ability to manage advanced therapeutic modalities. Ventilator care. Arterial/CVP lines. Ventricular assist devices. Lumbar drains.
  • QUALITY MEASURES • Accurately identifies patient that fit Core Measure criteria • Completes Core Measure Documentation Identifies and participates in data collection and process improvements related to Nurse Sensitive Quality Indicators
  • PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT • Participates in professional hospital/nursing activities Relief Charge Nurse Nursing committees/councils Hospital Teams Unit Based Projects Research Published peer review article.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

  • Req Bachelor's degree Nursing Degree in Nursing (BSN)
  • Req 0-1 year Must have less than 1 year of acute care experience as a Registered Nurse.
  • Req Current knowledge of treatment practices.
  • Req Knowledge of medical procedures and conditions and ability to understand, follow and successfully perform duties, including whole blood collection, and apheresis procedures, in accordance with administrative and clinical policies, regulations and procedures.
  • Req Registered Nurse - RN (CA Board of Registered Nursing)
  • Req Basic Life Support (BLS) Healthcare Provider from American Heart Association
  • Req Fire Life Safety Training (LA City) If no card upon hire, one must be obtained within 30 days of hire and maintained by renewal before expiration date. (Required within LA City only)
  • Req Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) Healthcare Provider from American Heart Association *Required for Departments: Intensive Care, Step-down, Telemetry. RNs without prior telemetry or critical care experience will be required to obtain ACLS within 180 days or by the end of orientation, whichever is sooner.
  • Pref Specialty Certification

Keck Hospital of USC, a 343-bed acute care hospital, provides exceptional and innovative care for complex medical and surgical conditions across a wide range of specialties. The hospital’s world-renowned physicians deliver compassionate, customized, patient-centered care and treat the most acutely ill patients with highly innovative techniques and treatment plans. As a leading academic medical center, hundreds of clinical trials are currently taking place at Keck Hospital and its affiliated research institutions, giving patients access to novel and promising therapies that are generally not available elsewhere. Every day at Keck Hospital, physicians, nurses and staff go beyond the science of exceptional medicine to bring patients breakthroughs in the art of caring. Join this world-class team providing highly specialized care, up-to-the-minute research, and innovative clinical trials.

title: Sr IT Engineer
description:
Sr.IT Engineer Virtualization/Linux/Unix/Storage About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled VMware Virtualization Subject Matter Expert (SME) with deep, hands-on expertise in VMware virtualization, Linux/Unix administration, enterprise storage platforms, operations, and advanced troubleshooting. In this role, you will be a critical part of our data center and ERP hosting operations team, responsible for maintaining a fully virtualized infrastructure integrated with enterprise storage solutions from Dell, HPE, and NetApp and ensuring high availability, stability, and performance across mission-critical systems.

This position is ideal for a seasoned technologist who excels in diagnosing complex issues, optimizing virtualized environments, and driving operational excellence across enterprise infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, administer, and optimize enterprise-grade VMware virtualization platforms (vSphere, vCenter, ESXi).
  • Manage and support hyper-converged infrastructure environments (e.g., Dell EMC VxRail).
  • Administer and support enterprise storage platforms, including Dell EMC, HPE, Alletra, and NetApp ONTAP environments.
  • Manage SAN/NAS provisioning, LUN and volume management, zoning/masking coordination, capacity planning, snapshots, replication, and storage performance troubleshooting.
  • Perform lifecycle management including upgrades, patching, resource optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across VMware, Linux/Unix, Dell/HPE/NetApp storage, compute, and networking layers.
  • Administer and support Linux/Unix operating systems (RedHat, Oracle Linux, and other Unix variants).
  • Perform deep dive troubleshooting for OS level, kernel level, boot, package, and performance issues.
  • Manage OS patching, vulnerability remediation, configuration hardening, and system tuning.
  • Automate routine tasks using scripting (Bash, Python, Shell) and configuration tools.
  • Support enterprise ERP hosting operations across virtualized Linux/Unix and Windows environments.
  • Manage and maintain backup and replication solutions including snapshots, filesystem backups, and database backups.
  • Participate in Disaster Recovery (DR) architecture, configuration, and mock exercises.
  • Drive incident, problem, and change management processes with strong Root Cause Analysis (RCA) capabilities.
  • Develop infrastructure standards, operational guidelines, and best practices for virtualization and Linux/Unix systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional project teams on design, implementation, and deployment activities.
  • Provide expert guidance and mentorship to junior administrators.

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in IT Operations or Data Center environment.
  • 5+ years of hands-on VMware virtualization experience (vSphere/vCenter/ESXi).
  • 3+ years of Linux/Unix administration and troubleshooting experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on enterprise storage administration or support experience, preferably across Dell, HPE, and/or NetApp storage platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Strong expertise in RedHat, Oracle Linux, and other Unix-based systems.
  • Strong expertise in enterprise storage technologies from Dell, HPE, and NetApp, including SAN/NAS architecture and day-to-day operations.
  • Understanding of Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, SMB, RAID concepts, multipathing, snapshots, replication, capacity planning, and performance tuning.
  • Experience integrating storage with VMware clusters and Linux/Unix hosts, including datastore management, LUN mapping, and end-to-end performance troubleshooting.
  • Advanced understanding of security, patching, and hardening tools.
  • Certifications such as:

    VMware VCP / VCAP
    Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or equivalent Linux/Unix certification

  • VMware VCP / VCAP
  • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or equivalent Linux/Unix certification
  • Experience with automation tools (e.g., Chef, Ansible, shell scripting).
  • Preferred exposure to vendor storage certifications or training such as Dell Information Storage, HPE Storage, or NetApp NCDA/NCIE, where applicable.
  • Experience conducting RCA and leading technical bridges during incidents.
  • VMware VCP / VCAP
  • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or equivalent Linux/Unix certification

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on advanced, large scale virtualized environments.
  • Exposure to cutting edge infrastructure technologies and DR solutions.
  • Collaborative and innovative work culture focused on technical excellence.

title: Head of Technology – EV Systems & Solutions
description:
Head of Technology – EV Systems & Solutions

Location: Home Based / Hybrid (Regular Depot Attendance Required)

Join SWARCO EVOLT Charging

We're looking for an experienced Head of Technology – EV Systems & Solutions to lead the strategic development of our software and hardware technology portfolio. This is a pivotal senior leadership role responsible for defining our technology roadmap, driving innovation, strengthening our cloud and software platforms, and ensuring our technology solutions continue to meet the evolving needs of our customers and the rapidly growing EV charging market.

Reporting to the Business Operations Director, you'll work closely with the Senior Management Team to shape the future of our technology function while leading a talented team of Software Engineers and collaborating across Sales, Product, Operations and Customer Support.

What You'll Be Doing

As Head of Technology, you'll provide both strategic and technical leadership across our EV Systems and Solutions portfolio.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading, developing and mentoring a high-performing team of Software Engineers.

  • Defining and delivering the technology strategy to support business growth and future innovation.

  • Leading the migration to the Ampeco back-office platform and ensuring successful implementation.

  • Developing EVOLT's future hardware and software propositions in partnership with OEM manufacturers and technology providers.

  • Maintaining strong strategic relationships with Ampeco and key technology partners.

  • Establishing robust technical governance, architecture standards and development best practice.

  • Embedding security, quality assurance and vulnerability testing throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Designing and implementing end-to-end Continuous Integration (CI) and automated testing processes with clearly defined quality gates.

  • Driving cloud infrastructure optimisation, performance, resilience and cost efficiency.

  • Providing technical leadership across OCPP, CPMS, API integrations, AWS Cloud platforms and connected EV technologies.

  • Supporting the continued development of AI-driven insights and intelligent platform capabilities.

  • Working collaboratively with Sales, Product, Service Operations and Customer Support teams to ensure technology solutions align with customer and business requirements.

  • Producing strategic recommendations and fact-based reporting to support Executive and Senior Leadership decision making.

  • Ensuring technology risks, cyber security and compliance remain at the forefront of all development activities.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.

  • Significant experience leading software engineering or technology teams.

  • Strong background in cloud architecture, software platforms and enterprise technology solutions.

  • Experience with OCPP, Charge Point Management Systems (CPMS), API integrations and connected technologies.

  • Strong knowledge of AWS Cloud and modern cloud-based architectures.

  • Experience designing, deploying and managing secure, scalable and cost-effective cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong understanding of technical governance, cyber security and risk management.

  • Strategic technology planning experience with the ability to align technology roadmaps to business objectives.

  • Excellent leadership, stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Executive-level presence with the ability to influence at all levels of the organisation.

  • Strong decision-making skills with the ability to adapt in a fast-moving technology environment.

  • Full UK Driving Licence.

  • Right to live and work in the UK.

Desirable

  • Solutions Architect Professional certification.

  • Experience within the EV charging, smart mobility or connected infrastructure sector.

  • Knowledge of AI-driven analytics and intelligent software platforms.

  • Experience working with OEM hardware manufacturers and technology partners.

  • Experience leading complex systems migration and digital transformation programmes.

What We Offer

At SWARCO, we recognise that our people are our greatest asset. In return for your expertise and commitment, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, career development and work-life balance.

Our benefits include:

  • Competitive salary
  • Hybrid and flexible working
  • 25 days annual leave, plus Bank Holidays, increasing with length of service
  • Company pension scheme
  • Life assurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Enhanced family-friendly policies
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Access to learning and career progression opportunities across the global SWARCO Group
  • Employee discounts and benefits platform
  • The opportunity to work on innovative technology that is helping shape the future of sustainable transport

Join us and become part of a collaborative, forward-thinking organisation where your ideas are valued and your career can thrive.

Why Join SWARCO?

This is an exciting opportunity to join a global organisation at the forefront of intelligent transport systems and sustainable mobility.

As Head of Technology, you'll play a critical role in shaping the future of EVOLT's technology strategy, leading innovative software and hardware development while influencing the direction of one of the UK's leading EV charging providers.

At SWARCO, we believe in investing in our people, encouraging innovation and providing opportunities for continuous professional development. You'll work alongside passionate experts in a collaborative environment where your ideas and leadership will make a genuine impact.

SWARCO is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of gender, disability, religion, ethnic origin or background.

Please note: We work exclusively with our approved recruitment partners. We do not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies, and no agency fees will be paid where terms have not been agreed in advance.

title: Content Specialist
location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
description:
Company Overview

Engage Video Group is a technology-driven social media video business combining data and creativity to create content people really care about. We have worked with global corporations such as Unilever and NESTLÉ to produce the most engaging, shareable content for some of the world’s largest brands, and have built and own the largest food and recipe social media platform in Africa, Foodies of SA.



The Content Lead is the strategic and creative owner of campaigns from client brief through to performance. This role is responsible for translating client objectives into platform-first creator video strategies, overseeing creator execution, maintaining creative quality throughout production, and driving continuous optimisation through performance insights.

Working predominantly across food and FMCG brands, this individual combines strategic thinking, food and recipe ideation, creator content management, production oversight, and reporting to ensure every campaign delivers both creative excellence and measurable business results.

The Content Lead acts as the central point of accountability across strategy, creators, production and reporting, ensuring campaigns are delivered to the highest creative and brand standard.



Key Responsibilities

1. Campaign Strategy & Creative Leadership

  • Own campaign strategy from initial client brief through to campaign delivery.
  • Translate client briefs into insight-led, platform-first creator strategies.
  • Lead creator strategy and recipe ideation, ensuring concepts are culturally relevant and brand aligned
  • Identify food trends, cultural moments and consumer behaviours that unlock strategic opportunities.
  • Present strategic thinking confidently to internal teams and clients.

2. Creator Sourcing, Briefing & Direction

  • Lead creator sourcing and recommend creators based on audience fit, creative style and campaign objectives.
  • Develop creator briefs that balance strategic messaging with authentic creator storytelling.
  • Brief creators and manage briefing sessions
  • Own creator feedback and sign-off prior to go-live

3. Production Oversight & Quality Assurance

  • Oversee production across campaigns to ensure strategic intent is maintained from concept through delivery.
  • Work closely with Foodies of SA and production teams to ensure content aligns with campaign objectives and brand standards.
  • Act as the quality gate for all campaign assets before client delivery.
  • Ensure campaign deliverables meet Engage Video Group's creative standards before publishing.

4. Campaign Performance & Optimisation

  • Monitor campaign performance throughout the campaign lifecycle.
  • Recommend creative pivots or reinvestment opportunities based on performance.
  • Ensure learnings are documented and applied to future campaigns.

5. Reporting & Strategic Insights

  • Lead strategic reporting across campaigns.
  • Develop meaningful reporting narratives that explain campaign performance beyond the metrics.
  • Produce actionable insights and recommendations for clients.
  • Identify long-term learnings across brands and categories.
  • Contribute strategic commentary to reporting decks and presentations.



Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic thinker with the ability to balance creativity and commercial objectives.
  • Excellent understanding of food culture, recipe content and FMCG purchasing behaviour.
  • Strong creative judgement with a high standard for content quality.
  • Experience briefing and directing creators.
  • Ability to oversee multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Confident interpreting campaign data and translating insights into action.
  • Strong storytelling ability across strategy, reporting and presentations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Meta and YouTube content ecosystems.
  • Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to act as a quality gate across campaign deliverables.


Experience & Qualifications

  • 2-3 years' experience in content strategy, influencer marketing, digital marketing, social strategy or FMCG brand marketing.
  • Experience developing content strategies for food, beverage or FMCG brands.
  • Experience overseeing creator campaigns from briefing through to delivery.
  • Experience working closely with production teams and creative talent.
  • Experience contributing to campaign reporting, optimisation and case study development.
  • Previous team leadership or mentoring experience.
  • Relevant qualification in Marketing, Communications, Media, Advertising or a related field.

title: Frydendal Naturbørnehus søger pædagog til barselsvikariat i vores vuggestue
description:
Har du hjertet med i arbejdet med de mindste børn?
Brænder du for nærvær, omsorg og trygge relationer?
Er du glad for det nærer og arbejdet i små grupper? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores vuggestue i Frydendal Naturbørnehus.
Børnehuset er en del af landsbyordningen Kildefryd, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen med Kildebjergskolen, om det gode børne og ungeliv i Mørkøv.

Hos os bliver du en del af et engageret team, der arbejder med høj faglighed, nærværende omsorg og stærke børnefællesskaber for de yngste børn i huset.
Vi søger en uddannet pædagog til vuggestuen på 37 timer ugentligt - måske det er dig?

Vi lægger vægt på det nære og trygge

I vuggestuen er vi særligt optagede af det lille barns første møde med institutionslivet. Vi arbejder målrettet med tryg tilknytning, gode overgange og små børnefællesskaber, hvor alle børn bliver set, mødt og forstået.

Vi tror på, at børn udvikler sig bedst gennem nære relationer og omsorgsfulde voksne, der er til stede – både i de små hverdagssituationer og i legen.

Derfor er vi i gang med en udvikling, hvor vi skal arbejde mere i små grupper, hvor der er plads til fordybelse, nærvær og til at følge børnenes initiativer og spor gennem dagen.

Natur, udeliv og børneperspektiver

Frydendal Naturbørnehus arbejder med ICDP som fælles pædagogisk fundament og har en stærk grøn profil. Vi elsker udelivet og bruger vores skønne udeområder aktivt i hverdagen året rundt.

Vi er optagede af at skabe meningsfulde læringsmiljøer med udgangspunkt i børnegruppen og børnenes perspektiver. Hverdagen planlægges med blik for både udvikling, trivsel og det enkelte barns behov.

Vores hus er et charmerende ældre børnehus med masser af sjæl, grønne omgivelser og gode rammer for både børn og voksne.

Vi søger en kollega, der:
  • Er uddannet pædagog og for arbejdet med de yngste børn
  • Er omsorgsfuld, nærværende og relationsstærk
  • Trives i arbejdet med små grupper
  • Er optaget af tryg tilknytning og gode overgange
  • Har lyst til at arbejde med natur og udeliv
  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og samarbejdet i huset
Vi tilbyder:
  • Et stærkt og hjælpsomt team
  • Høj faglighed og refleksion over praksis
  • Plads til udvikling og idéer
  • En hverdag med nærvær, humor og engagement
  • Skønne udeområder og masser af udeliv

Vil du høre mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Josefine Ronge Olsen på tlf. 72 36 61 52 eller leder af børnehaven Mikkel Horne Bervild på tlf. 72 36 94 24.

Vi søger med ansættelse pr. 1. september eller snarest muligt, da vores kollega er gået fra før tid.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Specialist, Technology Solutions
description:
Business Systems Analyst

Position Summary

The Business Systems Analyst (BSA) is a customer-focused role with direct product involvement responsible for managing and communicating requirements to the solution team throughout the project. This is done by understanding and representing the customer to the team through daily stand-ups, a requirements document or backlog, use cases or user stories, and low-fidelity prototyping. A strong and technical understanding of current and future business needs is required to exceed the customer’s needs.

Scope & Impact of Job

The Business Systems Analyst works closely with an agile project team and Product Manager to manage a backlog of user stories for enhancements and projects of varying size. The Senior BSA facilitates meetings with internal/external clients, end users, and/or other stakeholders for functional software requirements and will provide input to design and test cases.

Primary Responsibilities:

  1. 50% Requirement Development & Management

  • requirements elicitation

  • user story creation

  • user story mapping

  • backlog grooming

  • prototype/wireframes creation

  1. 30% Communication

  • user story reviews

  • daily standups

  • status meetings

  • iteration planning & retrospectives

  • demos

  1. 5% Process Improvements

  1. 5% Mentoring

  1. 5% Defects Analysis Input

  1. 5% Other duties as assigned

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor degree in a Business, Information Systems, Computer Science discipline or equivalent technical work experience required

  • Related graduate degree preferred;

  • Seasoned IT or Business professional with a minimum of 3 years business analysis experience;

  • Experience with requirement elicitation, requirements documentation, and requirements management;

  • Experience with agile methodology and practices;

  • Business Analyst Certification preferred;

  • Direct customer interface experience (working with client directly on project tasks; managing client expectations);

  • Experience using Microsoft Office tools in a work setting (Word, Excel, Power Point, Visio);

  • Experience in computer-based testing, certification, and licensing industry preferred;

  • Experience with software development of client-server, web-based, data warehousing, reporting, or similar systems.

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Ability to solve problems of large scope

  • Strong technical thinking, analytical, and conceptualization skills;

  • Ability to assimilate information and distill knowledge within time constraints;

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;

  • Creative problem-solving skills;

  • Strong negotiation skills and ability to influence others;

  • Excellent customer service skills;

  • Well organized and detail-oriented;

  • Strong time management and planning skills;

  • Ability to adapt to change quickly;

  • Ability to work independently – must be self-motivated;

  • Strong computer skills and ability to quickly learn technical concepts and new technology;

  • Ability to provide technical alternatives, recommend solutions, and participate in implementation;

  • Ability to multi-task;

  • Ability to delegate and provide guidance to others;

  • Ability to implement process improvements.

title: Project Executive
description:
About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

Who You’ll Work With

You will join one of our 45 offices in the US, be part of a committed team of over 1500 professionals, and work in teams and directly with our clients doing work that is shaping the world around us. You will be welcomed into a rapidly growing business and team and empowered to make an impact. You will be valued, cared for, and challenged on your path to becoming a world-class professional consultant and surrounded by leaders who are committed to creating an environment that enables you to realize your own success and fulfillment.

When you join Design Group as a Project Executive, you are joining a team that will challenge you and position you for growth. In this role, you will work with a team of industry experts to help the world’s leading companies solve their most difficult problems. You will join our Architecture + Engineering + Construction (AEC) Business and partner with seasoned leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients with consistency and accuracy.

What You’ll Do

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

AEC Business Leadership

Seniormost delivery leader accountable to deliver major projects or programs leading teams in BW Design Group’s role as Multidisciplinary Architect-Engineer (MAE), or Integrated Design-Builder (IDB), or Engineer-Procurement Manager-Construction Manager (EPC).

Understands and aligns with the BW Design Group firmwide strategic plan. Communicates those strategic plans to teams in span of care, identifies, and relates the roles of those teams in contributing to realize the strategic plans.

Understands and aligns with BW Design Group commercial goals and objectives – and then positions, proposes, and delivers projects and programs to realize – BW Design Group commercial, delivery, and risk KPIs for projects.

Grows the capability and capacity of our professionals by shaping, engaging, and leading teams through challenging and rewarding projects and programs.

Inspire client loyalty by positioning, organizing, communicating, celebrating a rewarding client experience from relationship formation through project closeout.

Client Engagement + Opportunity Development

Strong understanding of design-build, engineer-procure-construct, and design-bid-build project delivery models. Recognized as a primary resource and champion for BW Design Group’s particular approaches to Integrated Design-Build, EPC, and Multidisciplinary Architecture-Engineering as variants of the basic delivery models.

Responsible for representing BW Design Group’s approach to project delivery in capabilities, pursuit, and pitch presentations.

Fluent in BW Design Group’s portfolio of work, differentiation as a partner, and approach to relationship and opportunity development.

Form and cultivate client relationships using BW Design Group’s Relationship-Based Growth model to drive multi-year account engagement and growth plans. For specific opportunities, focus on intaking, understanding, and shaping project delivery strategy best suited to realize the client’s capital strategy. Advocate for BW Design Group’s value proposition and differentiation vs. competitors.

Leads/Partners with Pursuit Team leaders to develop:

  • Capture plan and positioning;

  • Project Delivery approach;

  • Project Team organization, roles, members, and assignments;

  • Consulting, trade, and OEM partnering approach and roles;

  • Project Scope, Price, Schedule, and Contract terms;

  • Project Execution Plan (PxP).

Recruit, qualify, and organize internal team, leaders, and external trade, OEM, and subconsultant partners (as any and all are applicable) in the Project/Program Team organization. Set expectations for shared objectives and alignment to ways of working and conditions of success.

Project Delivery

Accountable to organize and lead the Project/Program Team, establish the Contract Documents, implement the PxP for engaged Projects, forecast outcome, and drive team to achieve the Conditions of Success:

  • Establish and verify the applicable Contract Documents (Prime, trade, consulting, and OEM) for the Work;

  • Establish Conditions for Success that reflect Client and BWDG’s priorities for successful realization of the Project/Program – recognizing that many Conditions are shared and managed with the Client – and others (i.e. BWDG financial performance) are internal;

  • Lead team to effectively address Community and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) relationship considerations;

  • Oversee development of design assist, design for integration, design for fabrication, and delegated design practices and approaches for BW Design Group, as applicable to its role on the Project;

  • Oversee development of fast-track, early work, long lead buyout, and target value delivery practices;

  • Require that prevailing project management, project controls, quality, safety, risk, procurement, and financial programs and practices are observed and applied;

  • Require regular Project Status Reviews occur to check and verify Project Team progress vs. PxP; address opportunities and challenges, and mitigate risks.

Industry Presence + Network

Grows BW Design Group’s presence and network connections within Client and Market communities by forming, cultivating and growing relationships with key trade, OEM, and subconsultant partners.

Leverages those relationships to enable development of Client relationships; obtain early involvement, pricing, scheduling, and procurement support; capture competitive intelligence; and source and recruit talent.

Grow a network of strategic, repeat, and geographically distributed partners that amplify our organic brand reach, market influence, and knowledge of the competitive landscape.

Measures of Success

  • Total Margin Engaged and Realized.

  • Achieving Project-/Program-specific Conditions of Success.

What You’ll Bring

  • 15+ years of progressive direct leadership in major design and/or construction projects or programs from a project delivery leadership perspective with construction, engineering, and/or architecture firm(s).

  • Focused Market sector or segment experience in CPG, Food, Beverage, Household & Personal Care, Life Sciences, Semiconductor, Advanced Manufacturing, Data Center, or Mission Critical markets.

  • Strong understanding of risk allocation, contract terms, and insurance risk transfer programs applicable to projects and the applicable variations for MAE, or IDB, or EPC, and various DBB models.

  • Strong command of commercial considerations, pricing approaches, positioning and marketing, teaming, project organization, and project staffing.

  • Commands understanding of industry terminology and BW Design Group vernacular as applicable to the businesses and practices of design and construction.

  • Fluency in digital delivery software applications from preconstruction to BIM/VDC, project/financial management, estimating, scheduling. Demonstrated ability to leverage tools to evaluate and communicate approach, progress, and risks to realizing the conditions of success for projects.

  • Collaborative leadership across engineering, architecture, and construction — among internal teams and external trade, OEM, and subconsultant partners.

  • A track record of developing people — growing teams through organizational change, building bench strength across project roles, and creating challenging project environments where good professionals thrive and stay with BW Design Group.

  • Capable to serve as director, officer, and/or member/manager of BW Design Group’s business entities and/or managing agent, resident principal, or branch principal (or the like, however such obligations are defined in each applicable jurisdiction) for professional licensing.

  • May acquire or maintain professional engineer (P.E.), registered architect (R.A.), or construction qualifier licensure and serve as an engineering or architecture Principal-in-Charge or construction qualifier for select states, offices, and/or projects.

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management is preferred. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • Frequent travel wherever and whenever necessary for client meetings, projects, and industry events.

Our culture and commitment to our people is what sets us apart. We foster an environment of mutual respect, integrity, and unconditional interest in the individual and collective success of our professionals. Our model and entrepreneurial mindset offer a rewarding, challenging, and highly flexible path. As a Project Executive, you will build a meaningful and fulfilling career with the support of professional development resources and mentorships including our First Year Experience program, Individual Development Plans, and Career Path resources and tools. You will be surrounded by exceptional talent who will support your development as both a world-class engineer and a highly effective leader.

Feel like you're on the path to becoming a Project Executive but you're not quite there yet? We'd love to connect with you to see if we can take you from where you are today and grow you into a Design Group Consultant.

title: Front Office Associate
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

License or Certification: None

title: Account Specialist I
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



The Docusign Account Specialist is a high-impact, multi-faceted position, responsible for owning a large portfolio of renewals in an assigned territory. The AS serves as a key customer contact, driving a return on our customers’ investment in Docusign and unlocking further digitalization. Within their defined territory, the AS is responsible for negotiating favorable renewal terms, processing a high quantity of renewals and providing insights to the business and customers that improve future outcomes. The AS is a critical member of the Account team, working in collaboration with our Sales Team (Account Executives) and Customer Success Teams. The ideal Account Specialist candidate will drive accountability with themselves and their business partners, thriving in a fast-paced environment.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Account Management International.

Responsibility

  • Engage effectively with customers, securing and processing their renewal on-time

  • Maintain and update a rolling forecast of your territory and communicate any renewal risk to internal resources in order to develop resolution strategies

  • Own and implement win/win negotiation strategies for a high quantity of renewals that increase contract value while protecting and enhancing customer trust

  • Improve account growth by playing a role on the account team, helping to identify incremental opportunities upon contract renewal

  • Collaborate with internal resources such as Sales, Customer Success, Pricing, Legal, Revenue Operations and Product Management to develop strategies for upcoming renewals

  • Follow and adhere to best practices for all internal processes including, Opportunity Management, Data Quality & Accuracy, CRM Hygiene, Quotes and Forecasting

  • Leverage customer data and behavior to assess the health of each renewal


Job Designation



Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • Experience in a customer-facing sales or customer success role

  • Fluent English for daily working in an international market (US)

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • Strong negotiation skills with experience driving contracts to completion on time

  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment with excellent time/organization skills

  • Experience in quota carrying sales role with proven achievement

  • Strong process management, financial competence, and contractual engineering skills

  • Ability to react and adapt to potential rapid shifts in priorities

  • Strong level of urgency, organization, and prioritization skills

  • Ability to project manage the renewal cycle, pulling in necessary resources


Life at Docusign



Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

title: Controls Engineer , EMEA Controls
description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

The Global Services team is looking for Controls Engineer responsible for the building automation systems with a focus on European Sovereign Cloud (ESC). You'll design, commission, and maintain building automation systems across data centers, directly enabling millions of customers to innovate without interruption.

We're looking for someone who possesses a /construction management, mechanical, electrical or technology background, passionate about critical infrastructure, thinks globally, and wants to shape the future of building controls and automation at unprecedented scale.


Key job responsibilities
- Understanding of: electrical diagrams, control diagrams, building operations, control circuits, industrial HVAC.
- Ability to ascertain customer needs to help develop scope and specifications.
- Ability to manage scope of work relative to the site specifics and customer needs.
- Ability to manage engineering to determine the scope of work relative to the design intent of the customer needs.
- Ability to read and interpret specifications and implementing those specifications as they apply the work environment.
- Development of control panel BOM’s.
- Development of ISA sheets for temperature, level, flow, and pressure transmitters along with ISA sheets for control valves, positioners, analytical, and various other types of instrumentation.
- Development of drawings for control panels, power distribution, junction boxes. Included in the drawings are the general arrangement, internal layout, schematics and interconnection and wire diagrams.
- Development of logic diagrams in the International Automation format for complex logic devices such as Programmable Logical Controller and Distributed Control System.
- Preparation of cable, routing plans and schedules.
- Performing inspects, testing, and commission of the facility systems.
- Work individually and as part of a team to develop new products, support existing products, test and evaluate equipment.
- Provide technical assistance as needed to internal customers.
- Coordinate work internally within the department and externally with other departments to ensure on-time completion of projects within budget.
- Manage service contracts with various vendors.
- Must be business proficient in English.


A day in the life
CE works on AWS leased own or Colocation Datacenter. They install, commission , maintain the DCs . They work with Customers for innovation, service ensuring Control systems are available 24x7 , 100% of the time.

Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Data Scientist - Conversational AI
description:
The Opportunity We are the movers of the world and the makers of the future. The Integrated Services team at Ford is developing connected, digital platforms that will revolutionize how vehicles function.

You will join the Digital Cabin organization as the dedicated Data Scientist for our next-generation AI Digital Assistant. This AI-driven feature is currently active on mobile platforms and is rapidly expanding into our In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) systems to execute tasks, provide vehicle reports, and enhance the driving experience.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the data strategy for a high-priority AI product from the ground up. We are looking for a strategic, "full-stack" Data Scientist who leans heavily into Product Analytics. You must be willing to roll up your sleeves to structure raw data and build executive dashboards, while also deploying applied machine learning techniques to categorize user utterances, evaluate AI performance, and drive behavioral insights.

What you'll do...

  • NLP & Utterance Analysis: Leverage Natural Language Processing (NLP) and machine learning to categorize and cluster raw user utterances. Perform sentiment analysis on unstructured text logs to extract actionable product insights.
  • AI Response Evaluation & Experimentation: Design methodologies to evaluate the helpfulness, accuracy, and relevance of the AI’s responses. Design and analyze A/B tests to measure the impact of prompt adjustments, model updates, and new feature rollouts.
  • Data Integration & Sanitization: Dive directly into Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to cleanly join and structure mobile, customer support, and vehicle data into robust "Analytical Sandboxes," ensuring strict adherence to data privacy and PII handling standards.
  • Problem Framing & Metric Definition: Act as a strategic partner to Product Managers. Challenge assumptions and define core conversational metrics (e.g., task success rates, user engagement, support deflection).
  • Advanced Visualization & Self-Service: Design, build, and maintain highly intuitive, narrative-driven dashboards using Looker and PowerBI to empower the product team to answer their own day-to-day questions.
  • Bridge the Mobile-to-IVI Gap: Act as the analytical bridge as our digital assistant expands from the Ford app into the vehicle, standardizing mobile data against our emerging in-vehicle data contracts.

You'll have...

  • Education: A Master's Degree in a quantitative, technical, or related field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics).
  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in Data Science, Product Analytics, or Applied Machine Learning.
  • "Full-Stack" Capability: Demonstrated ability to act as a bridge between Data Science, Engineering, and Product—taking raw telemetry, applying statistical/ML models, and transforming it into business insights without relying on a central data team for every step.

Primary Technical Skills

  • Applied ML & LLM Analytics: Proficiency in Python or R with hands-on experience in text analytics, clustering, and categorization. Familiarity with LLM evaluation techniques (e.g., prompt effectiveness, hallucination tracking, human-in-the-loop feedback).
  • Expert-Level SQL & GCP: Highly proficient in writing complex, optimized SQL (Window Functions, CTEs, handling JSON/Nested Data) within Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery) to structure datasets independently.
  • Advanced Visualization: Deep expertise in building scalable business intelligence solutions, semantic layers, and executive-facing dashboards in Looker and PowerBI.
  • Experimentation: Strong grasp of statistics and experience designing and measuring A/B tests in a product environment.
  • Analytics as Code: Experience with version control (e.g., Git, GitHub) and working in environments where analytics changes go through a formal peer-review process.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Comfortable navigating complex, multi-source data environments. You view data integration as a puzzle to be solved and a strategic enabler for the business.

Even better, you may have...

  • Behavioral Analytics: Experience using platforms like Amplitude to analyze user funnels, retention curves, and cohort behavior.
  • Data Modeling: Experience with dbt (Data Build Tool) or similar frameworks for transforming data in the warehouse.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? title: Administratief medewerker Domselaerstraat (16-24 uur)
description:
Ben jij een duizendpoot die het liefst schakelt tussen de rol van administratief medewerker en officemanager? Dan ben jij geknipt voor deze baan!

Jouw rol
Met gemak houd je meerdere ballen in de lucht. Collega's kunnen bij jou terecht voor ondersteuning op (bijna) elk vlak, want jouw rol gaat veel verder dan alleen administratieve werkzaamheden.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het kasbeheer en de uitgifte van voedingsgeld aan onze bewoners. Daarnaast voer je diverse secretariële taken uit, plan je complexe afspraken en bewaak je het overzicht voor de teammanager, zorgcoördinatoren en het team.

Ook beheer je de personeelsadministratie. Je verwerkt gegevens van nieuwe medewerkers, zet personeelsmutaties klaar, plant en registreert gesprekken met medewerkers en verwerkt ziek- en herstelmeldingen. Daarnaast vraag je autorisaties aan, bestel je telefoons en laptops voor nieuwe medewerkers en zorg je ervoor dat zij worden ingepland voor trainingen. Ook houd je herhaaltrainingen in de gaten en plan je deze tijdig in.

Tot slot behoren notuleren en het opstellen van overzichten eveneens tot jouw takenpakket.

Locatie
Beschermd Wonen Domselaerstraat is een 24-uurs WLZ woonvoorziening waar mensen wonen met een langdurig psychiatrische kwetsbaarheid, al dan niet in combinatie met diverse somatische aandachtspunten. Alle bewoners krijgen intensieve begeleiding/verzorging of verpleging op maat. Ons team bestaat uit persoonlijk begeleiders, ondersteunend begeleiders, verzorgenden IG, een zorgcoördinator, en teammanager, een kok, een administratief medewerker en een huishoudelijk medewerker. Wij begeleiden in totaal 31 bewoners, waarvan 3 ambulant.

Jouw profiel
Jij bent een organisatietalent en voelt je thuis in een dynamische omgeving. Zelfstandig, verantwoordelijk en flexibel zijn eigenschappen van jou. Je pakt snel informatie op en houdt ervan om zaken op tijd en goed geregeld te krijgen. Je wordt enthousiast van agenda's op elkaar afstemmen en je kunt goed plannen. Als snelle denker pak jij zaken proactief op nog voordat iemand anders er aan gedacht heeft. Herken je jezelf ook in onderstaande wensen, dan maken we graag kennis met jou!

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde mbo-3 opleiding in een administratieve richting;
  • Je hebt ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie en affiniteit met onze doelgroep;
  • Geconcentreerd en nauwkeurig werken gaat jou goed af;
  • Je krijgt nieuwe computersystemen snel onder de knie, kennis van Afas, Excel, Word en Topdesk is een pre;
  • Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden en bijzonderheden

  • Een baan met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief;
  • Het betreft in eerste instantie een contract voor de duur van een jaar met uitzicht op verlenging;
  • Jouw salaris bedraagt minimaal € 2.735,- en maximaal € 3.560,- bruto per maand (schaal 35, CAO GGZ) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek;
  • Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform CAO GGZ. Denk hierbij aan vakantiegeld, pensioen, fietsplan en een eindejaarsuitkering. We vinden vitaliteit belangrijk en bieden jou daarom jaarlijks een sportvergoeding van € 100,-; Een jaarlijks balansbudget van € 500 (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband). Voor de besteding hiervan kun je kiezen uit de drie opties zoals beschreven in de CAO GGZ;
  • Je hebt ruime keuze uit opleidingen en cursussen;
  • Een referentiecheck en verklaring omtrent gedrag maken onderdeel uit van deze procedure;
  • Met een interactief onboardingsprogramma bieden we jou een warm welkom en een goede start.

HVO-Querido heeft de ambitie om een inclusieve en gelijkwaardige organisatie te zijn waar alle cliënten en medewerkers zichzelf kunnen zijn en zich thuis voelen, met als doel om betere kwaliteit van zorg te leveren aan onze cliënten en een veilige en inspirerende werkplek te bieden voor onze medewerkers. Bij HVO-Querido werken we vanuit drie kennisbronnen: ervaringskennis, praktijkkennis en wetenschappelijke inzichten.

Meer informatie?
Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Feliza Santana Toledo, zorgcoördinator via 06-44294145. Als je vragen hebt over de procedure, kun je bellen met junior recruiter Sana Pinto Silva via 06-15365021.

Direct solliciteren?
Graag ontvangen we je digitale reactie vóór 11 augustus a.s.

title: Psychiater Acute Intensieve Zorg
description:
Door het vertrek van een collega, zijn we opzoek naar een nieuwe psychiater op de hoog beveiligde intensieve zorg. Wil jij als psychiater werken in een van de meest intensieve en specialistische behandelsettings binnen de forensische ggz? Op de HIBZ van Inforsa bied je zorg aan cliënten in acute crisis, waar veiligheid, stabilisatie en herstel van contact centraal staan.

Wat ga je doen?
Als psychiater op de Hoog Intensieve Beveiligde Zorg (HIBZ) ben je verantwoordelijk voor de diagnostiek en behandeling van cliënten met ernstige psychiatrische aandoeningen die in een acute crisis verkeren en ontwrichtend of escalerend gedrag laten zien. Het gaat om cliënten die tijdelijk niet meer veilig behandeld kunnen worden binnen een reguliere ggz-setting of hun eigen woonomgeving.

Je werkt met cliënten bij wie de behandeling is vastgelopen of waar sprake is van spanningen tussen cliënt en behandelteam, waardoor opschaling noodzakelijk is. Je richt je op crisisinterventie, stabilisatie en het herstellen van contact, met als doel om cliënten zo snel mogelijk terug te laten keren naar een minder intensieve behandelsetting. De gemiddelde opnameduur ligt tussen de drie en zes weken, waarbij het doel is om de gesloten opname zo kort mogelijk te houden.

De HIBZ kent een duidelijke structuur: we beginnen met een dagstart met alle artsen en psychiaters om 9 uur, daarna is er dagelijks een overdracht op de afdeling, waarna de psychiater visite loopt met de arts-assistent.

Je werkt volgens de Forensic High & Intensive Care (FHIC)-methodiek, waarin nabijheid, structuur en begrenzing centraal staan. Binnen deze methodiek kijk je met een frisse blik naar de problematiek om stagnatie in behandeling te doorbreken.

Je:

  • voert de regie over behandelplannen en zet interventies in op psychiatrisch, psychologisch en somatisch gebied;
  • werkt intensief samen in een multidisciplinair team met onder andere een arts, psycholoog, maatschappelijk werker en verpleegkundigen;
  • betrekt waar mogelijk naasten bij de behandeling;
  • werkt vanuit een open herstelklimaat, gericht op samenwerking en gedeeld doel: stabilisatie en contactherstel;
  • biedt duidelijke begrenzing van ontwrichtend gedrag om veiligheid te creëren voor cliënt en omgeving;
  • stemt af met verwijzers en vervolgplekken om continuïteit van zorg te waarborgen;
  • begeleidt A(N)IOS en draagt bij aan opleiding en zorgontwikkeling;

Binnen de HIBZ ligt de focus niet op uitgebreide diagnostiek of resocialisatie, maar op het keren van de crisis en het herstellen van behandelbaarheid.

Wij bieden jou
Wij bieden een betekenisvolle functie in een unieke en hooggespecialiseerde behandelomgeving, waarin je echt impact maakt.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • een contract van 24 tot 36 uur, met mogelijkheid tot uitbreiding van uren bij aanvullende taken;
  • arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de MSR en CAO GGZ, met een salaris tussen € 6691,- en € 14115,- bruto per maand op basis van 36-45 uur;
  • een eindejaarsuitkering en vakantiegeld van 8,33% en pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn;
  • volledige OV-vergoeding of een vergoeding voor eigen vervoer;
  • ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling via opleidingen en supervisie;
  • deelname aan vitaliteitsprogramma’s en een jaarlijks vitaliteitsbudget van € 100,-;
  • een werkplek met eigen parkeerterrein en toegang tot activiteiten via Nrgize, zoals yoga en bootcamp;
  • een aanbrengbonus van € 1000,- wanneer je een nieuwe collega aandraagt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • je hebt de opleiding tot psychiater afgerond of bent in de afrondende fase;
  • je hebt affiniteit met cliënten met complexe en ontwrichtende psychiatrische problematiek;
  • je kunt werken in een hoog intensieve en beveiligde setting en houdt overzicht in crisissituaties;
  • je beschikt over inlevingsvermogen en overtuigingskracht en werkt vanuit een herstelgerichte visie;
  • je weet wanneer nabijheid nodig is en wanneer begrenzing essentieel is;
  • je hebt gevoel voor humor en relativeringsvermogen in samenwerking met collega’s en cliënten.

Het aanleveren van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag is onderdeel van de aanstellingsprocedure.

Werken bij ons
De HIBZ biedt hooggespecialiseerde, kortdurende zorg aan cliënten met ernstige psychiatrische aandoeningen die in een acute crisis verkeren. De afdeling richt zich op het afwenden van escalatie, het herstellen van contact en het creëren van veiligheid. Door intensieve samenwerking binnen het behandelteam en met verwijzers wordt gewerkt aan een snelle terugkeer naar de reguliere behandeling. De kracht van de HIBZ ligt in het combineren van nabijheid en duidelijke kaders, waardoor cliënten weer in beweging komen. Er werken meerdere psychiaters in de kliniek dus er is altijd ruimte om te sparren met collega's.

Binnen Inforsa werken we vanuit de kernwaarden verbinding, vertrouwen en verantwoordelijkheid. Samen met andere specialismen binnen Arkin zorgen we voor passende zorg, juist ook wanneer de complexiteit hoog is.

Meer weten over deze vacature?
Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Jorim den Hertog, manager bedrijfsvoering, op 0629476097 of met Elvira van Vliet, manager behandelzaken, op 652711213. Zij vertellen je graag meer over de functie en de werkomgeving.

Ben je enthousiast geworden van de vacature, reageer dan snel via de Sollicitatie button!

Na ontvangst van je sollicitatie nemen wij contact met je op voor een eerste kennismaking. Vervolgens plannen we een gesprek in en leren we elkaar beter kennen. We zijn benieuwd naar jouw ervaring en vertellen je graag meer over werken bij Arkin.

title: Murer til fliser og betonarbejde i Nibe
description:
Vil du som murer have firmabil, frihed og sjovt at gå på arbejde?

Her får du fliser, nybyg, renovering og beton i hverdagen.

Du lander på et mindre murerhold, hvor arbejdet skifter mellem private kunder og erhverv. Opgaverne spænder fra fliser og renovering til nybyg og beton, så du skal kunne lide at bruge flere sider af faget. Pladserne ligger i Nibe og omegn, og aftalerne med kunderne skal holde, så de ved hvor projektet står.

Du får frihed under ansvar, men det betyder ikke at du står alene med alt. Nogle dage tager du selv fat på opgaven, andre dage arbejder du med makker eller i sjak. Her tæller det, at du er stabil, siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer og afleverer arbejde du kan være bekendt.

Det får du

Løn: 190-220 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Nibe og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 5 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Fliser, nybyg og renovering

Din hverdag

På pladsen tager du fat i det der er aftalt, hvad enten dagen står på fliser, støbning eller renovering. Du afstemmer rækkefølgen med den du arbejder sammen med, og når opgaven ændrer sig, får du det meldt videre.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Lægger fliser i forbindelse med renovering og nybyg
  • Arbejder med nybyg i både boliger og erhverv
  • Renoverer murværk og følger opgaven til den er afleveringsklar
