title: Pladsmedarbejdere til Ballerup
description:
Vil du have et alsidigt job, hvor du spiller en vigtig rolle i at holde byggepladsen kørende og skabe en sikker og effektiv arbejdsplads?

Så er du måske en af vores kommende pladsmedarbejdere til vores byggeplads i Ballerup, hvor vi opfører 121 lejligheder.

Om jobbet

Som pladsmedarbejder er du med til at holde orden på byggepladsen og fungerer som byggeledelsens ekstra øjne. Du løser forskellige praktiske opgaver, arbejder selvstændigt, tager ejerskab og planlægger din hverdag i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger i byggeledelsen.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være:

  • Pladslogistik og koordinering på pladsen

  • Modtagelse og aflæsning af materialeleverancer

  • Daglig oprydning og generel vedligehold

  • At holde øje med sikkerheden og melde ind, hvis noget skal udbedres

  • Opstilling og nedtagning af udstyr på byggepladsen

Dine kompetencer

  • Ordenssans og ansvarsbevidst

  • Både god til at samarbejde og arbejde selvstændigt

  • Fordel med håndværksmæssig erfaring og kendskab til byggebranchen samt arbejdsgange og sikkerhed på en byggeplads

  • Godt overblik og godt humør

  • Kørekort B, truckkort og teleskoplæssercertifikat

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast fuldtidsstilling med opstart til hhv. september og november

  • En afvekslende arbejdsdag med mange forskellige opgaver

  • Et team af kompetente og humørfyldte kolleger

  • Mulighed for at udvikle faglige og personlige kompetencer

  • Firmabil og værktøj

  • Løn efter overenskomst

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Projektchef, Peter Benedikt Nielsen, på tlf.: 23 10 19 59.

Upload dit CV snarest muligt via linket. Vi holder samtaler løbende og afslutter stillingsopslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Birch Ejendomme ønsker at afspejle samfundet omkring os, samt fremme mangfoldighed og ligestilling. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge stillingen.

Om Birch Ejendomme

Birch Ejendomme blev stiftet i 2010 og er i dag blandt Danmarks førende boligudviklere med speciale i rækkehuse og etagebyggeri i hele landet. Vi er omkring 190 dedikerede medarbejdere fordelt på vores kontorer i Silkeborg og Høje Taastrup samt på byggepladser i hele Danmark. Vores fokus er på kvalitet, effektivt samarbejde og høj professionalisme inden for alle arbejdsområder.

Vi prioriterer trivsel og et stærkt fællesskab - både i hverdagen og gennem sociale arrangementer. Vores arbejdskultur er præget af ordentlighed, høj faglighed og gensidig respekt, og vi tror på, at et sundt arbejdsmiljø er en forudsætning for langsigtet succes.

title: Circle K Täby Galopp söker butikssäljare på heltid
description:
Vart är du på väg?

Nu söker vi butikssäljare – ja, alltså riktiga servicehjältar!

Vi vill bli världsbäst på service. Och därför söker vi nu fler servicehjältar. Vad gör en sådan? Jo, du möter våra kunders behov med kunskap, fingertoppskänsla och ett härligt leende – ofta samtidigt som du kanske fyller på kaffemaskinen eller lägger upp en korv. För vi är en butikskedja som erbjuder allt från god mat och bakverk, till bra drivmedel och fräscha toaletter. Är du vår nästa talang? Då hittar du vänner för livet här på Circle K.

Vi söker nu dig som vill jobba som butikssäljare hos oss på Circle K Täby Galopp. Tjänsten är på heltid och är tillsvidare med inledande provanställning på sex månader. Schemat för denna tjänst är rullande på tre veckor, morgon,dag kväll och var tredje helg. Ensamarbete förekommer. För att vara aktuell för tjänsten hos oss behöver du ha körkort. Som butikssäljare hos oss har du en månadslön som baseras på din tidigare erfarenhet inom service. Månadslönen vid heltidsarbete varierar mellan 27400-33065 kr/månad. Utöver din månadslön får du extra OB-ersättning för arbete under kvällar, helger och röda dagar. Eftersom vi har en CV-lös och fördomsfri rekrytering behöver du styrka din tidigare erfarenhet genom att uppvisa arbetsgivarintyg under rekryteringsprocessen. För att söka tjänsten fyller du enkelt i dina uppgifter, anger vilka tider du kan arbeta och genomför därefter ett kort servicetest som tar cirka 10 minuter. Är du vår nya butikssäljare som gillar varierande arbetsuppgifter och att ge service utöver det vanliga? Vi jobbar med löpande urval i rekryteringen så sök tjänsten omgående för att inte missa chansen!

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan senast 11.08.2026

Om dig:

  • Du är en teamplayer – du sätter laget före jaget.
  • Du är en fixare – du hittar lösningar på allt.
  • Du älskar människor.
  • Du är en allkonstnär: Du gillar att ha koll på allt, och tycker om att göra många saker samtidigt.
  • Du vill lära dig nya saker och utvecklas, kanske är du redo för mer ansvar.
  • Du har förmodligen arbetat inom service och är redo för nästa steg i karriären.
  • Du pratar och förstår svenska.
  • Du är över 18 år.

Om oss:

  • Vi är en plantskola för social skills – vi lägger en bra grund för alla framtida yrken. Och du får ett snyggt CV!
  • För dig som redan kommit en bit i yrkeslivet kan vi erbjuda ett utvecklande och mångsidigt jobb.
  • Du får kunskap om hur det är att driva butik.
  • Du lär dig att bli en ledare med förståelse för service.
  • Du får specialistkunskap – vi kan allt från att driva butik och sälja drivmedel, till marknadsföring och ledarskap.
  • Du får en möjlighet till att göra karriär inom företaget – kanske vill du driva din egen butik, eller sikta mot ett jobb på vårt huvudkontor.
  • Du får ett roligt jobb med härliga kollegor.
  • Vi är ett internationellt företag med kollegor runt omkring i hela världen.
  • Våra stationer kan ha biluthyrning, då är körkort B-manuell ett krav.
  • Vi erbjuder dig ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag och personalrabatt på alla våra stationer.

Circle K är ett framgångsrikt globalt företag med mer än 17 300 butiker i 27 länder. Totalt har vi cirka 150 000 anställda som arbetar i våra butiker och på kontoren. Vårt nätverk består av butiker som drivs både i bolags- och franchisedrift. Vår kultur och våra värderingar: One Team, Take Ownership, Play to Win och Do the Right Thing är grunden i allt vi gör. Vi vill göra det enkelt för våra kunder längs vägen genom att erbjuda bra produkter och snabb service i världsklass.

För den här tjänsten krävs att du antingen är medborgare i Sverige, ett annat nordiskt land eller ett EU/EES-land, har permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige, eller är asylsökande med giltig rätt att arbeta. Under rekryteringsprocessen behöver du kunna visa upp handlingar som styrker ditt medborgarskap eller din arbetsrätt i Sverige.

Vi förbehåller oss rätten att göra bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidater i rekryteringsprocessen.

title: Program Management Engineer
description:
Custom Team at Texas Instruments is looking for an experienced, highly driven Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional custom development programs that bring innovative semiconductor products from concept to production.

In this role, you will work closely with systems, design, operations, marketing & sales, post-silicon validation, test, quality, and very demanding customer teams to ensure successful execution of schedules, deliverables, and business goals.

Key Responsibilities

Program Ownership

  • Being in custom development for demanding customers, execution efficacy, timeline adherence, quality control and stakeholder management need to be ensured by the Program Manager.
  • Lead end-to-end program planning, execution, and delivery for analog/mixed-signal/embedded semiconductor products.
  • Drive program scope, timelines, risk assessment, budgeting, and resource planning.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Coordinate with design, DV, layout, post-Si validation, test engineering, quality, packaging, manufacturing, supply chain, marketing and operations teams across global sites.
  • Facilitate program reviews, technical checkpoints, and decision gates.

Schedule & Risk Management

  • Create and maintain detailed program schedules using appropriate tools.
  • Identify risks early, develop mitigation plans, and ensure teams stay aligned to program objectives.

Customer & Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Present program status, key metrics, and critical issues to leadership and customers.

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure programs meet TI’s quality, reliability, and regulatory standards along with customer mandated quality checks. Coordinate root cause analysis and corrective actions when needed.

Operational & Business Support

  • Collaborate with product line management on go-to-market strategies.
  • Monitor cost, yield, and performance targets throughout the product lifecycle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of program/project management experience in semiconductors, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing.
  • Experience managing SoC/ASIC/analog/mixed-signal or embedded product development programs (depending on team).
  • Strong understanding (experience preferred) of semiconductor development flows: architecture → design → validation → test → quality checks → release to production.
  • Proficiency with program management tools (Jira, MS Project, Confluence, etc.).
  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

title: Functional Safety V & V Senior Engineer
description:
What you'll do...

You will assist teams in the development and execution of functional safety V&V strategies and their work products to develop a comprehensive Safety Case.

You will work with Ford Connected Vehicle Software and Product Data Integrity, and supplier engineering teams to identify safety related process and work product gaps and recommend best practice solutions.

You will develop a FuSa V&V capability maturity plan working with engineering stakeholders.

You will report to the Director of the Office of Functional Safety Assurance (OFSA).

We have two roles within this posting.

Key difference with Role 1: Focus on AI tools and software

Key difference with Role 2: Focus on verification and validation plans, methods, tools, and results.

You'll have...

  • FuSa Technical Leadership: Apply, demonstrate and champion best in class methods, tools, practices to ensure embedded software achieves safety.
  • FuSa Software V&V Health Dashboard Ownership: Lead the development of the FuSa Software Health Dashboard for the enterprise, including its metrics and criteria for maturity. Develop AI enhanced tracking and analytic tools to determine status and priority actions.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product engineering, program management, validation and verification, software, hardware, design, integration, quality, and architecture to drive maturity of enterprise FuSa Health metrics.
  • FuSa Software related escapes: Apply system engineering, risk analysis, trouble shooting and root cause analysis methods to find software related issues and close the loop to process, methods and tools gaps.
  • Alignment of FuSa and Quality Assurance: Align and exploit synergies with SQA where this helps drive FuSa maturity.
  • Continuous improvement: Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize software development and deployment processes, tools, and methodologies, enhancing effectiveness.
  • Communication: Provide consistent health status, insights, risks and opportunities to executive leadership and stakeholders.

You'll have...

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in embedded automotive safety software verification.
  • Technical expertise: Demonstrable deep understanding of ISO-26262 Part 6 e.g. software requirements analysis, decomposition, allocation, verification. Software architectural design, safety analysis, safety mechanism design and implementation, software unit test, integration and verification, FFI, DFA, software design practices to ensure safety, software structural design and verification, the inter-relationship between software, hardware and systems engineering as it relates to the safety lifecycle. Use of AI in embedded software development and verification.
  • Experienced with tools commonly used in safety software test including requirements analysis, IDEs, static code analysis, code complexity metrics, code and requirement coverage, MISRA and Safe C rules checkers, debuggers, configuration management, change control, CI/CD pipelines, regression test, SIL, HIL, MIL. Model based software development. Development of software test strategies including fault injection.
  • Working knowledge of ISO-26262 Part 3,4 Concept and Systems Engineering process, tools, methods, including HARA, HAZOP, Functional Safety Concept. Able to understand the translation of systems work products into software.
  • Communication & collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage with cross-functional teams, external partners, and stakeholders to drive successful feature system development projects.
  • Leadership: Leadership abilities, with a track record of initiative and problem solving, delivering high-quality software that meets safety, security, and performance objectives.

Even better, you may have...

  • Master's degree in a technical or Management field to broaden scope of activities
  • FuSa Professional Accreditation: UL, TUV, Exida or equivalent.
  • Additional experience in Systems, Hardware development for Safety applications in a complementary fashion
  • Experience with software related standards development
  • Strategic and systemic thinking: Demonstrated ability to comprehend end-to-end systems of systems, apply systemic thinking, critical thinking, and strategic reasoning to identify opportunities, rapidly understand complex concerns, provide alternative solutions, and drive strategy from concept through to production
  • Adaptability: Comfort with ambiguity, with a demonstrated ability to structure an approach to complex problems and drive clarity on solutions
  • Innovation: Understand and drive innovation and change in processes, engineering excellence, quality, and efficiency
  • Continuous improvement mindset: A drive for a system approach to design and development, coupled with a desire and curiosity to strive for exceptional delivery execution and continuous improvement

description:

Join our Financial Crime Surveillance team and help make a real difference in the fight against financial crime. You'll work with large and complex datasets from a range of sources, turning raw information into meaningful insights that help detect, prevent and respond to financial crime risks.

You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to innovative AI initiatives and help shape how data is used to strengthen Westpac's financial crime prevention capabilities. What do I need?

We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:

title: IT Infrastructure Cloud Engineer
description:
Title: Senior Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer

About Eurofins

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company providing analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries. With a global presence and a commitment to innovation, Eurofins supports customers in ensuring the safety, authenticity, and sustainability of products and services worldwide.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer to join our Core Infrastructure Project Engineering team. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer passionate about building, automating, and operating reliable enterprise-scale infrastructure across hybrid and multi cloud environments.

As part of a Core Infra team, primarily responsible for the engineering, configuration, installation, and maintenance of; Windows physical and virtual servers, Active Directory, Azure cloud and on-prem environments based on Hyper-V/VMWare, storage, backups, and disaster recovery planning. We rely on our engineers to empower our users with high availability, excellent performance levels and key services. Ideally, we are seeking an experienced project engineer to deliver insights and guidance as we design, build, and operate state-of-the-art multi-cloud infrastructures. Of most interest to us is someone who brings ideas and solutions, a lateral thinker, demonstrates a unique and informed viewpoint, and enjoys collaborating with a cross-functional team to develop real-world IT service. .

What You'll Do

  • Deliver enterprise infrastructure projects involving Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, PKI, Storage, Backup, VMware, and Hyper-V technologies.
  • Lead migration, transformation, and modernization initiatives across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure solutions aligned with business and architectural requirements.
  • Drive automation and Infrastructure-as-Code adoption using PowerShell, Terraform, and Ansible technologies.
  • Collaborate with Architects on technical designs, migration plans, implementation procedures, and project documentation.
  • Collaborate with global infrastructure, security, and application teams to execute complex cross-functional projects.
  • Contribute to cloud adoption, identity modernization, datacenter transformation, and infrastructure standardization programs.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to improve service delivery, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure successful project execution through planning, testing, deployment, knowledge transfer to platform support team, and stakeholder engagement.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise Microsoft infrastructure administration and engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server environments.
  • Proven experience managing Microsoft Active Directory.
  • 4+ years of experience supporting Microsoft Azure infrastructure services.
  • Experience with GCP & AWS Cloud platforms is an added benefit
  • Experience with virtualization technologies such as Hyper-V and VMware.
  • Experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery, and infrastructure monitoring solutions.

Technical Skills

We are looking for candidates with experience in several of the following areas:

  • Windows Server administration and engineering
  • Microsoft Active Directory
  • Microsoft Entra ID administration
  • Microsoft PKI Services
  • Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud services
  • Virtualization technologies (Hyper-V and VMware)
  • Core infrastructure services such as DNS, DHCP, and NPS
  • PowerShell scripting and infrastructure automation
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
  • Exposure to configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible
  • Linux system administration
  • Enterprise monitoring, alerting, and observability platforms
  • Backup and disaster recovery solutions
  • Azure IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS services
  • Storage technologies and infrastructure management
  • Troubleshooting and root cause analysis of complex infrastructure issues

Additional Technical Knowledge

Experience or exposure in the following areas is considered a strong advantage:

  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins
  • Bare-metal server administration (iLO, iDRAC, firmware management)
  • Security and identity management best practices

Professional Competencies

We are looking for someone who:

  • Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Has a curious and proactive mindset focused on reliability, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Takes ownership and drives initiatives from concept to implementation.
  • Works collaboratively across regional and international teams.
  • Maintains high standards of documentation and operational excellence.
  • Excellent writing and communication skills (fluent spoken and written English); excellent interpersonal skills and able to interact and work efficiently with people at all levels in an organization (internal employees and customers, contractors, managers, third parties, etc.).
  • Familiarity with relevant regulatory requirements (GxP, HIPAA, GDPR, …) is a plus
  • Knowledge of laboratory (regulated/controlled environment) operations and processes is a plus
  • Apply curiosity and technological intellect to analyze emerging concepts and make necessary recommendations to achieve transformational results in Deployments, Application & Infrastructure Support, and Automation Setup and Implementation.

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified Professional certifications (Azure, Windows Server, Identity, or Security).
  • VMware certifications.
  • Terraform Associate certification.
  • ITIL Foundation certification (Nice to have)

title: Associate Account Director
description:
About the role

We're looking for an Associate Account Director to drive RetailNext's commercial growth across EMEA, with a focus on our expanding market in Italy. This is an early-career commercial role for someone who wants to learn the full sales cycle from the inside — building pipeline, supporting deals end to end, helping existing customers grow, and lending a hand on marketing in-region.

You'll work directly with our regional sales team and partner closely with our Head of EMEA, who provides commercial and customer guidance across the region. The right person is hungry, organized, and proactive: comfortable picking up the phone, chasing leads, and creating commercial momentum without waiting to be asked. You're energized by closing the gap between a prospect and a customer, and you care about getting the details right.

This is a launchpad role for someone who wants a career in sales. You'll get broad commercial exposure in a fast-growing market, with real runway to grow into a quota-carrying sales role as you find your footing.

Reports to: Head of Sales (dotted line to Head of EMEA)

Location: Remote — based in Italy, with the right to work in-region

Salary range: €65,000–€75,000 gross per year, plus commission

What You'll Do

Pipeline Generation & Outbound

  • Own targeted outbound outreach to identify, qualify, and book meetings with new prospects across Italy
  • Research target accounts and build prioritized prospect lists aligned to regional growth goals
  • Follow up relentlessly on inbound and marketing-generated leads to keep the top of the funnel healthy

Sales Support & Deal Execution

  • Keep the regional sales team and the Head of EMEA moving on day-to-day commercial activity — preparing materials, tracking follow-ups, and pushing deals toward close

Existing Customers & Partner Support

  • Track relationships with existing EMEA customers, surface renewal and expansion signals, and act on them alongside the sales team
  • Coordinate joint activity with regional partners and keep those relationships running smoothly

Marketing Support

  • Contribute to regional marketing efforts — events, campaigns, and localized content for the Italian market
  • Coordinate RetailNext's presence at regional trade shows and customer events
  • Feed on-the-ground insight back to the marketing team on what resonates in-region

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Some experience in a sales, business development, or commercial role — early-career candidates welcome, but you should be excited about a sales career
  • Comfortable and confident with outbound outreach: cold calls, emails, and talking to prospects and customers
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail — you keep deals and follow-ups on track
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Based in Italy with the right to work in-region; Italian language fluency strongly preferred

Valued but Not Required

  • Prior experience with a CRM platform such as Salesforce or HubSpot
  • Exposure to SaaS, retail technology, or enterprise software sales
  • An existing network of contacts in the Italian retail or tech sector

What We Offer

  • Direct, hands-on mentorship from RetailNext's Head of EMEA as you learn the full sales cycle

title: Request for Proposal Production Agency for  Success Story Development Mzazi Hodari III Programme
description:
Who We Are

Girl Effect is an international non-profit organisation that creates media, technology and behaviour change interventions that equip adolescent girls and young women with the knowledge, confidence and skills to improve their health, education and livelihoods.

In Tanzania, Girl Effect delivers programmes through its youth brand Tujibebe, which uses radio, social media, digital platforms and community engagement to promote positive health, parenting and behaviour change.

This consultancy supports the Mzazi Hodari III programme, which promotes responsive caregiving, early childhood development and positive parenting behaviours among young parents and caregivers.

Background

Mzazi Hodari III is a one-year extension programme designed to improve nurturing care practices for children under three years by encouraging:

  • Early initiation of breastfeeding
  • Exclusive breastfeeding
  • Responsive caregiving
  • Positive parenting practices
  • Appropriate health-seeking behaviour
  • Improved child nutrition

As the programme concludes, Girl Effect seeks to document programme impact through compelling multimedia success stories demonstrating behavioural change among programme participants and showcasing the effectiveness of the programme's Social and Behaviour Change (SBC) approach.

Assignment Objective

Girl Effect Tanzania seeks to engage a qualified Production Agency to conceptualise, film, edit and deliver three high-quality success story products that demonstrate the impact of the Mzazi Hodari III programme.

The agency will work closely with Girl Effect's Creative Team throughout pre-production, production and post-production to ensure all deliverables align with Girl Effect's creative, safeguarding and brand standards.

What You’ll Do

Mzazi Hodari III is a one-year extension project focused on improving children’s health by encouraging responsive caregiving, early breastfeeding, and promoting positive parenting behaviors through media content across radio, social media, IVR, and on-the-ground interventions.

The goal of Mzazi Hodari III is to increase knowledge and practices around nurturing care for children under three, particularly in areas like early breastfeeding, responsive caregiving, and child health care. We aim to:

  • Improve knowledge about health-seeking behaviors among adolescent girls and young women (AGYW) who are non-caregivers.
  • Shift perceptions by highlighting the positive outcomes associated with good health practices.
  • Increase self-efficacy among AGYW to engage confidently in caregiving and health-related decisions.

Deliverables

The successful agency will produce the following outputs:

Deliverable Description

Becoming Mzazi Hodari 2-minute documentary following three young parents

SBC in Action Written success story and accompanying short social media reel

60 Seconds of Impact One-minute donor-focused impact video

Behind-the-scenes Footage Raw footage and photography

Raw Video Files All original production files

Final Edited Assets High-resolution versions suitable for digital distribution

Girl Effect Responsibilities

Girl Effect will:

  • Provide programme background and creative brief.
  • Facilitate introductions to beneficiaries and partners.
  • Coordinate safeguarding onboarding.
  • Provide brand guidelines.
  • Supply monitoring and evaluation results.
  • Review and approve all creative outputs.
  • Coordinate final dissemination.

Who You Are

Essential

The agency should demonstrate:

  • Minimum four years' experience in professional video production.
  • Proven experience producing documentaries or success stories.
  • Strong storytelling capability.
  • Experience filming in community settings.
  • Professional filming and audio equipment.
  • Capacity to operate in Arusha and surrounding regions.

Desirable

Preference will be given to agencies with:

  • Experience working with NGOs or development partners.
  • Experience producing behaviour change communication content.
  • Knowledge of safeguarding and ethical storytelling.
  • Strong understanding of Tanzanian cultural contexts.

Assignment Schedule

  • Phase 1: Creative briefing and pre-production
  • Phase 2: First production shoot ("Before")
  • Phase 3: Second production shoot ("After")
  • Phase 4: Editing and review
  • Phase 5: Final delivery of all assets
  • Detailed production dates will be agreed during contract inception.

Proposal Submission

Interested agencies should submit:

Technical Proposal (Maximum 5 Pages)

The proposal should include:

  • Understanding of the assignment.
  • Proposed creative approach.
  • Production methodology.
  • Workplan and timeline.
  • Team structure.
  • Relevant experience.
  • Links to previous documentary or impact storytelling work.
  • Three client references.

Financial Proposal

Submitted separately and including:

  • Professional fees.
  • Pre-production costs.
  • Production costs.
  • Post-production costs.
  • Travel and logistics.
  • Applicable taxes.
  • Any assumptions or exclusions.

Evaluation Criteria

The criteria against which proposals will be evaluated are listed below.

  • All deliverables produced under this assignment shall become the intellectual property of Girl Effect.
  • Payment shall be linked to satisfactory completion of agreed deliverables.

title: Director, Enterprise Continuity (FTC)
description:
About CLS:

CLS is the trusted party at the centre of the global FX ecosystem. Utilized by thousands of counterparties, CLS makes FX safer, smoother and more cost effective. Trillions of dollars’ worth of currency flows through our systems each day.

Created by the market for the market, our unrivalled global settlement infrastructure reduces systemic risk and provides standardization for participants in many of the world’s most actively traded currencies. We deliver huge efficiencies and savings for our clients: in fact, our approach to multilateral netting shrinks funding requirements by over 96% on average, so clients can put their capital and resources to better use.

CLS products are designed to enable clients to manage risk most effectively across the full FX lifecycle – whether through more efficient processing tools or market intelligence derived from the largest single source of FX executed data available to the market.

Our ambition to make a positive difference starts with our people. Our values underpin everything that we do at CLS and define our working environment:

  • Pivotal purpose
  • Trusted guardian
  • Targeted innovation
  • Facilitate connections
  • Delivering excellence
  • Inclusive culture

Job information:

  • Functional title – Director – Enterprise Continuity (FTC)
  • Department – Enterprise Continuity
  • Corporate level - Director
  • Report to – Executive Director – Enterprise Continuity
  • Location - London
  • Base pay / salary (New York) -

What you will be doing:

As a systemically important financial market utility, the operational resilience posture of CLS is inextricably tied to the wellbeing of the global financial infrastructure. While CLS enjoys a strong and demonstrable history of resilience of its platforms and operating environments, the need for CLS to maintain, monitor and improve the resilience of its services, demands an increased focus and maturity in the way in which CLS considers Resilience. One of CLS’ top prioritise is Resilience.

CLS has a requirement for a senior role to support the development of Enterprise-wide Continuity within the context of the evolving Enterprise Resilience regulatory requirements and industry best practises. This role will report to the ED Enterprise Continuity, helping to make CLS’ resilience industry leading.

Supporting the design and delivery of an industry leading Enterprise Continuity program within the overall Enterprise Resilience function.

Develop internal and external stakeholder support for critical initiatives.

The successful candidate with be experienced engaging with Regulators and Senior Management.

The candidate will be required to lead change across the organization as CLS matures the resilience function. This will require creativity, ideation, industry credibility, experience, strong verbal and written influencing skills along with empathy and the ability to understand others and their positions.

A proactive, change mindset always thinking how to balance service, risk and investment in the service of the corporate strategy.

The candidate will

  • Support the delivery of the Enterprise Continuity programme for CLS.
  • Identify the CLS critical internal business services and associated Impact Tolerances.
  • Lead the mapping and scenario testing of the critical internal business services to identify vulnerabilities.
  • Design and deliver the resilience tooling and dashboarding for CLS.
  • Deliver a programme of internal resilience improvement initiatives.
  • Support the transformation of the current BCM capabilities to deliver industry leading, continuity solutions.
  • Plan and deliver staff training and testing of various resilience capabilities.
  • Prepare inputs for relevant governance bodies.
  • Support the management of the Enterprise Continuity teams risk and controls environment.
  • Support the design and execution of the enterprise wide Strategic BIA across all operational assets.
  • Participate in the strategic and existential threat continuity planning at an enterprise level.
  • Enhance the capability and enterprise utility of the BIA, mapping data and tooling.

Lead engagements internally and externally including at Executive Management.

What we’re looking for:

The candidate shall have the following experience:

  • Experience delivering industry leading operational continuity and/or resilience within the context of cutting edge GSIB and FMI practices and customer expectations.
  • Experienced in business process mapping and using these capabilities to produce MI.
  • Experience of designing and implementing Operational Resilience metrics & reporting.
  • Experience of using Fusion Risk Management.
  • Experience across technology, third party, facilities and people risk analysis and mitigation.
  • Experience in the design and delivery of resilience scenario testing and associated vulnerability identification and remediation;
  • Experience engaging at a GSIB / FMI level with lead and global regulators.
  • Experience influencing change at a C-Suite.
  • Experience analyzing and delivering enterprise change
  • Experience managing enterprise level strategic continuity planning including Cyber, Resolution, Pandemic, Change
  • A history of Operational Risk analysis, specifically in the Resilience domain.
  • Good understanding of FX products and services with knowledge of the required infrastructure and dependencies.
  • Experience in the delivery of projects providing solutions across the breadth of a company’s operations; business process, technology solutions, cyber remediation, third party risk etc.

Professional qualifications / certifications

Recognized qualifications in the following areas will be beneficial:

  • Financial regulation
  • Resilience / BCM
  • Operational / Enterprise Risk Management
  • Project Management (e.g Prince / PMI / APM)
  • Cyber Management (e.g. CISM)

Our commitment to employees:

At CLS, we celebrate inclusion and consider this to be one of our strongest assets. We are committed to fostering an environment in which everyone feels comfortable to be who they are, and inclusion is valued. All employees have access to our inclusive benefits, including:

  • Holiday - UK/Asia: 25 holiday days and 3 ‘life days’ (in addition to bank holidays). US: 23 holiday days.
  • 2 paid volunteer days so that you can actively support causes within your community that are important to you.
  • Generous parental leave policies to ensure you can enjoy valuable time with your family.
  • Parental transition coaching programmes and support services.
  • Wellbeing and mental health support resources to ensure you are looking after yourself, and able to support others.
  • Employee Networks (including our Women’s Forum, Black Employee Network and Pride Network) in support of our organisational commitment to embrace and always be learning more about inclusivity.
  • Hybrid working to promote a healthy work/life balance, enabling employees to work collaboratively in the office when needed and work from home when they don’t.
  • Active support of flexible working for all employees where possible.
  • Monthly ‘Heads Down Days’ with no meetings across the whole company.
  • Generous non-contributory pension provision for UK/Asia employees, and 401K match from CLS for US employees.
  • Private medical insurance and dental coverage.
  • Social events that give you opportunities to meet new people and broaden your network across the organisation.
  • Annual flu vaccinations.
  • Discounts and savings and cashback across a wide range of categories including health and retail for UK employees.
  • Discounted Gym membership – Complete Body Gym Discount/Sweat equity program for US employees.
  • All employees have access to Discover – our comprehensive learning platform with 1000+ courses from LinkedIn Learning.
  • Access to frequent development sessions on a number of topics to help you be successful and develop your career at CLS.

title: Principal Product Manager, Matching & Monetisation
description:
As our next Principal Product Manager, Leads, you'll play a key role in helping us build the UK's go-to home improvement marketplace. Millions of homeowners come to Checkatrade to find a tradesperson they can trust, and hundreds of thousands of trades rely on us to win great work. Matching the two is the core of what we do, and trades paying for those leads is our biggest business line. You'll own that product end-to-end: how we match homeowners to the right trades, how we price and package what we offer, and how we grow the Opportunity Board, our fast-growing self-serve marketplace. It's a rare mix of product craft and real commercial ownership, and you'll set the vision, define what great looks like, and ship it.

Forget long lists, here’s what you’ll actually spend your time on:

  • Own the leads marketplace end-to-end: Matching, Monetisation and the Opportunity Board, with a clear vision for how they work together.

  • Grow the marketplace commercially, making smart trade-offs between growth, value to trades and long-term marketplace health.

  • Make matching smarter so the right job reaches the right trade, working closely with Data Science.

  • Evolve how we price and package leads, using dynamic pricing to unlock new value.

  • Scale the Opportunity Board into a major way trades win work.

  • Set and hold the quality bar for a world-class two-sided marketplace, building alignment and earning trust across Product, Data Science, Engineering and our commercial teams through delivery.

It’s not about ticking every box. It’s about turning up curious, ready to crack on. You’ll do well here if you bring:

  • Extensive experience in senior product roles, owning a revenue-generating or marketplace product at scale.

  • Marketplace depth: you understand liquidity, supply and demand, matching and distribution.

  • Commercial and pricing fluency, comfortable with dynamic pricing, packaging and subscription/pay-as-you-go economics, backed by strong analytical instincts and a habit of using data and experimentation to decide.

  • A track record of shipping: you drive delivery, remove blockers and move fast without dropping quality, with the vision and ambition to see where a marketplace should go and bring people with you.


We believe great work deserves great rewards. Here’s just a taste:

  • Competitive salary + annual bonus

  • Employee Share Programme

  • Health, well-being and learning support

  • Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme and Cycle Scheme

  • Birthday/Special day leave

  • 1 week’s paid charity leave and much more!

  • 1st stage interview with Hiring Manager interview with our Head of Monetisation

  • 2nd Stage interview with Panel interview with our VP Marketplace and a Principal Product Manager

  • Final stage interview includes a case study presentation with our VP Marketplace and Head of Monetisation

If this sounds like the place where you can do your best work, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box

At the moment, this role isn’t open to visa sponsorship applications.

We’re Checkatrade – the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business.

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.

title: Azure Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a talented and experienced Azure Platform Engineer to join our team and drive the design and implementation of cloud-based solutions. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in delivering secure, scalable, and highly available cloud platforms, primarily on Microsoft Azure, with the ability to contribute to AWS environments as well. This role requires a deep understanding of cloud networking concepts, containerization technologies, and automation practices to ensure efficient and reliable cloud infrastructure management.

• Design, build, administer, and maintain secure, scalable, resilient, and highly available cloud platforms
primarily on Microsoft Azure, with exposure to AWS being advantageous.
• Provision and manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices, primarily through
Terraform, ensuring consistency, repeatability, and compliance with organizational standards.
• Implement and maintain cloud networking solutions, including Hub-and-Spoke architectures,
ExpressRoute connectivity, VPNs, routing, firewalls, DNS, private networking, and zero-trust security
principles.
• Develop, enhance, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps to enable automated, reliable, and
secure application and infrastructure deployments.
• Collaborate with application development, architecture, security, networking, and operations teams to
deliver platform capabilities that support business and technology objectives.
• Build and maintain configuration management and automation solutions using Ansible, PowerShell,
Bash, Python, and related technologies.
• Design, deploy, and manage containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring scalability,
reliability, and operational excellence.
• Support and promote DevOps, DevSecOps, GitOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices across
engineering teams.
• Proactively identify, assess, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure, operating system, and platform
security vulnerabilities.
• Ensure all cloud platforms comply with banking security policies, regulatory requirements, governance
controls, and audit standards.
• Monitor platform health, availability, performance, capacity, and security using enterprise monitoring and
observability tools.
• Develop and maintain logging, metrics, alerting, and dashboard solutions to improve operational visibility
and incident response.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure, networking, platform, and deployment issues across
development, testing, and production environments.
• Raise awareness of operational and security risks by identifying, documenting, and escalating risks
through the bank's governance and risk management framework.
• Continuously evaluate platform architecture and recommend improvements to enhance reliability,
scalability, security, performance, and cost efficiency.
• Ensure cloud environments are operated in a cost-effective manner while maintaining required levels of
availability, resilience, and regulatory compliance.
• Support pre-production validation, release readiness reviews, operational acceptance testing, and
deployment activities.
• Produce and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, deployment
procedures, operational runbooks, standards, and support documentation.
• Stay current with emerging cloud technologies, industry trends, security threats, and platform engineering
best practices to drive continuous improvement and innovation.
• Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and coaching to junior engineers and contribute to the
development of engineering standards and best practices.
• Take end-to-end ownership of platform services, ensuring secure-by-design principles, operational
excellence, reliability, and service continuity across the cloud estate.

Strong hands-on experience in designing, provisioning, and managing enterprise-scale Azure cloud
environments, including Subscriptions, Management Groups, Resource Groups, Virtual Networks
(VNets), Subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs), User Defined Routes (UDRs), Azure Firewall,
Private Endpoints, Private DNS, Load Balancers, Application Gateways, Virtual Machines, and Identity
services.
• Good understanding of AWS cloud services and networking concepts (preferred).
• Strong expertise in cloud networking concepts, including Hub-and-Spoke architecture, ExpressRoute,
Site-to-Site VPN, DNS, IP addressing, routing, segmentation, security boundaries, and hybrid
connectivity.
• Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for automated provisioning,
configuration, and lifecycle management of cloud infrastructure.
• Hands-on experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible.
• Strong experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
• Good understanding of DevSecOps principles and integrating security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
• Strong expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as
Kubernetes (AKS preferred).
• Experience with GitOps methodologies and tools such as ArgoCD or Flux is highly desirable.
• Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, Linux Shell/Bash scripting, and Python.
• Good understanding of YAML-based configurations and automation frameworks.
• Knowledge of GoLang is an added advantage.
• Strong experience administering Linux and Windows Server operating systems in enterprise
environments.
• Experience with monitoring, observability, and logging platforms such as Azure Monitor, Prometheus,
Grafana, ELK Stack, Dynatrace, Logz.io, Splunk, or similar tools.
• Good understanding of SSL/TLS certificates, PKI concepts, encryption standards, and secure
communications.
• Strong understanding of cloud security best practices, vulnerability management, identity and access
management (IAM), secrets management, and compliance requirements.
• Experience implementing highly available, scalable, resilient, secure, and auditable platforms following
industry best practices.
• Strong understanding of platform reliability, disaster recovery, backup, business continuity, and
operational excellence principles.
• Experience working in Agile, Scrum, and traditional project delivery methodologies.
• Hands-on experience using source control systems such as Git and ticketing/project management tools
such as Jira, or Azure Boards.
• Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex
infrastructure and platform issues.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across
engineering, security, architecture, and business teams.
• Demonstrated ability to mentor junior engineers, promote engineering best practices, and drive
continuous improvement initiatives.
• Self-motivated team player with a proactive attitude, strong ownership mindset, and ability to
independently deliver technical projects and operational activities.

title: Strategy & Operations Associate
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Own

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions


Location

  • This role is based in Malaysia. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Malaysia office at least 3 days per week.


Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Gz-psycholoog Volwassenen - Utrecht Rijnzathe
description:
Wil jij graag een diverse cliëntpopulatie behandelen die een grote verscheidenheid aan psychische problematieken kent? Bij Mentaal Beter vind je een fijne balans tussen verbondenheid en autonomie en krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheden en vrijheid.

Dit ga je doen

Je behandelt een cliëntpopulatie die een grote verscheidenheid aan psychische problemen kent, waaronder bijvoorbeeld angst- en stemmingsstoornissen, PTSS en milde persoonlijkheidsproblematieken. De behandelingen worden over het algemeen kortdurend en individueel aangeboden en aangevuld door e-health. Waar mogelijk zetten we ook groepsbehandeling in.

  • Tijdens de behandelingen staat de hulpvraag van de cliënt centraal waarbij er zoveel mogelijk gebruik wordt gemaakt van evidence-based behandelmethodieken.

  • Ook het uitvoeren van diagnostiek zal mogelijk tot je takenpakket horen.

  • Daarnaast vervul je de rol van regiebehandelaar en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het geven van werkbegeleiding aan enkele basispsychologen en mogelijk aan piogs waar casuïstiek en persoonlijke ontwikkeling wordt besproken.

Dit bieden wij

We bieden een prettige werkplek waar we met elkaar omgaan op basis van vertrouwen en samenwerking, waar ruimte is voor creativiteit en ideeën binnen een organisatie die volop in groei is. Daarnaast:

  • Ontvang je van ons in eerste instantie een contract voor bepaalde tijd, met de intentie om jou daarna voor onbepaalde tijd aan onze organisatie te verbinden.

  • Bieden we je een salaris conform cao ggz in schaal 65.

  • Krijg je een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% van je jaarsalaris.

  • Ontvang je een jaarlijks balansbudget (zie pagina 28) van € 1000,- (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband).

  • Bouw je elk jaar opleidingsdagen op om je verder te ontwikkelen. Lees hier meer over ons opleidingsbeleid.

  • Heb je onbeperkt toegang tot onze HSK Flow app, met coaching, e‑healthmodules, webinars en Mental Fit Checks.

  • Bieden we meer aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een fietsplan, levensfase budget uren en een goede pensioenregeling. Ook faciliteren wij een laptop. Alle arbeidsvoorwaarden ontdek je hier.

Leer ons kennen

Over het team

Op onze locatie in de Rijnzathe werken we nauw samen in twee teams van (gz-psychologen, klinisch psychologen, basispsychologen, psychiaters, een psychomotorisch therapeut en een psychotherapeut. Ook loopt er op onze locatie bijna altijd een stagiaire en één of meerdere PIOG’s rond. We zien met onze enthousiaste en kundige collega’s veel cliënten binnen de basis en specialistische GGZ voor diverse individuele- en groepsbehandelingen. We hebben een leuke mix van collega’s die al langer in het werkveld zitten en collega’s die recente zijn gestart als behandelaar. Kenmerkend aan onze teams is dat we betrokken zijn bij elkaar, dat er veel gelachen kan worden en ook indien je daar behoefte aan hebt de mogelijkheid om regelmatig buiten werktijd wat te doen zoals een teamuitje of borrel.

We zijn een zelfsturend team. Dit biedt ons de mogelijkheid om organisatorisch e.a. op te pakken of bij te dragen. Hierdoor hebben we de mogelijkheid om indien wij dat wenselijk en noodzakelijk achten (uiteraard binnen de kaders) bijvoorbeeld nieuwe groepen op te starten. Kortom, een werkplek waar veel mogelijk is en er ook ruimte is voor gezelligheid!

Over Mentaal Beter

Zowel jong als oud kan bij ons terecht voor behandelingen in de generalistische basis ggz (gb-ggz) en specialistische ggz (s-ggz). We zijn gespecialiseerd in het behandelen van lichte tot matige klachten die te maken hebben met depressie, angststoornissen, trauma, ADHD, autisme en somatisch-symptoomstoornissen. Het verminderen van klachten is echter niet het enige waaraan wij werken: bij iedere behandeling zorgen we ervoor dat mensen groeien in hun zelfredzaamheid en weer de regie over hun eigen leven kunnen oppakken, ongeacht hun leeftijd. Klik hier als je meer wilt weten over Mentaal Beter.

Over Mental Care Group

Mentaal Beter is samen met HSK en Opdidakt onderdeel van Mental Care Group. Met meer dan 2000 medewerkers door het land zetten wij ons iedere dag in om de beste zorg te bieden aan onze cliënten, van jong tot oud en van Groningen tot Maastricht. Samen staan wij sterk voor een mentaal gezond, vitaal en veerkrachtig Nederland. Meer weten over Mental Care Group? Je leest het hier.

Binnen Mentaal Beter streven we naar een harmonieuze samenwerking tussen verschillende individuen, disciplines en expertises. Hierin vinden we in elk geval de volgende punten belangrijk:

  • Je bent geregistreerd gz-psycholoog en daarmee in het bezit van een BIG registratienummer.

  • Je hebt minimaal twee jaar ervaring als gz psycholoog.

  • Bij voorkeur heb je verschillende cursussen afgerond zoals; cognitieve gedragstherapie of EMDR.

  • Je werkt vanuit een visie op de moderne GGZ en je wilt bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van Mentaal Beter.

Werken bij Mentaal Beter

Enthousiast geworden?

Solliciteren kan via de sollicitatiebutton. Heb je vragen of wil je vrijblijvend kennismaken? Neem dan contact met mij op via onderstaande contactgegevens.

Goed om te weten:

  • Voor alle functies binnen Mental Care Group is een verklaring omtrent gedrag vereist. Tevens maakt het inwinnen van referenties onderdeel uit van het sollicitatieproces.

  • Er wordt geen einddatum gehanteerd. Zolang de vacature online staat, is deze nog actueel.

  • Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld en niet in behandeling genomen.

title: Diesel Aftertreatment Development Engineer
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

In this position...

Ford Motor Company is seeking an innovative and detail-oriented Diesel Catalyst Development Engineer/Scientist to advance the development of next-generation diesel emissions control catalyst technologies. This role involves generating critical experimental data on diesel catalyst devices—Diesel Oxidation Catalysts (DOC), Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR), Ammonia Slip Catalysts (ASC), and Diesel Particulate Filters (DPF)—using flow reactor systems and advanced analytical instrumentation. The successful candidate will apply deep knowledge of catalyst kinetics, mass transfer, and durability/aging mechanisms to support catalyst design, modeling, and validation efforts, contributing directly to Ford's commitment to environmental stewardship and sustainable mobility.

What you'll do...

Design, execute, and analyze bench-scale flow reactor experiments on small wash coated monolithic core samples (DOC, SCR, ASC, DPF) to generate high-quality catalyst performance data.

Operate and maintain flow reactor systems coupled with analytical instrumentation such as FTIR for gas-phase species quantification and reaction analysis.

Apply fundamental catalyst kinetics and mass transfer principles to interpret reactor data and identify kinetic- vs. diffusion-limited performance regimes.

Generate and structure experimental data to support kinetic parameter extraction and development of 1D catalyst/monolith performance models; experience developing 1D models independently is a strong plus.

Design and execute catalyst aging protocols (thermal, hydrothermal, chemical/poisoning) to evaluate durability and robustness under real-world conditions.

Perform or coordinate chemical/physical characterization of fresh and aged catalyst samples, including BET, SEM, Chemisorption, XRF, and XRD, to identify aging mechanisms and correlate with performance loss.

Apply Global Technology Development System (GTDS) methodology and structured problem-solving tools, including FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and 8D, to proactively identify catalyst failure modes and resolve technical issues.

Support DVP&R (Design Verification Plan and Report) development to ensure testing aligns with durability and performance requirements.

Facilitate technical dialogue and collaborative problem-solving with catalyst and substrate suppliers, including reviewing formulation/design changes, discussing performance and durability data, and driving joint resolution of technical issues.

Collaborate cross-functionally with modeling, catalyst design, systems engineering, and quality teams to translate experimental findings into actionable design and calibration decisions.

Deep understanding of global emissions regulatory requirements as they relate to catalyst performance and durability targets.

Document methodologies, results, and conclusions in technical reports and present findings to cross-functional and leadership audiences.

Stay abreast of emerging catalyst materials, characterization techniques, and modeling approaches to maintain Ford's leadership in clean propulsion systems.

You'll have...

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or a related field.

Minimum of 5 years of relevant industry or research experience in catalysis, emissions control, or related technical fields.

Hands-on experience with flow reactor systems and gas analysis techniques (FTIR, MS, GC, or similar).

Solid understanding of heterogeneous catalysis, reaction kinetics, and mass transfer principles.

Experience with catalyst characterization techniques (BET, SEM, XRD, XRF, chemisorption).

Working knowledge of structured problem-solving and quality methodologies (FMEA, 8D, or equivalent root-cause analysis tools).

Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and facilitate technical discussions with external catalyst and substrate suppliers.

Even better, you may have...

Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, or a related field (may be considered in lieu of a portion of the required experience).

In-depth knowledge of internal combustion engine emissions and aftertreatment technologies (e.g., DOC, SCR, ASC, and DPF).

Experience developing or applying 1D reactor/catalyst models (e.g., in MATLAB, Fortran, Python, or commercial modeling software).

Background in catalyst aging mechanisms and durability testing.

Direct experience working within a formal product/technology development process (GTDS or similar stage-gate system).

Certification or formal training in FMEA facilitation, 8D leadership, Six Sigma, or related quality methodologies.

Strong understanding of global emissions regulations for Diesel engines.

Existing relationships or prior direct experience working with catalyst/substrate supplier technical teams.

Track record of external publications or patents in the field of emissions control/catalysis.

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

title: Engineer - Airfield
description:
The WSP Aviation team is seeking an experienced Airfield Civil Engineer within our Indian office. The primary function of this role will be to support the Airfield Principal Engineer, however there will be potential to become a Senior Airfield Civil Engineer as the GCC Airfield Engineering team grows and develops. The successful candidate will be among one of the first members of this team and will form a crucial role in its growth and development. The Airfield Civil Engineer will be responsible in supporting delivering airfield civil engineering design and maintenance projects through various stages of design from feasibility/ option studies to detailed design and onto construction for various clients both in the UK and overseas.

The candidate will be required to:

  • Act as a Civil Airfield Engineer for airfield civil engineering projects.
  • Take ownership in the production of technical designs whilst giving technical leadership and mentorship to more junior engineers in the team.
  • Undertake the preparation of technical reports, calculations, drawings and specifications related to the delivery of airfield engineering projects in both the UK and overseas.
  • Contribute towards technical design reviews as required to meet the WSP quality management requirements.
  • Read and accurately interpret, review, amend and reproduce engineering drawings using AutoCAD and Civil 3D software.
  • Ability to manage drawing registers and revision control processes.
  • Respond to client directions in a professional and customer focused manner and to develop and maintain relationships with clients, peers and others who are influential in providing future business.
  • Actively participate in the design and take ownership in providing technical input to the design team throughout the full design process.
  • Effectively and confidently communicate and coordinate designs with team members, industry associates and Clients as required.
  • Identify and support in the management of design risks, issues and Request for Information (RFIs).
  • Support the Principal Airfield Civil Engineer as directed by monitoring and contributing to the development of appropriate project controls, including change management, information management and document control.
  • Follow the technical quality requirements, address the project brief and meet client deadlines.
  • Champion excellent health and safety in design.

The current team is diverse and well respected across the industry therefore the candidate is required to have sound technical abilities.

The successful candidate will be knowledgeable and experienced in Civil Engineering projects at airports and preferably have a degree in Civil Engineering.

Minimum Requirements

  • Civil engineering experience of working on large, technically complex airport projects from the detailed design and construction support stages.
  • Experience working within an engineering team in the delivery of technical aviation projects, sharing ideas and collaborating with colleagues and be able to demonstrate a time when you’ve managed to do this successfully to solve complex problems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills when providing design information or interacting with team members, industry associates and Clients, regardless of their technical abilities.
  • Competent self-discipline with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and prioritisation of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment to meet the needs of multiple projects and managers.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as part of a team to meet the technical and design objectives as directed by the Airfield Principal Engineer.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with strict deadlines.
  • Experience of international airfield design standards such as ICAO and FAA.
  • Knowledge and experience of using AutoCAD, Civil 3D and relevant other airfield engineering design software packages such as AviPlan, SkySafe and FAARFIELD is preferable but not essential.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Civil Engineering Degree or equivalent relevant qualification
  • Chartered or Incorporated Status (MICE, MCIHT or equivalent) or equivalent demonstrable experience is preferable but not essential.
  • Knowledge and experience of using Civil 3D and relevant other airfield engineering design software packages such as AviPlan, SkySafe and FAARFIELD is preferable but not essential.

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Senior Data Scientist – Graph Machine Learning
description:
The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist specializing in Graph AI to join our growing Data Science team. In this role, you will design and deploy production-grade graph machine learning solutions, working with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), graph databases, and large-scale datasets to solve complex real-world problems.

You will play a key role in shaping the company's Graph AI capabilities, collaborating with cross-functional teams and mentoring other data scientists while delivering innovative, business-impacting solutions.

The main responsibilities of the position include:

  • Design, develop, and deploy Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and graph-based machine learning solutions

  • Transform large, complex datasets into graph representations and extract actionable insights using advanced analytics, graph algorithms, and statistical techniques.

  • Drive the adoption of Graph AI across the organisation by identifying new use cases and contributing to the evolution of the company's data science strategy.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts and model outcomes clearly to both technical and business audiences.

  • Ensure high standards in data preparation, feature engineering, model evaluation, documentation, and code quality.

  • Leverage technologies such as Python, Graph Neural Networks, graph databases, modern ML frameworks, and cloud-based data platforms to build innovative data solutions

  • Ensure adherence to best practices in data quality, model monitoring, version control, and reproducible analytics

  • Lead and supervise a team of data scientists working on graph-related tasks

  • Partner closely with Data Engineers, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to translate business challenges into scalable Graph AI solutions.

Main requirements:

  • University degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field

  • At least 6 years of experience in data science, machine learning and AI, including hands-on experience in designing, training and optimising Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for production applications.

  • Experience working with relational and non-relational databases

  • Solid experience working with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Neptune) and proficiency in graph query languages (e.g., Cypher or Gremlin).

  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Plotly

  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with Pandas, NumPy, and similar data analysis libraries

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

  • Fluent in English

Benefit from:

  • Attractive remuneration package plus performance related reward

  • Private health insurance

  • Corporate pension fund

  • Intellectually stimulating work environment

  • Continuous personal development and international training opportunities

The Hiring Experience: What Awaits You

  • Let’s Connect – Intro Chat with Talent Acquisition

  • Deep Dive – First Interview with Your Future Team

  • Bring It to Life – Role-Specific Take-Home Task

  • Final Connection – Final Interview

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality!

title: Huishoudelijke hulp Grou en omliggende dorpen
description:
Word jij het zonnetje in huis? Kom werken als Huishoudelijke Hulp!

Werkgebied: Grou
Contract: 2-24 uur per week, flexibele werktijden

Bij Miep Huishoudservice en Begeleiding draait alles om het creëren van een écht thuisgevoel – niet alleen voor onze cliënten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je je gewaardeerd voelt, je werk met plezier doet en altijd de steun krijgt die je nodig hebt. Flexibiliteit, persoonlijke aandacht en een fijne werksfeer staan bij ons centraal!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Huishoudelijke Hulp bij Miep Huishoudservice zorg je ervoor dat onze cliënten zich thuis blijven voelen in hun eigen woning, ook als zij zelf niet meer volledig voor het huishouden kunnen zorgen. Jouw taken bestaan uit:

  • Schoonmaken, stofzuigen en andere huishoudelijke werkzaamheden.

  • Cliënten zoveel mogelijk betrekken bij het huishouden.

  • Persoonlijke aandacht en een luisterend oor bieden.

Jij maakt elke dag het verschil! Dankzij jouw hulp blijft het huis van onze cliënten schoon en fijn, waardoor zij langer zelfstandig kunnen blijven wonen. Een sociaal en dankbaar beroep waarin jij elke dag iets moois betekent voor een ander!

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ons bepaal jij je eigen werktijden en -dagen! Extra werken in de vakantie? Geen probleem! Je krijgt een salaris volgens de cao VVT, vanaf € 15,07 bruto per uur afhankelijk van ervaring, met jaarlijkse verhogingen tot € 18,27. Daarnaast ontvang je vakantiegeld (8%) en een eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%), die je ook maandelijks kunt laten uitbetalen. Ook bouw je pensioen op en kun je gebruikmaken van een collectieve zorgverzekering. Reiskosten (zoals auto, fiets, brommer of scooter) en reistijd tussen cliënten worden vergoed.

We investeren in jouw groei met een digitaal onboardingsprogramma via de MiepApp vol e-learnings. Wil je alvast een kijkje nemen? Klik dan hier. Je krijgt een contract voor bepaalde tijd met de intentie tot een vaste aanstelling. Twee keer per jaar organiseren we een medewerkersbijeenkomst om je collega’s beter te leren kennen. Miep is een warme, betrokken werkgever die naar je luistert. Jouw werk is niet alleen belangrijk, maar maakt ook écht een verschil voor onze cliënten!

Wie ben jij?

  • Jij bent het zonnetje in huis, zorgzaam en hebt een groot inlevingsvermogen.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor je taken.

  • Je spreekt en begrijpt Nederlands.

  • Je bent minimaal 2 uur per week beschikbaar tussen 9:00 en 18:00 uur (ma-vr).

  • Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme en een passie voor schoonmaken zijn minstens zo belangrijk!

  • Je hebt eigen vervoer (auto, scooter of fiets) om naar cliënten te reizen.

Enthousiast geworden?

Wil jij het verschil maken en onze cliënten laten stralen? Solliciteer vandaag nog!
Stuur je CV en motivatie naar ons op en wie weet verwelkomen wij jou binnenkort als onze nieuwe collega. Na je sollicitatie laten we je zo snel mogelijk weten hoe het verder gaat. Bij indiensttreding vragen wij een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) aan.

Meer informatie
www.miep.nu

title: Director, Product Design (Remote Eligible)
description:

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

As the Director of Product Design, you will lead and grow a diverse and talented team of Product Designers in applying principles of design thinking to conceptualize engaging and personalized user experiences for our web and mobile apps. You have a solid history of making the people around you better. You drive quality and efficiency by establishing processes, developing talent, and leveraging your own expertise and experience to help coach your team to accomplish more than they might have without you. You see yourself as a team captain more than a coach.

You are skilled at scaling your influence and abilities. You love to collaborate with designers, user researchers, engineers, product managers, executives, and inspire them to do their best.
