title: Tømrer til tagarbejde og renovering i Bjæverskov
description:
Vil du have firmabil, ordentlig løn og tømreropgaver med tag og renovering?

Vi mangler en erfaren tømrer i Bjæverskov til fast arbejde.

Du lander i en håndværkerflok på cirka 25 ansatte, hvor der er flere fag omkring projekterne. Arbejdet spænder over renovering, tagarbejde og løbende ejendomsservice for både private og erhverv. Aftaler skal holde, og undervejs er det vigtigt at følge op hvis noget ændrer sig. Pladserne ligger i Bjæverskov og omegn, og firmabilen gør hverdagen nemmere når du skal fra den ene opgave til den næste.

Det er en rolle for en tømrer, der kan tage ansvar uden at skulle have alt skåret ud i pap. Du får bredden fra taget til renoveringen, men også nok struktur til at vide hvad der er aftalt. Det passer godt, hvis du gerne vil bruge din erfaring på opgaver hvor både finish og fremdrift betyder noget.

Det får du

Løn: 195-250 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Bjæverskov og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 25 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Renovering, tagarbejde og ejendomsservice

Din hverdag

Dagen starter med den aftalte plan for opgaven, så rækkefølgen er klar før du tager fat. Du arbejder med det der er meldt ind, og hvis en opgave ændrer sig, følger du op så næste aftale ikke vælter.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Renoverer boliger og ejendomme efter aftalt plan
  • Udfører tagarbejde på mindre og større opgaver
  • Laver reparation og vedligeholdelse hos kunder
  • Monterer vinduer, døre og trædele efter mål
  • Arbejder med ombygning og nybyg i træ

Der bliver lavet sociale arrangementer, så du lærer folk at kende uden for pladsen. Til daglig er det vigtigste stadig enkelt: mød som aftalt, lav arbejdet ordentligt og sig til hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 5 års erfaring som tømrer
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde med renovering og tagarbejde
  • Møder stabilt og holder aftaler
  • Taler ordentligt med kunder og kolleger

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet både tag, renovering og serviceopgaver. Men det vigtigste er, at du tager ansvar og holder dine aftaler.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, er opstart hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
About Blockbrain

For mid-sized companies, knowledge is the last real competitive lever. Yet knowledge gets stuck in tools and SharePoint folders — or disappears when experts leave. While IT is still planning, employees are already using ChatGPT and the like — without governance, and sensitive data is leaking out.

With the Knowledge Bots platform, Blockbrain creates what companies truly need: AI-powered knowledge management that is quick to implement, flexibly scales, and operates in a compliant manner. Teams use our GenAI building blocks to build tailored AI assistants, agents, and workflows in minutes — just like Lego.

  • Series A funded with strong growth momentum (10x product usage & 5x revenue in 2025)

  • Enterprise clients such as Roland Berger, Bosch, IONOS, and Harting from industries including manufacturing, finance, and legal — sectors with the highest security requirements

  • ISO 27001 certified, EU AI Act ready. Made in Germany.

Role & Responsibilities

Forward Deployed Engineers are Blockbrain’s most client-proximate technical operators. Where Solutions Engineers sell and specify, FDEs ship — embedded directly in client environments to deploy, extend, and integrate the Blockbrain platform against real-world constraints. You own the gap between signed contract and working system.

This is not a support role. FDEs write production-grade code, design integration architectures, and make technical decisions on-site with clients. You are accountable for time-to-value.

Deploy & Integrate

  • Own end-to-end delivery of Blockbrain in client environments — from infrastructure standup through agent configuration, retrieval tuning, and integration wiring

  • Work directly with client engineering teams to ensure seamless adoption

Build Client-Specific Extensions

  • Develop custom connectors, API adapters, and workflow extensions using Blockbrain’s stack (TypeScript/Node.js, Python/FastAPI, Next.js)

  • Tailor the platform to client data models, auth systems, and business processes

Retrieval & Agent Tuning

  • Configure and optimize Blockbrain’s knowledge retrieval layer — vector indexes, reranker pipelines, graph integrations — for client-specific environments

  • Translate domain requirements into retrieval architecture decisions

Infrastructure & Self-Hosted Deployments

  • Support and troubleshoot Kubernetes-based deployments (Docker, ArgoCD), cloud integrations, and IaC (Terraform)

  • Take full ownership of clients running self-hosted Blockbrain instances

Surface Product Gaps

  • Act as a direct signal channel from the field to Product and Engineering

  • Document patterns, edge cases, and missing capabilities with enough specificity to become actionable backlog

Run Technical Workshops

  • Lead discovery sessions, integration workshops, and architecture reviews with client engineering stakeholders

  • Own the technical narrative in client meetings and teach advanced customer advocates to become platform experts

Expected AI Skills

At Blockbrain, we don't just talk about AI — we use it every day. In this role, you will:

  • Use Claude Code and Blockbrain's own agents to accelerate deployments — scaffolding integrations, debugging client environments, and generating documentation instead of writing everything from scratch

  • Actively experiment with AI-assisted workflows for code generation, retrieval tuning, and test authoring to compress client time-to-value

  • Collaborate with the product team to provide real-world field feedback on Blockbrain's AI capabilities — you're the closest person to how customers actually use the platform

  • Stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and apply them hands-on in client engagements — if a new tool can cut a 2-day integration task to 2 hours, we expect you to find it

We're not looking for AI researchers — we're looking for engineers who treat AI as a power tool and reflexively reach for it before doing things the slow way.

Your Profile

Professional Experience: 5+ years in solutions engineering, full-stack development, or a client-facing technical role with proven ability to deliver projects from ideation to deployment

Communication: Excellent presentation and relationship-building skills; confident leading client consultations, demos, and technical workshops. Fluency in German is required; English is a plus

Tech Affinity: Jack of all trades with strong TypeScript proficiency across the stack; eager to pick up new technologies and infrastructure quickly. Familiarity with LLMs, data processing, and coding agents is ideal

Solution Orientation: Bias for action and pragmatic execution — you prototype rapidly, deliver value to clients quickly, and thrive in ambiguous, dynamic environments

Organizational Talent: Able to manage multiple concurrent client engagements, coordinate across Product and Engineering teams, and keep deployments on track without external project management

Education: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

Hard Skills: TypeScript/Node.js, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL, Kubernetes, Docker, ArgoCD, Terraform, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, vector databases, LLM/embedding pipelines, CI/CD tooling (Sentry, Grafana, Datadog)

Soft Skills & Mindset: Entrepreneurial, resilient, and goal-oriented. An independent problem-solver who proposes tailored solutions, experiments with client feedback, learns from challenges, and communicates technical concepts clearly across all levels

What Blockbrain Offers

  • Flexible Work Models: Full-time position on-site in Stuttgart (3 days per week) with flexible working hours.

  • Benefits: Deutschland-Ticket, Wellpass fitness membership, access to the latest AI tools, and regular company and team off-sites.

  • Top Team: International team with exceptional talents.

  • High Growth Potential: Steep learning curve in a fast-growing AI startup. A high level of personal responsibility and the freedom to actively shape processes.

  • Top Equipment: MacBook, iPhone, headset, and all the tools you need to perform at your best.

Blockbrain is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive work environment.

Compensation: €70,000 EUR - €80,000 EUR (base) plus variable components of 20,000 EUR - 25,000 EUR

€90.000—€105.000 EUR

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, GCBP Transact
description:

As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Technical Strategy and Leadership: Define the multi-year architectural goal and strategy for GCBP’s pre-production environments, testing platform and SDLC management. Execute on the defined strategy with AI Agentic innovation.

  • 8 years of experience programming in C++, Java, Python, Kotlin or Go.
  • 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • 5 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • 5 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.

title: Director, Warranty
description:
The Warranty Finance Director position is critical for driving warranty accounting, budgeting and forecasting, as well as working with our partners across the business including quality, Ford Customer Service Division (FCSD), and Supply Chain to provide financial guidance and drive warranty cost improvements. In this role you will lead the warranty profit analysis, warranty coverages, and warranty Re-aquired Vehicle finance organizations. You will have the opportunity and autonomy to respond quickly to areas of warranty that require further attention and/or a fresh perspective to drive improvement.

  • Partner with operating teams to develop aspirational targets to achieve best-in-class quality levels, and identify physicals-based roadmap actions to deliver over the Plan period

  • Act as a trusted advisor, translating complex technical warranty accounting concepts into clear, impactful insights for audiences with varying levels of warranty accounting knowledge

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track the progress, and apply problem-solving approach when metrics off-track to identify recovery actions to ensure delivery of warranty financials

  • Develop annual business plans and budgets, and monthly forecasts ensuring operational alignment and buy-in to warranty projections and forecasts, while driving operational warranty cost improvements

  • Manage monthly and quarterly warranty close processes, external quarterly earnings messaging, and quarterly external benchmarking analysis

  • Ensure adherence to warranty Rules of the Road, accounting guidelines and internal controls governing warranty reserves and expenses

  • Cultivate strong, collaborative relationships with senior leaders in our quality organization, FCSD, finance teams, global data and analytics, and other business units

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing, highly engaged team of warranty finance professionals, fostering a culture of business partnering, strong controls, continuous improvement, and agility

You'll have...

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • 10 years of progressive experience in finance, consulting, or operations, with strong analytical skills and business acumen.

  • 5 years of experience leading and developing high-performing teams.

  • Prior experience in Quality/Warranty (External)

  • Demonstrated problem solving skills

  • Familiarity with digital finance technologies, including AI, Robotic Process Automation (RPA), advanced analytics, and modern ERP systems

  • Proven experience working closely with executive leadership, demonstrating exceptional executive-level stakeholder management and influencing skills.

  • Superior presentation, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information and make compelling recommendations to all levels of the organization.

Even better, you’ll have…

  • Master of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree.

  • Understanding of financial regulatory compliance standards pertaining to warranty such as SOX, IFRS, and GAAP.

  • Ability to multi-task, change priorities quickly, manage competing deadlines, and thrive in an evolving environment

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

title: Project Director
description:
About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

Job Description

Who You’ll Work With

You will join one of our 45 offices in the US, be part of a committed team of over 1500 professionals, and work in teams and directly with our clients doing work that is shaping the world around us. You will be welcomed into a rapidly growing business and team and empowered to make an impact. You will be valued, cared for, and challenged on your path to becoming a world-class professional consultant and surrounded by leaders who are committed to creating an environment that enables you to realize your own success and fulfillment. When you join Design Group as a Project Director, you are joining a team that will challenge you and position you for growth. In this role, you will work with a team of industry experts to help the world’s leading companies solve their most difficult problems. You will join our Architecture, Engineering, and Construction Practice and partner with seasoned leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients with consistency and accuracy.

What You’ll Do

You will be focused on leadership of our most significant and challenging projects, which may include large Engineering Only, EPCm or Program of Projects, in a client-facing project execution role. You will use your extensive experience in all aspects of engineering and construction practices as well as associated leadership competencies. You will enjoy the challenge of fast paced aggressive timelines and derive satisfaction from “doing the impossible”. These projects may be in any of our target sectors, Industrial, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, advanced technology (semi-conductor), food & beverage and other sectors.

  • Lead projects the “Design Group way,” utilizing established Client Trust project management best practices

  • Safely deliver complex projects successfully within scope, on schedule, on budget

  • Build client relationships and drives business development through successful project leadership

  • Provide project design, operational, engineering, construction, and execution subject matter expertise

  • Lead/Support proposal development

  • Lead/Support project and design efforts from concept design through start-up

  • Oversee the engineering team in preparation of plans, specifications, and contract documents

  • Collaborate with clients, engineers, architects, designers, and other technical professionals

  • Facilitate site, building, and infrastructure design and construction; proactively solve execution challenges

  • Manage all client communications and client expectations

  • Manage project timelines, budget, scope, change, and risk

  • Evaluate project progress and adjust critical paths for scope completion and budget adherence

  • Coordinate with local authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs); ensure compliance with local requirements

  • Interface with the construction manager and site manager to resolve design coordination and constructability issues; assist with value engineering efforts

  • Prepare proposals and participate in sales presentations

  • Make an impact day-to-day with your skills and expertise, strengthening that relationship with our clients and team

What You’ll Bring

  • A minimum of 15 years of relevant project management and engineering experience executing capital projects covering design development and coordination, specifications development, cost estimation, budget management, change control management, plan check and permit acquisition, creation of construction and contract documents, and construction administration

  • Understanding of all DG services and the interdependency of design and construction leadership when executing successful projects

  • Successful track record of delivering large/complex projects or programs

  • Perform well in high pressure situations, demonstrates confidence; “runs toward the fire”

  • Demonstrate mastery of project management best practice tools and champion of Client Trust program

  • Demonstrate knowledge of industry accepted engineering and construction practices

  • Sought out by clients and internal leaders to take on challenging projects

  • Skilled in conflict resolution, negotiation, and ability to maintain positive rapport in adverse situations

  • Project management experience in the oversight of design projects including buildings, building systems, plant utilities, process systems, and/or automation

  • A working knowledge of a broad range of engineering disciplines.

  • Project execution experience of projects within an A/E/C design firm

  • The ability to execute presentations, manage client relationships, and successfully interact with team members

  • Solid computer software skills including Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, and Microsoft Project

  • A willingness to travel for project requirements including installation and start-up activities, client and company sponsored meetings, trainings, industry related seminars, forums, and conventions

  • A Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Construction, or other technical discipline preferred

Our culture and commitment to our people is what sets us apart. We foster an environment of mutual respect, integrity, and unconditional interest in the individual and collective success of our professionals. Our model and entrepreneurial mindset offer a rewarding, challenging, and highly flexible path. As a Project Director, you will build a meaningful and fulfilling career with the support of professional development resources and mentorships including our First Year Experience program, Individual Development Plans, and Career Path resources and tools. You will be surrounded by exceptional talent who will support your development as both a world-class engineer and a highly effective leader.

Feel like you're on the path to becoming a Project Director but you're not quite there yet? We'd love to connect with you to see if we can take you from where you are today and grow you into a Design Group Engineering Consultant.

#LI-JF1


At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process. ​

Barry-Wehmiller is an equal opportunity employer. M/F/D/V This organization uses E-Verify.


Applicants may be subject to pre-employment screening which may include drug screening, reference checks, employment verifications, background screening and/or skills assessments.

title: Operations Leader
description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?


We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.


Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


  • Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

  • Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through distinct experiences, products, and services.

  • Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:


We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.



As a Key Holder, you are a trusted member of the leadership team who helps ensure smooth daily operations, exceptional customer service, and a safe, secure environment for pets, partners, and customers.

You support store leadership by supervising partners, opening and closing the store, and serving as a point of contact when management is not present. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys leading on the floor, solving problems in the moment, and delivering a great experience every day.

What You’ll Do

Pet First

  • Uphold Petco’s animal care standards, ensuring the health, safety, and proper handling of all animals.
  • Promote a safe, welcoming environment for pets, pet parents, and partners.
  • Follow all policies and procedures related to animal welfare, safety, and store operations.

Foster the Fun

  • Deliver friendly, knowledgeable, and solution-oriented service to every customer.
  • Support and supervise store partners, helping maintain productivity and positive morale.
  • Assist with training new partners and reinforcing best practices on the sales floor.
  • Help maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store environment.

Let’s Go!

  • Open and close the store while following all cash handling, safety, and security protocols.
  • Support daily store operations including sales, task execution, and recovery.
  • Execute merchandising standards, including planograms, pricing accuracy, signage, and promotional set-ups.
  • Assist with inventory activities such as restocking, cycle counts, inventory integrity, and required inventory paperwork.
  • Identify out-of-stocks, low inventory, or merchandising issues and communicate them to store leadership.
  • Process transactions, refunds, and exchanges accurately and efficiently.
  • Act as the primary point of contact in the absence of store management.
  • Support sales initiatives and promotions to help achieve store goals.

Key Responsibilities

Store Operations, Merchandising & Inventory

  • Maintain merchandise presentation and in-stock conditions to Petco standards.
  • Ensure accurate pricing and signage throughout the store.
  • Assist with inventory counts, product replenishment, and shrink awareness.
  • Monitor merchandising and inventory conditions during shifts and escalate issues as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and safety standards.

Customer Experience & Leadership

  • Address customer questions and resolve concerns promptly and professionally.
  • Model Petco’s selling behaviors and service expectations.
  • Provide guidance and direction to partners during assigned shifts.
  • Escalate concerns appropriately to store leadership.

What Success Looks Like

  • The store opens and closes safely and smoothly.
  • Merchandise is well-stocked, accurately priced, and visually appealing.
  • Inventory is handled accurately and with care.
  • Customers receive prompt, friendly, and knowledgeable service.
  • Partners feel supported and clear on expectations during each shift.

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

  • Previous retail experience required; key holder or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic math skills and experience handling cash and transactions.
  • Reliable, responsible, and detail oriented.

Essential Functions & Work Environment

This role is primarily performed in a Pet Care Center retail environment. The Key Holder is expected to be regularly present on the sales floor, leading by example and engaging with partners, customers, and pets.

  • Majority of work is conducted indoors; however, occasional duties may require leaving the Pet Care Center for tasks such as bank deposits, merchandise transport, or community events.
  • The role requires frequent standing and walking, as well as bending, kneeling, reaching, and lifting.
  • Ability to safely lift and move merchandise, supplies, or animals weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Regular engagement with customers on the sales floor, including providing customer assistance and performing cashiering and point-of-sale transactions.
  • Must be able to work in proximity to animals, including exposure to animal dander, odors, noises, and cleaning chemicals.
  • Flexible availability to support Pet Care Center operating hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • A limited amount of travel may be required for training, meetings, or community engagement.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Purpose-driven work that makes a difference for pets and people.
  • Opportunities to build leadership skills and grow your career.
  • A collaborative, inclusive team culture.
  • A strong stepping stone for future leadership opportunities.

Petco Animal Supplies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or any other protected classification.

description:

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Own

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.


This Role Is Not For

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions


Location

  • This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Spain. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Spain.


Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Solutions Development, Director
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Director, Solutions Development – Performance Development

About WPP Media

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Role Summary and Impact

As one of our Directors in the Solutions Development team you will be focused specifically on leading the design and development for enhanced digital performance within WPP Media Solutions in ways that have client appeal and are revenue returning.

With either extensive performance marketing, or in-platform performance experience in social and programmatic, you will canvas the broad responsibility of leading strategically on designing the destination and mapping the requirements, with tactical development planning to ensure we build, test, and launch with robust processes.

Strategically, you will act as a forward-looking leader and innovation agent, shaping the future of performance within WPP Media Solutions and directly influencing our own path to delivering Guaranteed Outcomes to clients.

Tactically, you will both lead cross-functional working groups to build, test and launch while also collaborating with marketing science, directly feeding into the rest of the portfolio – defining, evolving and championing lower funnel performance delivery for clients in line with our gold standard measurement and effectiveness framework.

The role promises to offer you a platform for individual growth, matrix management of cross-functional teams across Data & Tech, Solutions Integrations, Marketing Science, Planning, and Activation with a platform for true client and business impact.

Overall Purpose:

To lead, shape, and directly influence our lower funnel performance offer to clients – grounded in social and OR programmatic, with influence into the wider portfolio.

Responsibility set

  • Performance planning & Solution design:Define and lead the development of best-in-market performance capabilities for Social (P1) and ideally Programmatic Display (P2), ensuring solutions are synced to client needs and cross-channel use cases.
  • Strategic & Thought leader:Be the go-to expert for innovation and developments in Performance delivery for clients with a lens on Social and Programmatic Display, understanding competitive landscapes, and collaboratively shaping solution differentiation. Lead channel innovation leveraging our Desirability, Feasibility, Viability framework.
  • Cross-Functional leadership:Lead cross-functional working groups, bringing together diverse teams (media, tech, marketing science, planning, activation) to deliver prioritized developments and planned benefits. This involves being a project manager for complex initiatives.
  • Senior stakeholder engagement:Engage confidently with senior leaders and stakeholders to drive ideas, influence strategy, and articulate the value of proposed solutions.
  • Channel ecosystem understanding:Network with agency practitioners and EMEA colleagues to ensure a finely tuned understanding of how channels are planned, activated, and measured, driving solution consistency and identifying opportunities for share and reapply.
  • Commercial & compliance oversight:Ensure the compliant design and development of owned channel solutions, continuously reviewing pricing, margin setting, and market fit. Maintain a deep understanding of the supply chain and cost model.
  • Roadmap & delivery:Develop and deliver a channel roadmap, manage solution materials, and troubleshoot business challenges to ensure an enhanced and integrated portfolio of solutions.

Skills and Experience

  • 10+ years with performance marketing experience in Media, with proof points in Performance, Social and OR Programmatic trading.
  • Evidenced experience and understanding of Digital Media, both from a media and technical perspective with strong relationships with adtech/martech partners to enable solution development
  • Performance Marketing craft knowledge and industry POV is important.
  • An entrepreneurial attitude with a portfolio of experiences to showcase ability to recognise and develop new client solutions ahead of market maturity
  • Accredited or can speak to project management experience to effectively manage cross-functional teams and associated developments
  • Confidence and Ability to manage and deliver multiple projects to multiple deadlines simultaneously

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. title: specjalista(-ka) relacji z klientem
description:
To masz na bank:

  • ​​​umowa na zastępstwo,

  • pracę stacjonarną w 1 Oddziale w Pile, pl. Konstytucji 3 Maja 4,

  • zespół/lider: Sławomir Ochodek,

  • udział w atrakcyjnym systemie premiowym (z gwarantowaną premią w okresie wdrożeniowym) i w szerokiej ofercie benefitowej.

Na bank cenimy sobie relacje z ludźmi. Do oddziałów szukamy osób, które tak jak my chcą zapewnić naszym klientom najlepsze doświadczenie w sektorze finansowym - jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Dbamy o portfele klientów w ponad 300 oddziałach w całej Polsce. Zarządzamy wieloma produktami bankowymi dla osób prywatnych oraz przedsiębiorstw.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • masz minimum średnie wykształcenie,

  • posiadasz minimum roczne doświadczenie w bankowości i chcesz się rozwijać w tym sektorze,

  • cenisz sobie kontakt z ludźmi i długotrwałe relacje oparte na zaufaniu,

  • stawiasz sobie ambitne cele i dobrze się czujesz wiedząc do czego dążysz,

  • lubisz działać nie tylko indywidualnie, ale też zespołowo i osiągać wspólnie ustalone cele.

Mile widziane, jeśli będziesz mieć:

  • umiejętność porozumiewania się w języku angielskim na poziomie komunikatywnym, umożliwiającym kontakt z klientem zagranicznym i pomoc w wyborze odpowiednich produktów bankowych,

  • prawo jazdy kat. B.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • wspieranie klientów w wyborze najlepszych produktów i usług bankowych,

  • zapewnienie profesjonalnej obsługi oraz najlepszych doświadczeń związanych z wizytą w oddziale,

  • oferowanie i promowanie produktów bankowych,

  • realizacja indywidualnych i zespołowych zadań sprzedażowych, za które przyznajemy miesięczne premie na atrakcyjnym poziomie,

  • telefoniczny i bezpośredni kontakt z klientami,

  • budowanie długotrwałych relacji z klientami banku oraz pozyskiwanie nowych,

  • codzienną obsługę transakcji gotówkowych (w oddziałach gotówkowych) i bezgotówkowych,

  • praca w zgodzie z obowiązującymi procedurami oraz standardami jakości

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę na zastępstwo,

  • pracę stacjonarną w Oddziale (lokalizacja na początku oferty),

  • ubezpieczenie na życie,

  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),

  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na warunkach pracowniczych,

  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,

  • kartę Multisport oraz aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary,

  • możliwość udziału w wolontariacie,

  • dodatkowe świadczenia socjalne (np. wyprawka dla dzieci),

  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, praca hybrydowa, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,

  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w naszym banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.

  • Pierwsze szkolenie będzie trwało 6 miesięcy w ramach Akademii Rozwoju Mocy.

  • Po 2 miesiącach zaczniesz realizować część planu sprzedażowego i wejdziesz do systemu premiowego.

  • Przez pierwsze miesiące pokażemy Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowiemy na wszystkie pytania.

  • Po okresie wdrożenia zaczniesz w pełni realizować plany sprzedażowe.

Dołącz do nas w 3 krokach:

1. Wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu,

2. Spotkaj się z rekruterem i menadżerem,

3. Pracuj z nami w naszym Zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: Överläkare Barn och ungdomspsykiatrin Region Örebro län
description:
Vill du bli en del av ett engagerat och utvecklingsfokuserat läkarteam? Vi söker dig som är specialist i barn- och ungdomspsykiatri till en tillsvidareanställning som överläkare inom BUP. Tjänsten utformas utifrån den enhet där du placeras, med goda möjligheter till anpassning efter din kompetens och dina intressen.

Barn- och ungdomspsykiatrin i Region Örebro län (BUP) ingår i Område Psykiatri, en specialistverksamhet med drygt 900 medarbetare. Vi består av tre öppenvårdsmottagningar, en heldygnsvårdsavdelning med sex platser och en dagvårdsenhet för små barn och deras föräldrar. Alla mottagningar är centralt belägna i Örebro stad. Vi är för närvarande 15 överläkare och 5 ST-läkare i ett starkt kollegialt team där du som ny medarbetare får en viktig roll i såväl kliniskt arbete som utveckling. Alla medarbetare för en individuellt planerad introduktion efter dina förutsättningar och namngivet stöd för att komma in i arbetet.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som överläkare arbetar du med:

  • Diagnostik, utredning och behandling av barn och ungdomar med psykisk ohälsa.
  • Handledning och utbildning av läkarstudenter, BT-, AT- och ST-läkare.
  • Vi har även påbörjat en gaffelmottagning där man som överläkare arbetar i en mer konsultativ form och handleder underläkare under besök. Detta arbetssätt kommer fortsätta expanderas och utvecklas där din kompetens och kunskap ska användas för att stötta underläkarna på bästa sätt.
  • Konsultativa insatser och samverkan med andra aktörer.
  • Deltagande i verksamhetsutveckling och förbättringsarbete. Du kommer ha nära kontakt med enhetschef och dina synpunkter kommer vara drivande för förändringar.

Vi erbjuder möjlighet till delvis distansarbete i form av digitala patientbesök, behandlingskonferenser, handledning och receptförnyelser. All nödvändig utrustning tillhandahålls av arbetsgivaren.

Utbildning och forskning:

BUP Örebro har ett nära samarbete med läkarprogrammet vid Örebro universitet. Det finns möjlighet att engagera sig i:

  • Basgruppshandledning
  • Mentorskap
  • Forskning och utvecklingsprojekt

Vi gör just nu en särskild satsning på att öka forskningsaktivitet och kunskapsutveckling inom verksamheten.

Jour:

Tjänsten inkluderar bakjour på vardagskvällar och helger till kl. 21.00. Inget nattjoursarbete förekommer.

Kvalifikationer
  • Specialistläkare inom barn- och ungdomspsykiatri.
  • God samarbetsförmåga, ansvarskänsla och intresse för utveckling och handledning.

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet. Vi sätter stor vikt på samarbetsförmåga och pedagogiskt förfarande, bland annat för att stötta juniora kollegor i gaffelmottagningen som pågår. Flexibilitet efterfrågas då vi har många projekt för att utveckla vården inom barn och ungdomspsykiatrin och medarbetares arbetsmiljö.

Ansökan

Ansökningarna kommer att hanteras löpande under ansökningstiden.

Ansökan ska innehålla CV och personligt brev. Intyg, betyg, examensbevis med mera ska lämnas vid en eventuell intervju.

Om du är eller tidigare varit anställd i Region Örebro län kommer vi ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef, om du blir aktuell för anställning.

Vi krigsplacerar våra tillsvidareanställda och i vissa fall även visstidsanställda. Läs mer om vad det innebär.

Om verksamheten

Område psykiatri i Region Örebro län är en specialistverksamhet inom Hälso- och sjukvårdsförvaltningen som erbjuder vård när någon drabbas av psykisk ohälsa. Detta gör vi genom samverkan inom och mellan våra fem verksamhetsområden samt med patienter, närstående, brukarorganisationer och andra aktörer. Vi har en väl fungerande utbildningsmiljö för verksamhetsförlagd utbildning samt bidrar till utveckling av ny kompetens genom vår forskningsverksamhet. Tillsammans är vi drygt 900 medarbetare.

Region Örebro län är en av länets största arbetsgivare och en viktig tillväxtmotor i regionen. Vi arbetar för människors hälsa, trygghet och välbefinnande och för länets utveckling. Hos oss finns spännande och viktiga jobb inom bland annat hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård, kollektivtrafik, kultur och näringslivsutveckling. Tillsammans skapar vi ett bättre liv.

Övrig information

Då vi inom Psykiatrin värnar om våra patienter och värderar patientsäkerheten högt, kommer vi i samband med rekryteringen att begära utdrag ur misstanke- och belastningsregister från Rikspolisstyrelsen. Mer att läsa om misstanke- och belastningsregister finns i SFS 1999:1135 och SFS 1999:1134.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi har gjort vårt medieval för denna rekrytering och undanber oss därför erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annonsering.

title: Strategy & Operations Associate
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Own

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions


Location

  • This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Ireland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Ireland.


Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Financial Modeller
description:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality.
Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £7 billion in renewable energy assets.
We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero.
The Development Portfolio Management Team at OEGEN is responsible for delivering our development investments and works hand in hand with developers to deliver on the investment cases in changing commercial and market dynamics.
Your mission will be to make our large development portfolio across Europe a huge success. It spans different maturity stages (from early-stage land to ready to build) and five countries.
We are looking for someone who is very commercially minded, understands renewables development, loves data and communicates clearly with the team and senior stakeholders. The board directors and fund managers will rely on you to support them in decision making and value creation for portfolio companies.
You will be in charge of value maximisation of projects through their development journey (from early stage to ready to build) and lead on exits.
The ideal candidate will be available to start within 4 weeks.

What you'll do

Commercial Management:
  • You will be a key person responsible for modelling renewable energy projects, joint ventures and TopCo business plans.
  • Maintain and adapt financial models to monitor valuation and financial performance of investments, conducting regular assessments of overall portfolio performance against objectives and reporting progress to OEGEN fund managers.
  • You will support the commercial management of multiple development pipelines, working with a team of portfolio managers and developers to track performance against investment cases and agreed milestones.
  • Support managers and fund managers on value maximisation initiatives for each development project, including exit timing, sale preparation, revenue contracting, last mile development and other activities, ensuring optimal returns to investors on exit. You will drive the exit process of projects and platforms at different stage of their life.
  • Monitor and interrogate project progress, budgets and KPIs, identifying and escalating risks in a timely manner, and provide briefings and solutions to decision makers (such as board directors and fund managers).
    • Governance Oversight:
  • Support in implementing and maintaining governance frameworks across portfolio companies, ensuring compliance with internal standards and external regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate with developers on the preparation of board packs, investment committee materials and other operational review documentation to support senior management.
  • Track compliance with internal processes and external regulatory requirements, escalating gaps where identified.

    • What you'll need

  • Strong financial modelling skills (DCFs, business plans). Proficient in financial modelling principles, accounting, project management, data and reporting.
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience in managing investments, assets and/or development pipelines against investment objectives. Experience in analysing complex data, tracking KPIs, and preparing structured reporting for internal stakeholders.
  • Be a pro-active and self-starting senior team member who has a strong sense of ownership, “can do” attitude, strong team spirit and ability to grow team members.
  • Great communication and interpersonal skills, adept at building relationships and presenting analysis to a diverse range of stakeholders.
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Preferably but not mandatory experience in the sale of renewable energy assets (development, in construction or operational stage).

title: EHS Multi-Site Leader
description:
We are the people who give possibilities purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.





Job Description

Position Summary:

The EHS Multi-Site Leader is responsible for management and performance of the Environmental, Health, and Safety function for the designated sites. The individual leads the network of EHS associates across sites in the business unit(s) in order to track and measure performance, assess capability levels and identify common areas of EHS risks that can be managed across sites through program implementation. They provide ongoing support to site EHS associates to ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations across sites in the Business Unit portfolio. The EHS Multi-Site Leader is a key advisor for senior operations leadership and EHS Central leadership for the business unit, ensuring that EHS aspects are considered in the business’ operations strategy (ex. Architecture / process changes). Must be willing and able to uphold BD Values.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Owns the development and leadership of the EHS Business Unit (BU) Strategy. Harmonizes BU strategy with Global Central EHS strategy and champions at the BU level for designated sites. Comprehends the operations strategy for aligned BUs and able to implement a roadmap to support operations. Presents strategy during annual ASR process.

  • Provides oversight into EHS resourcing to site level based on the nature of operations; Factory Blueprint and focuses on building capability across site level EHS associates in the network. Leads recruitment process for Site EHS Leaders and other key EHS Roles.

  • Maintains strong relationship with Site Directors through regular engagement, providing updates discussing site priorities and providing input on site EHS team.

  • Lead and own BU-level implementation of BD Excellence EHS components, ensuring effective adoption of tools; approving and validating site EHS maturity assessments and action plans; and driving ongoing progress reviews and alignment with site and EHS leadership.

  • Mentors sites and drives professional development pathways. Onboards new EHS associates and partners with Central EHS to ensure all system accesses and training are provided. Provides training to sites and leadership through Leaders as Teachers model.

  • Primary point of contact for assigned sites. Engages appropriate stakeholders of the organization to ensure effective support and resourcing for the sites and Business Unit.

  • Responsible for EHS performance review and trend insights with BU Leadership, ISC leadership and CSO. Effectively communicates EHS performance and path forward on EHS matters to ensure a strong culture of associate safety and environmental management.

  • Provides interim EHS support to sites during staffing gaps.

  • Collaborates with local Plant Leadership Teams in the development and execution of EHS Recovery Plans as necessary. Establishes governance processes and monitoring cadence to ensure execution and track progress.

  • Supports EHS compliance activities for acquisitions, divestitures and closures.

  • Own and drive quality and consistency of injury and incident investigations across assigned sites, proper root cause analysis, safety alerts write-ups including distribution and ensures corrective actions being address across their network of sites.

  • Obtains input from sites and relays feedback regarding the development and implementation of Central EHS Program and standard reviews. Leads the implementation of policies/programs with site EHS staff. Supports site project and program planning utilizing risk-based prioritization. Collaborates with Central EHS staff on the development of policies, goals, and programs (within specific expertise).

  • Establishes mechanisms to periodically review objectives and metrics to ensure alignment of EHS strategies with business needs.

  • Responsible for ensuring accuracy of site-reported metrics and maintaining data assurance through the EHS management system.

  • Provides operational verification of high-risk action closure. Coaches site and ensures sites are always audit-ready. Supports and provides guidance on findings, actions and strategies for timely and sustained closure.

  • Engages or leads in applicable project teams in support of both BDX EHS and site network strategy.

  • Mentor and coach site EHS leaders and teams by conducting regular 1:1 engagements and site visits; and ensuring effective development, alignment, and execution of site-level EHS strategies.

  • Advises sites in the BU portfolio in the event of government agency inspections (i.e., OSHA or EPA) and in any procedures that may follow a citation. Acts as a liaison between the site and Central EHS and Legal when correspondence is needed with government agencies.

  • Keeps abreast of changes to EHS that may impact BU/site operations; Initiates changes to practices and procedures to support compliance requirements.

  • Demonstrates ability to use influence skills to successfully develop and implement effective safety and environmental programs which engage all sites across the portfolio.

  • Effective communication skills and the ability to exercise judgment and appropriately communicate and manage during crisis situations if they are to arise.

  • Engages and gains the support of associates in various positions of responsibility and in various functions within BD worldwide. This includes associates in these functions who occupy positions of authority that are equal to, greater than or less than the incumbent. title: Content Specialist
location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
description:
Company Overview

Engage Video Group is a technology-driven social media video business combining data and creativity to create content people really care about. We have worked with global corporations such as Unilever and NESTLÉ to produce the most engaging, shareable content for some of the world’s largest brands, and have built and own the largest food and recipe social media platform in Africa, Foodies of SA.



The Content Lead is the strategic and creative owner of campaigns from client brief through to performance. This role is responsible for translating client objectives into platform-first creator video strategies, overseeing creator execution, maintaining creative quality throughout production, and driving continuous optimisation through performance insights. Working predominantly across food and FMCG brands, this individual combines strategic thinking, food and recipe ideation, creator content management, production oversight, and reporting to ensure every campaign delivers both creative excellence and measurable business results. The Content Lead acts as the central point of accountability across strategy, creators, production and reporting, ensuring campaigns are delivered to the highest creative and brand standard.



Key Responsibilities

1. Campaign Strategy & Creative Leadership

  • Own campaign strategy from initial client brief through to campaign delivery.
  • Translate client briefs into insight-led, platform-first creator strategies.
  • Lead creator strategy and recipe ideation, ensuring concepts are culturally relevant and brand aligned
  • Identify food trends, cultural moments and consumer behaviours that unlock strategic opportunities.
  • Present strategic thinking confidently to internal teams and clients.

2. Creator Sourcing, Briefing & Direction

  • Lead creator sourcing and recommend creators based on audience fit, creative style and campaign objectives.
  • Develop creator briefs that balance strategic messaging with authentic creator storytelling.
  • Brief creators and manage briefing sessions
  • Own creator feedback and sign-off prior to go-live

3. Production Oversight & Quality Assurance

  • Oversee production across campaigns to ensure strategic intent is maintained from concept through delivery.
  • Work closely with Foodies of SA and production teams to ensure content aligns with campaign objectives and brand standards.
  • Act as the quality gate for all campaign assets before client delivery.
  • Ensure campaign deliverables meet Engage Video Group's creative standards before publishing.

4. Campaign Performance & Optimisation

  • Monitor campaign performance throughout the campaign lifecycle.
  • Recommend creative pivots or reinvestment opportunities based on performance.
  • Ensure learnings are documented and applied to future campaigns.

5. Reporting & Strategic Insights

  • Lead strategic reporting across campaigns.
  • Develop meaningful reporting narratives that explain campaign performance beyond the metrics.
  • Produce actionable insights and recommendations for clients.
  • Identify long-term learnings across brands and categories.
  • Contribute strategic commentary to reporting decks and presentations.



Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic thinker with the ability to balance creativity and commercial objectives.
  • Excellent understanding of food culture, recipe content and FMCG purchasing behaviour.
  • Strong creative judgement with a high standard for content quality.
  • Experience briefing and directing creators.
  • Ability to oversee multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Confident interpreting campaign data and translating insights into action.
  • Strong storytelling ability across strategy, reporting and presentations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Meta and YouTube content ecosystems.
  • Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to act as a quality gate across campaign deliverables.



Experience & Qualifications

  • 2-3 years' experience in content strategy, influencer marketing, digital marketing, social strategy or FMCG brand marketing.
  • Experience developing content strategies for food, beverage or FMCG brands.
  • Experience overseeing creator campaigns from briefing through to delivery.
  • Experience working closely with production teams and creative talent.
  • Experience contributing to campaign reporting, optimisation and case study development.

title: Test – en Service Engineer (Regio Rotterdam/West-Brabant)
description:
Ben jij een hobbyist die zijn eigen uitvindingen in elkaar knutselt? Houd je van technische uitdagingen met producten die nog op de markt moeten verschijnen? En denk jij graag mee met R&D over hoe het nog beter kan? Lees dan verder!

Belangrijkste taken

Voor het installeren, onderhouden en testen van onze prototypes zijn we op zoek naar een Test- en Service Engineer. Dit vindt voornamelijk plaats op een aantal test-boerderijen in de regio Rotterdam/West-Brabant. Deze melkveehouders testen onze nieuwe producten die nog verder doorontwikkeld moeten worden.

Je bent als Test- en Service Engineer medeverantwoordelijk voor de 24-uurs service en onderhoud aan de robotsystemen. Daarnaast ondersteun je het Product Development team in Maassluis door mee te denken over wat nodig is om tot het perfecte eindproduct te komen. Jouw feedback uit het veld is hierbij van groot belang. Op de bedrijven is geen dag hetzelfde. Er wordt veel van jou gevraagd bij het oplossen van problemen, waarbij technisch inzicht en creativiteit steekwoorden zijn. De producten zijn namelijk nog in de testfase, dus je kan helaas niet terugvallen op een handleiding. Dit terwijl de machines wel 24/7 beschikbaar moeten zijn: een leuke uitdaging dus!

Nog een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk is om het Product Development test-team te ondersteunen met het doen van veld testen. In praktijk betekent dit dat je nieuwe componenten aan de robot monteert of aanpassingen doet en de feedback van de melkveehouder ophaalt. Het is belangrijk dat je goed vastlegt welke storingen je tegenkomt, hoe je storingen oplost en wat de feedback is van de melkveehouder. Deze informatie wordt namelijk gebruikt om onze producten te verbeteren en om de handleidingen te schrijven. Kortom; een afwisselende en betekenisvolle baan, waarbij je de kans krijgt om in een unieke omgeving en met de nieuwste technieken te werken!

  • Een technisch inzicht, oplossingsgerichtheid en een ondernemende houding.
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zo weet je om te gaan met de feedback van de melkveehouder en zaken op de agenda te krijgen.
  • Een afgeronde hbo opleiding in de richting van mechatronica, werktuigbouwkunde of elektrotechniek; of je hebt een technisch mbo niveau 4 opleiding afgerond en enkele jaren werkervaring.
  • Ervaring met storingsdiensten, je vindt het geen probleem om soms ook ’s nachts en in het weekend te werken.
  • Kennis en ervaring met meet- en regeltechniek; affiniteit met de melkveehouderij is een pre.
  • Een rijbewijs, daarnaast ben je woonachtig in de regio Rotterdam/West-Brabant.

Een waanzinnige baan bij internationaal bedrijf dat continu vooroploopt binnen de agrarische sector om het leven van de veehouder steeds gemakkelijker, duurzamer en leuker te maken. Dit is jouw kans om jouw gespecialiseerde kennis te delen en wederom te verrijken.

Verder:

  • salaris tussen de €3500 en €5000,- waarbij we graag ruimte zien voor groei;
  • prima arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder 27 vakantiedagen & 13 roostervrije dagen;
  • flexibiliteit in werktijden en werkplek;
  • vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om jouw eigen werk in te delen;
  • #FitatLely programma met (online) sportlessen, masterclasses over thuiswerken en andere activiteiten op het gebied van Body, Mind or Food.
  • Lely Academy met een aanbod van verschillende opleidingen.

En een eigen barista op de Lely Campus die de beste cappuccino’s maakt van verse melk, direct van de boer.

Werving & selectiebureau, consultancy en/of detacheringsbureau? We stellen de interesse op prijs, maar we zoeken al onze kandidaten rechtstreeks. We begrijpen dat jullie als intermediair de kandidaten onze toffe posities willen voorleggen en zo bijdragen aan onze ambities, maar dit is niet hoe wij onze werving hebben ingericht. Dit betekent dat alle ongevraagde profielen die worden aangeboden op Lely vacatures, als directe sollicitaties zullen worden behandeld.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Reconomy is an international circular economy specialist that combines technology, skills and incredible people to enable businesses to better manage their resources, helping reduce waste, optimise their supply chains, and contribute in a meaningful way toward the circular economy

We are bending the edges of linear business models across the world, integrating circular economy strategies and processes into everyday operations. We have the tools, talent and technology that enable customers to harness the full and inherent value of their resources, with integrated global operations in over 80 countries across the world.

Our full range of capabilities are organised into 3 ‘loops’: Recycle, Comply and Re-use, each providing opportunities for circularity within the wider resource cycle.
  • Recycle loop is utilising the latest technology and data to enable customers to make the best possible use of their materials.
  • Comply loop is enabling customers to solve increasingly complex environmental regulatory challenges using data, expert knowledge and thought leadership to drive business accountability across the globe.
  • Re-use loop is providing intelligent technology platforms and agile delivery models for pre-retail logistics and product returns, fulfilment and processing, on behalf of many of Europe’s largest retailers.
Do you have experience in Credit Control but you're looking for a change or new challenge?

If you can keep calm under pressure and you're used to using your persuasive nature to encourage collection of cash owed, this may well be the role for you.

You will have your own ledger, some small businesses who work with us occasionally and some larger ones who work with us on a regular basis.

Having strong communication skills is very important, as you will speak to a variety of contacts to arrange payment of invoices, ensuring that solid relationships are created and robust credit control methods are implemented. You'll predominantly do this by phone, but you will also follow up what's been discussed with emails, which will need to be well written and clear.

Customer service experience or skills will help to settle the invoices quickly, combined with your problem solving skills to resolve queries. You’ll also work closely with colleagues in different teams, ensuring that everyone involved with the account is kept up to date.

This is a target driven role, which will make it easy for you to see how you are getting on throughout the month and gives you the opportunity to earn bonus.

Your ledger is managed predominately using Excel or the company system so the more comfortable you are with Microsoft Office packages and bespoke systems the better. Ideally you’ll need to know how to sort in Excel or maybe create basic sums, we can then help you to learn anything more advanced which might be of use such as pivot tables and charts.
  • Proven experience in credit control, with a strong track record of managing high-volume ledgers in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage your own workload efficiently and effectively.
  • Strong team player, demonstrating a collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues.
  • Confident communicator, capable of building and maintaining effective relationships both internally and externally.
  • Tech-savvy, confident using Microsoft Office and comfortable navigating in-house systems, with a quick ability to learn new tools and platforms.
  • Holidays and Birthday Leave – Start with 23 days, increasing to 25 after 2 years of service, plus bank holidays. After one year, you can also take advantage of our holiday buy/sell scheme for added flexibility. Also, enjoy your birthday off once you reach 1 year of service.
  • Volunteering Day - 1 paid day per year to support local charities.
  • MyPerks Platform - Access a wide range of discounts, cashback offers, cycle-to-work scheme, gym membership discounts, mortgage advice, and skip hire discounts.
  • Financial & Family Support - Competitive pension contributions, life assurance, and enhanced maternity and paternity leave.
  • Health & Wellbeing – Flu jabs, eyecare vouchers, Employee Assistance Programme, confidential counselling, MyPerks wellbeing centre, and access to trained Mental Health Fire Aiders.
  • Employee Referral Programme - Recommend great talent and earn a reward.
  • Long Service Awards - Celebrating your milestones with us.
  • Reward & Recognition Schemes - Recognising and celebrating achievements across the business.
  • Employee Voice: Regular “My Voice” surveys and follow-up check-ins to drive meaningful change.
  • Credit Control bonus structure: Rewarding performance and contribution to targets.
