title: Doktersassistent Chirurgie
description:
Laat jij met jouw inzet en enthousiasme de spreekuren soepel verlopen? Werk je graag in een ziekenhuis met korte lijnen en een persoonlijke benadering? Dan zien wij jouw reactie graag!

Als doktersassistent op deze drukbezochte poli, heb jij een afwisselend takenpakket met een voornamelijk coördinerende, administratieve rol. Samen met jouw collega’s zorg jij voor een goed verloop van de spreekuren. Jij weet wat er speelt, houdt het overzicht en zet graag dat stapje extra wanneer dat nodig is.

Een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je treft de voorbereidingen voor een goed verloop van de spreekuren;

  • Je bepaalt bij wie, waar en wanneer de patiënt terecht kan;

  • Je bewaakt de werklijsten en zorgt voor de afspraken en planning van de spreekuren;

  • Je houdt de patiëntendossiers op orde en beheert de voorraad;

  • Je verricht eenvoudige medische handelingen;

  • Je maakt verbandrecepten;

  • Je onderhoudt contact met de patiënt door ze te ontvangen, telefonisch te woord te staan en uitleg te geven;

  • Je beantwoordt (digitale vragen) van de patiënten of wijst ze toe;

  • Je werkt mee aan innovatieve projecten zoals de digitale polikliniek;

Jaarlijks zien wij veel patiënten en we werken intensief samen met de vakgroep chirurgie, de gipsverbandmeesters, de verpleegkundig specialisten, de stoma-, wond-, mammacare- en coördinerend oncologisch verpleegkundigen. Binnen de vakgroep hebben we de specialismen vaat- , trauma-, plastische-, oncologische- en algemene chirurgie.
I.v.m. doorstroming van een collega, zoeken we een nieuwe collega voor Harderwijk. Soms help je ook onze collega’s in Lelystad. We werken prettig met elkaar samen, de lijnen zijn kort en we helpen elkaar. Past onze slogan 'je zorgt voor elkaar' ook bij jou? Dan horen wij graag van je!

Wat vragen wij van jou?

  • Een afgeronde MBO-4 opleiding tot doktersassistent.

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

  • Recente kennis van de medische terminologie.

  • Ruime ervaring met MS Office

Van nature pak je zaken proactief op en draag je nieuwe ideeën aan. Je weet anderen op een onderbouwde manier te informeren en je bent gewend om informatie en kennis te delen in een team. Je kunt goed omgaan met veranderingen en krijgt hier ook energie van. Verder draag je bij aan een prettige collegiale sfeer in het team.

  • Een jaarcontract voor 24-32 uur per week met de intentie, bij ongewijzigde organisatorische omstandigheden, deze om te zetten naar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd. Je werkt zowel in Harderwijk als in Lelystad.

  • Het salaris is ingedeeld volgens schaal 40 (FWG 3.0) en bedraagt minimaal € 2.750 en maximaal € 3.960 per maand op basis van 36 uur. Daarbij ontvang je 8,33% vakantietoeslag en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%.

  • Je bouwt pensioen op bij Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn. Daarnaast bieden wij interessante extra’s, waaronder korting op jouw zorgverzekeringspremie, bedrijfsfitness en de MKA (Meer Keuze Arbeidsvoorwaarden) regeling.

  • Via de St Jansdal academie kun je (online) werken aan jouw persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Ook zijn er regelmatig leuke initiatieven, waaronder workshops, om jou gezond en vitaal te houden.

Ben je enthousiast?

Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatiebutton. Je kunt jouw sollicitatiebrief richten aan Bianca Hoorn bedrijfsleider. Wil je liever eerst meer informatie over deze functie dan kun je contact opnemen met Bianca via bs.hoorn@stjansdal.nl.

Wanneer wij een geschikte kandidaat hebben gevonden zullen we de vacature sluiten.

title: Senior Vehicle EE Integration Technician
description:
The Senior Vehicle Integration Technician is responsible for installing, integrating, testing, validating, and troubleshooting complex electronic systems in prototype and production-intent vehicles, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test systems, and laboratory test racks.


This role requires strong automotive electrical and electronics expertise, hands-on vehicle integration experience, and the ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex technical issues while collaborating effectively with engineering and technical teams.

What you'll do...
Installation and System Integration
• Install, integrate, and configure electronic hardware and systems in vehicles and test environments, including:
o Prototype vehicle systems
o Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test systems and test racks
o Telematics systems
o Advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS)
o Infotainment systems
o Electric vehicle charging systems
o High-voltage battery systems
o Aftermarket components and accessories
• Fabricate, modify, and install wiring harnesses, connectors, modules, sensors, and related components.
• Verify that wiring, connections, mounting, and system configurations meet engineering requirements, manufacturer specifications, and applicable industry standards.
• Work closely with engineering teams to support system bring-up, vehicle builds, upgrades, and hardware modifications.

Testing and Validation
• Perform functional, performance, and safety testing of integrated systems.
• Use diagnostic tools, test equipment, and engineering software to verify system operation and identify technical issues.
• Support validation activities by executing test procedures and collecting accurate data.
• Document installation details, system configurations, test procedures, findings, and results.
• Communicate issues clearly and provide recommendations for corrective action.

Troubleshooting and Repair
• Diagnose complex electrical and electronic system malfunctions, communication faults, and hardware failures.
• Apply structured troubleshooting methods to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
• Repair, replace, or modify wiring, connectors, modules, and related components as needed.
• Verify repairs and modifications through appropriate testing and validation.
• Escalate design-related issues and collaborate with engineers to develop long-term solutions.

Technical Leadership
• Apply advanced knowledge of automotive electronics, circuit analysis, power electronics, vehicle communication networks, and digital systems.
• Read and interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, engineering drawings, pinout tables, and technical documentation.
• Maintain awareness of emerging vehicle integration technologies, tools, standards, and best practices.
• Provide technical guidance, share knowledge, and mentor less-experienced team members.
• Promote safe, organized, and high-quality work practices.

You'll have...
• Five or more years of experience in automotive electrical/electronic integration, vehicle development, testing, or a related technical field.
• Demonstrated experience installing, integrating, testing, and troubleshooting complex vehicle electronic systems.
• Strong understanding of automotive electrical systems, electronic components, wiring, grounding, power distribution, and communication networks.
• Proficiency with diagnostic tools and test equipment, such as digital multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, data acquisition systems, and vehicle network diagnostic tools.
• Ability to read and interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.
• Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail, workmanship, documentation, and accuracy.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to manage assignments independently and collaborate in a cross-functional team environment.
• Ability to follow established safety procedures when working with high-voltage and prototype vehicle systems.

Even better, you may have...
• Associate degree, technical diploma, or professional certification in electronics technology, automotive technology, mechatronics, or a related field.
• Experience with telematics, ADAS, infotainment, HIL testing, electric vehicle charging, or high-voltage battery systems.
• Experience with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Automotive Ethernet.
• High-voltage vehicle safety training or certification.
• Familiarity with relevant automotive standards and regulations, including SAE and ISO standards.
• Experience working in prototype vehicle, product development, engineering laboratory, or validation environments.
• Experience coordinating technical projects, vehicle builds, or integration activities.
• Demonstrated leadership, mentoring, and team-development skills.

title: Service Engineer R&D
description:
In deze rol werk je op het snijvlak van service, techniek en productontwikkeling. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze innovatieve robotsystemen in de praktijk blijven draaien én steeds beter worden.

Je werkt met producten die nog in ontwikkeling zijn. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen storingen oplost, maar ook structureel bijdraagt aan verbeteringen. Je ziet waar het beter kan en zorgt dat deze inzichten daadwerkelijk landen binnen het development team.

  • Je analyseert en lost complexe storingen zelfstandig op, ook zonder standaard handleiding

  • Je voert veldtesten uit en implementeert nieuwe componenten en aanpassingen
  • Je bent medeverantwoordelijk voor de 24-uurs service en continuïteit van robotsystemen in het veld

Je hebt ervaring in een technische service- of fieldrol en bent gewend om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen in een dynamische omgeving. Je combineert technisch inzicht met een praktische en ondernemende instelling.

Waarom deze rol?

Je werkt met de nieuwste technologie binnen een omgeving waar innovatie en praktijk samenkomen. Geen dag is hetzelfde en jouw werk heeft direct invloed op de ontwikkeling van onze producten. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte voor initiatief en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken.

Een waanzinnige baan bij internationaal bedrijf dat continu vooroploopt binnen de agrarische sector om het leven van de veehouder steeds gemakkelijker, duurzamer en leuker te maken. Dit is jouw kans om jouw gespecialiseerde kennis te delen en wederom te verrijken.

title: Sygeplejerske eller SOSU-assistent søges til Boenheden Delfinen
description:
Da vores sygeplejerske flytter fra landsdelen, søger vi en sundhedsfaglig medarbejder, der brænder for at understøtte borgernes sundhed, trivsel og livskvalitet.

Stillingen er på 30 timer ugentligt med mulighed for op til 37 timer ved deltagelse i pædagogiske vagter. Tiltrædelse senest 1. oktober 2026, gerne tidligere.

Om Delfinen

Delfinen er et botilbud med 11 beboere med nedsat kognitiv funktionsevne og psykiske udfordringer. Beboerne er overvejende selvhjulpne, men har behov for støtte, guidning og nærvær i hverdagen.

Vi arbejder ud fra et menneskesyn, hvor alle skal opleve sig betydningsfulde og have mulighed for et liv med glæde, fællesskab og værdighed. Vores pædagogiske fundament er KRAP (Kognitiv, Ressourcefokuseret og Anerkendende Praksis), hvor fokus er på relationer, ressourcer og udviklingsmuligheder.

Dine opgaver

  • Sygeplejefaglige vurderinger og observationer.

  • Planlægning, koordinering og opfølgning på sundhedsfaglige indsatser.

  • Forebyggelse og tidlig opsporing af sygdom.

  • Dokumentation og kvalitetssikring.

  • Ansvar for medicinhåndtering og medicininstrukser.

  • Undervisning og vejledning af medarbejdere.

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med kolleger, læger, terapeuter og pårørende.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er autoriseret sygeplejerske eller SOSU-assistent.

  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for mennesker med udviklingshæmning og komplekse støttebehov.

  • Har kendskab til medicinhåndtering og dokumentation.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og kvalitetsbevidst.

  • Er empatisk, anerkendende og god til at skabe relationer.

  • Trives i tværfagligt samarbejde.

Vi tilbyder

  • En dynamisk arbejdsplads med engagerede kolleger og stærke værdier.

  • Mulighed for at præge den sundhedsfaglige indsats.

  • En meningsfuld hverdag, hvor du gør en reel forskel for beboerne.

Kan du se dig selv i ovennævnte, så send en kort ansøgning vedlagt CV til Jeannette Fischer på jfn@slettestrand.dk. Du er også velkommen til at kontakte mig på tlf.: 66447974 på hverdage mellem kl.10 og 14. Sidste frist for ansøgning er d. 18/8-2026. Samtaler afholdes d. 25/8-26.

title: Technical Solutions Engineer Leader, Ford Energy
description:
Ford Energy is a newly formed, wholly-owned subsidiary of Ford Motor Company dedicated to accelerating U.S. energy independence. Leveraging Ford’s century of manufacturing excellence and world-class battery energy storage systems (BESS) technology, Ford Energy designs, manufactures, and services grid-scale and commercial DC battery energy storage systems (BESS). Ford Energy is uniquely positioned to capture the growing demand for reliable, US-built energy storage systems. We are not just building batteries; we are building the infrastructure for the next generation of the American grid.

Why Ford Energy?
At Ford Energy, you have the backing of an industrial manufacturing powerhouse with the agility of a dedicated energy startup offering industry leading technology. We offer a competitive compensation package including performance-based bonuses, Ford vehicle discounts, and the opportunity to shape the energy strategy of one of the world's most iconic brands.

In this position...

The Technical Solution Leader will serve as the senior Technical Solution Lead for the Ford Energy sales team and our customers. This role is critical in leading a team of technical solution engineers, translating complex customer requirements into optimized BESS configurations, and establishing the governance for the technical solution process. You will be responsible for serving as the final technical authority for all bids, ensuring that Ford Energy’s solutions are "bankable," safety-compliant, and aligned with our long-term service and reliability standards. This highly visible senior role will bridge the gap between commercial strategy and engineering execution, interfacing directly with internal and external executives to drive the subsidiary's growth.

What you'll do...

  • Strategic Governance & Technical Authority
    • Serve as the final technical authority with sign-off for all bids, ensuring alignment with the subsidiary's technical risk and governance standards.
    • Embed a "Safety-First" culture into the solution design phase, ensuring all proposed configurations meet or exceed industry safety and regulatory standards (UL/NFPA).
    • Own the intake, triage, and prioritization of customer requests, ensuring effective workload balance across the technical solutions team.
  • Product Roadmap & Closing the Loop
    • Formalize the "closed-loop" process, ensuring customer technical requirements, market trends, and field learnings are systematically fed back into the Product Roadmap.
    • Prioritize "Design for Serviceability" by ensuring sales configurations focus on long-term asset reliability, uptime, and ease of maintenance, rather than just the initial sale.
    • Provide clear technical recommendations and risk assessments to support long-term commercial strategy and bid positioning.
  • Executive Influence & Solution Leadership
    • Serve as the primary technical interface for internal and external executives, representing Ford Energy in high-stakes customer reviews and strategic business discussions.
    • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of technical solutions engineers, establishing a culture of technical rigor and commercial urgency.
    • Establish and continuously improve technical solutions workflows and governance to increase speed, quality, and consistency of executive-level proposals.
  • Technical Execution & Cross-Functional Alignment
    • Oversee the technical scoping and configuration of BESS projects, including system sizing (MW/MWh) and site layout optimizations.
    • Interface with simulation teams to model battery degradation and financial performance (LCOS/NPV) based on specific customer use cases.
    • Ensure a seamless technical handoff from the solutioning phase to delivery and commissioning, capturing lessons learned for recurrence prevention.

You'll have...

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years of experience in Applications Engineering, Quality Assurance, Systems Engineering, or Product Development within the energy or automotive sectors.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated experience interfacing with executive-level stakeholders and driving technical governance.
  • Strong understanding of power systems, batteries, and battery management systems.

Even better, you may have...

  • Master’s degree or MBA in a related field.
  • Direct experience with stationary Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and familiarity with grid-scale standards (UL 9540A, NFPA 855).
  • Experience building or improving technical solutions processes and operating rhythms for a new business unit.
  • Working knowledge of wholesale electricity markets and grid operations (e.g., ERCOT, CAISO).

title: Senior Energy Integration Specialist
description:
Oh what a feeling!

At Toyota we celebrate individual differences, and we strive to create a workplace that not only gives equal opportunities to people of all backgrounds and abilities but supports them to reach their full potential. Afterall, our people are our greatest assets. We do this through employee community engagement, mentorship, development and recognition programs.

Together, we are Toyota.

Toyota Motor Corporation Australia is well-recognised for offering:

  • Fully maintained motor vehicle including insurance and fuel

  • Annual contribution to your private health insurance worth over $2,000

  • Significant family vehicle lease and purchase discounts

  • Flexible hours and workspaces, with a hybrid of working from home and in the office

  • Wellness facilities – free onsite gym, end of trip facilities

  • Free car parking and discounted onsite cafe

  • Genuine career development: promotions, rotations and paid professional membership

  • Paid volunteer days to support your community and matched workplace giving program

  • 26 weeks paid primary carers leave, 8 weeks paid parental leave for secondary carers and Superannuation paid on unpaid Parental Leave

  • Access to Toyota’s RewardsHub – explore, manage and customise your benefits to suit your lifestyle

What you’ll contribute to

An exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Energy Integration Specialist to join our Business Planning & Strategy division in a permanent fulltime position.

The Business Planning & Strategy Division provides leadership across corporate governance, compliance, strategic planning, reputation management and community engagement. Partnering closely with the business, the division drives organisational performance, supports problem-solving, enables the achievement of strategic objectives, and fosters a high-performing culture that positions the company as an employer of choice.

The Senior Energy Integration Specialist is responsible for leading the development and management of external hydrogen fuel cell integration partnerships. The role involves building the required engineering capability, collaborating with key stakeholders, and working closely with Toyota Motor Corporation to secure technical approvals and ensure successful integration outcomes.

This role is based in our Port Melbourne office with flexible work arrangements on offer.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead the development and delivery of strategic system integration projects that support future Toyota hydrogen initiatives and business objectives.

  • Develop, manage and influence a broad range of internal and external stakeholders to build critical organisational capability and expertise in fuel cell systems, creating pathways to commercialisation.

  • Lead engineering project planning, analysis and execution to ensure objectives, milestones and performance targets are achieved, while coordinating matrix teams across Toyota and external partner organisations.

  • Drive the development of Toyota's fuel cell technology roadmap through market analysis, insights into the Australian hydrogen sector, and collaboration with external partners, ONE Toyota companies and TMC global affiliates.

  • Develop innovative solutions to complex business challenges, including leading the preparation of business cases, feasibility studies and strategic assessments in partnership with external organisations.

  • Maintain and enhance reporting frameworks and performance metrics, providing accurate and timely information to support strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting and decision-making activities.

Your attributes –If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

  • Tertiary qualifications in Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Demonstrated experience in the development and implementation of hydrogen system integration projects, including the application of Toyota fuel cell technology.

  • Strong capability in analysing, troubleshooting and resolving complex technical and business challenges.

  • Proven ability to contribute to the development and delivery of strategic initiatives and programs.

  • Understanding of business case development, feasibility assessment and commercial evaluation processes.

  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to achieve project and organisational objectives.

  • Strong communication, stakeholder engagement and project leadership skills.

Make your impossible, possible & apply today!

title: Event Coordinator
description:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no days are the same? As our Event Coordinator, you create memorable experiences and coordinate events, customer visits and meetings that strengthen relationships and support business success.

Why Sandvik?

At Sandvik, you’re part of a collaborative and global environment where your work has a direct impact on how customers, partners and colleagues experience our business. Here, you get the opportunity to combine project leadership, service excellence and creativity in a role with broad exposure and variety.

  • Coordinate high-impact internal and external events and customer visits.
  • Work with colleagues and stakeholders across different functions and countries.
  • Take ownership of projects while contributing to continuous improvement and best practices.

About the job

You plan, coordinate and deliver internal and external events, customer visits, meetings and digital experiences. From the initial concept through execution and follow-up, you ensure every detail is in place and every participant receives a professional and seamless experience.

Job responsibilities:

  • Lead and coordinate events, meetings and customer visits from planning through delivery and evaluation.
  • Develop project plans, timelines, budgets and communication activities.
  • Coordinate internal stakeholders and external suppliers to ensure successful execution.
  • Manage invitations, registrations, attendee communication and event logistics.

title: Consultant - Energy & Industrial
location: Kota Jakarta Selatan, DKI Jakarta, Indonesia
description:
About the Practice Area

Energy & Environment (E&E)

Frost & Sullivan’s ‘Energy & Environment (E&E)’ practice offers advisory services to a number of highly specialized sectors – Power Generation, Oil & Gas, Homes & Buildings, Energy Storage, Environment & Water, Critical Power, Grids and Distributed Energy. The practice covers multiple convergence themes such as Sustainability, Smart Cities, Green Energy, Shale Phenomenon, Hydrogen and Globalization. The practice is proud to have served most of the global and regional E&E sector clients and is one of the sought after consulting and advisory firms Frost & Sullivan.

Industrial (IND)

Frost & Sullivan’s Industrial Growth Advisory practice is a powerful congruence of thought leadership, insights, and actionable strategic recommendations that enable our clients to successfully grow in the Industrial markets ranging from automation and manufacturing, electronics and measurement, machines, semiconductors, and digital industrial technologies. Players across this value chain work with us to better understand where they are and where they need to be with our insights and recommendation into not only their competition but also opportunities across geographies, vertical end markets, and customer types. The Industrial Growth Advisory practice is the doorway for our clients to navigate the vagaries of business, foresee the future of their market and create sustainable growth strategies for the long term.

We work on global engagements, complex topics, difficult to reach target group, large sample sizes, customized / individual solutions including dashboard development, qualitative and quantitative research techniques.


About the Role

As a Consultant, you will take ownership of managing a key module of work or a small project (1-2 member team). You will lead client teams, structuring comprehensive analyses to address critical client questions. Your key objectives will include serving as a role model internally, building expertise with middle management-level client staff, and gradually taking on business development tasks, such as crafting proposals and delivering client pitches.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of managing a key module of work or a small project.
  • Lead client teams, structuring comprehensive analyses to address critical client questions.
  • Business development tasks, such as crafting proposals and delivering client pitches.
  • Lead end-to-end execution of consulting engagements, from scoping and hypothesis development to insight delivery and presentation.
  • Conduct high-quality primary and secondary research, market analysis, and benchmarking using a range of tools and sources.
  • Translate client challenges into structured problem statements and develop actionable, data-driven solutions and recommendations.
  • Manage multiple projects and stakeholder priorities concurrently in fast-paced settings.
  • Analytical Skills -Good understanding of industry trends, ability to contextualise these into specific client organisation context and be able to have a meaningful discussion on the industry or strategy of the client. Able to create an effective and project-relevant questionnaire/ discussion guide and effectively conduct expert interviews and focus group discussions. advanced skills in market analysis, strategic analysis, competitor analysis and understanding of financial analysis models. advanced proficiency in Excel, Powerpoint & Word. Understanding and use of Growth Pipeline Engine framework; Able to articulate components of the Growth Pipeline Dialog for discussion with clients.
  • Interpersonal Skills - Able to plan tasks for a delivery module/ project, develop storyline/ TOC for client deliverables and create templates for final output; guide team members to fulfil as per plan. Able to plan the analysis needs for a specific project/ task, relate that to the information required to be captured and link inferences drawn from data analysis into meaningful results. Able to independently plan for: Quantitative Research, i.e., method, sample size, etc. and Qualitative Research. i.e., templates, sources, etc. Able to clearly articulate content to client and possess effective formal communication skills.
  • Client Handling Skills - Develop specific logical sections for proposals and propose robust methodologies to address client requirements with limited supervision. Able to initiate discussion with clients on proposal scope, methodology and facilitate closure. Highly professional interactions with clients and makes him/herself available for the client.
  • Corporate Development -Able to identify and initiate ideas for process improvements and contribute to thought leadership content development for the Practice Area.



Required Competencies

The ideal candidate will have a strong educational foundation in engineering or technology, coupled with knowledge of business and a passion for solving complex problems and creating actionable insights for clients.

This role requires someone who is curious, methodical, and able to think strategically—connecting dots between data, industry trends, and business impact. Strong client-handling skills, including communication, adaptability, and credibility in stakeholder interactions, are critical.

  • A relevant university degree (BA, BS) in Engineering, or technology. A postgraduate degree (Master’s or PhD) is highly regarded and considered an advantage
  • 4 – 6 years of analyst/consulting working experience within a Consulting and/or Advisory services business environment.
  • The ability to research and write a coherent story in proper English about a topic is critical.
  • A foundational understanding of the Energy or Industrial industry, such as industry structure, operational practices, and competitive landscapes.
  • The ability to network to create new relationships and to proactively manage on-going relationships to stay relevant to market intelligence needs of the clients.
  • An analytical thought process, with outstanding written and verbal communication skills and business level fluency in English.
  • The desire to learn public presentation skills in front of an audience and a video camera.
  • Confident enough to present your work to a group of peers or a client and defend your analysis in a calm and professional manner.
  • A team player who views team collaboration as an important path to professional development.
  • Are Well-organized and detail-oriented
  • Take ownership to work independently with remote supervision
  • Can multi-task and meet tight deadlines
  • Are disciplined and adhere to high-quality standards
  • Is a strategic thinker; understands how operational activities are vital in supporting the overall strategy of the business


What will make you succeed at Frost & Sullivan?

You need to be-

  • Committed to customer success
  • A self-starter invested in your future
  • A persuasive communicator
  • Deeply analytical
  • Excited about disruptive trends and impact on governments, policies and people


Benefits

  • A friendly and professional work environment with an ‘open door’ policy
  • A strong career path with growth opportunities.
  • Be part of a global team that strives for excellence, and fosters an Olympic spirit
  • Feed your intellectual curiosity by collaborating across all levels of the company across the globe
  • Global recognition - President’s Club & Chairman’s Club Awards
  • Continuous learning and coaching
  • Flexible work policy


About Frost & Sullivan

Frost & Sullivan, the Transformational Growth Journey Company, has spent more than 65 years partnering with clients to develop transformational growth strategies by focusing on innovation and growth opportunities driven by disruptive technologies, mega trends, emerging markets, and new business models. Today, more than ever before, companies must innovate, not only to survive, but thrive in the future. Our Growth Pipeline Management (GPM) system supports clients by identifying and evaluating new growth opportunities and serves as the foundation for continuous growth. This is your opportunity to be part of a revolutionary global team that truly inspires positive global changes by innovating to zero. Learn more about Frost & Sullivan at www.frost.com

title: Principle Data & IT Platform Engineer
description:
At OxyChem, our chemistry makes modern life possible, and it is our people who make the difference. We are a safety-first, purpose-driven team committed to innovation, environmental responsibility, and doing things the right way. If you are ready to contribute, elevate your skills, and take ownership of your career, OxyChem offers the opportunity to make a difference every day.


OxyChem, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a leading producer of essential chemistry with operations in the U.S., Canada and Latin America. OxyChem’s products play an essential role in everyday life, supporting critical applications in water treatment, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, manufacturing, automotive, personal hygiene, and residential and commercial construction. OxyChem actively participates in the Occupational Safety and Health Administration Voluntary Protection Program, underscoring our commitment to safety. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, OxyChem is a top three U.S. manufacturer of polyvinyl chloride, chlor-alkali and chlorinated organic chemicals, and calcium chloride. Visit oxychem.com for more information.


In a fast-paced industry that demands precision, we create a supportive workplace where the safety and well-being of our employees are paramount. We are committed to rewarding top performers, offering very competitive pay and benefits, and providing tremendous career development opportunities.


We are seeking a Principal Data & AI Platform Engineer to define and lead the vision for our enterprise data and analytics ecosystem. In this senior, hands-on role, you will design and build a modern, Azure and SAP-based data platform—anchored on Microsoft Fabric, OneLake and SAP BDC—that delivers centralized, scalable, and governed capabilities for analytics, reporting, and AI across the organization. You will own the technology roadmap and architectural standards, design the integration and infrastructure-as-code frameworks that other engineers build upon, and partner closely with business and technical stakeholders to translate strategy into trusted, production-grade solutions. The ideal candidate pairs deep, current technical mastery with the judgment to set direction and hands on engineering to ensure the platform is secure, cost-effective, and aligned to long-term business goals.

Responsibilities

  • Define the technology vision, roadmap, and architectural standards for the enterprise data and analytics platform, ensuring tight alignment with business goals and establishing the patterns other engineers build upon.
  • Design and lead the build of a modern, Azure/SAP-based data platform leveraging Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Data Factory, Warehouse) and SAP BDC, integration patterns, setting the foundation for enterprise-wide analytics and reporting at scale.
  • Own the design and deployment of dimensional and semantic data models and curated datasets that deliver performant, governed, self-service reporting—establishing modeling standards adopted across the organization.
  • Establish enterprise data governance - data quality, security, lineage, and compliance controls across the platform - to guarantee trusted, audit-ready analytics.
  • Determine Azure and SAP cohesion/coexistence to determine right fit per use case
  • Design and lead the build of Fabric data pipelines for batch, CDC, and incremental ingestion, architecting reusable patterns for transforming on-premises relational data into the cloud platform.

  • Set the standard for infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform/Bicep), driving consistent, version-controlled, repeatable provisioning and instilling software-engineering discipline across the platform team.
  • Define and own the CI/CD strategy, building and governing deployment pipelines that automate releases of infrastructure, data pipelines, and warehouse artifacts—with automated testing, environment promotion, and rollback strategies for safe, reliable delivery.

  • Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 5+ years Deep, hands-on expertise with modern cloud data platforms (Azure strongly preferred), including Microsoft Fabric OneLake, data warehousing, and AI/ML architecture.
  • Mastery of diverse data stores—relational, NoSQL, and graph databases—with the judgment to select the right technology for each workload.
  • 10+ years of designing and operating enterprise integrations across relational databases, SAP BDC/Datasphere/HANA/CPI, Globalscape MFT, Microsoft BizTalk, message buses, and OData/REST APIs.
  • 5+ years experience with the Azure service ecosystem, including Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid, API Management, and Container Instances.
  • 15+ years demonstrating ability to define technology roadmaps, align architecture to business objectives, and deliver actionable guidance to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • 5+ years of enterprise BI, particularly Power BI, including semantic modeling and governed self-service reporting.
  • 5+ years integrating and working with time-series historians, including PI historian and related operational technology data platforms
  • Working knowledge of Generative and Agentic AI capabilities, architectural patterns, and supporting technology stacks.
  • Disciplined software-engineering practices, including Git-based version control and automated deployment pipelines (CI/CD).
  • Proficiency writing clean, reusable, performant code in SQL, Python, and PySpark for data engineering, transformation, and integration tooling.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Business Office
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.


Join us in shaping the future of Ford Motor Company, as part of a global organization with exceptional colleagues in world-class facilities. As part of Ford Design, you’ll be at the cutting edge of Ford’s most strategically critical work, designing people and society’s needs into the heart of our next generation of products, services, and experiences.

The Design Business Office Analyst plays a critical role in managing, analyzing, and optimizing the Global Design organization’s financial operations. This position is responsible for evaluating financial data, monitoring budget performance across multiple operational pillars, and providing strategic recommendations to leadership to drive efficiency.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and collaborative skills, a deep understanding of corporate financial compliance, and the ability to manage current-year execution while forecasting resource and department needs up to five years into the future.

What you'll do...

Budget Development, Forecasting & Compliance

  • Multi-Pillar Budget Management: Collaborate with global department heads to develop, manage, and monitor departmental budgets across five key pillars: Personnel, Purchased Services, Material, Other Indirect, and Capital Projects.
  • Financial Accuracy: Maintain strict forecasting accuracy of +/- 5% compared to actual finance results.
  • Policy Compliance: Apply a deep understanding of the Ford Finance Manual to appropriately define, categorize, and bin spending based on the item, cost, and intended use.
  • Strategic Planning: Focus on current calendar year execution while proactively tracking, modeling, and anticipating department needs 5 years out.

Financial Operations & Procurement Lifecycle

  • End-to-End Project Tracking: Monitor and track departmental projects from initial need identification through procurement, delivery, and final payment.
  • Capital & Purchase Authorizations: Author all Capital Projects on behalf of the department and stakeholders; draft and submit material and purchased services orders as needed.
  • Transaction & Expense Management: Review and process FAB card orders, and ensure all incoming invoices and receipts are sufficiently detailed and processed within a timely manner.
  • Audit & Reconciliation: Conduct monthly audits of existing purchase orders and initiate corrective actions to resolve discrepancies or update contract terms.

Collaboration, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Executive Reporting: Prepare, update, and present clear financial status reports, forecast models, and presentations for senior design leadership.
  • Finance Liaison: Partner closely with the Corporate Finance team to maintain clear visibility of planned versus target spending, ensuring funding is optimized and utilized within the appropriate fiscal windows.
  • Process Innovation: Identify trends, locate cost-saving opportunities, and implement robust processes to ensure data integrity and timely reporting.
  • Emerging Technology Integration: Stay current on emerging digital tools and applications (e.g., AI Co-Pilot, advanced Excel/PowerBI, financial automation tools) to drive operational efficiencies within the business office.

You'll have...

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in business operations, financial analysis, corporate procurement, or budget management. Prior experience working within Ford Motor Company and a strong familiarity with the Ford Finance Manual, corporate purchasing systems, corporate compliance structures and Product Planning.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong financial acumen with proven experience tracking complex budgets, analyzing variances, and managing forecasting cycles. Familiarity with tracking capital expenditure (CapEx) and operational expenditure (OpEx) cycles.
  • Systems & Tools: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced modeling, pivot tables, formulas) and standard corporate financial/purchasing software. Demonstrated experience using data visualization tools (such as PowerBI, QlikView) and leveraging generative AI/digital assistants (such as Co-Pilot) to improve workflow efficiency.
  • Communication: Outstanding written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders. Proven track record of collaborating effectively with multi-disciplinary, global teams.

Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? Delegates tasks based on others’ scope of practice and competency. Acts as patient advocate. Manages restraint use per policy Attempts alternative non-restraint measures first. Assures complete MD order per policy. Ensures MD assessment per policy. Assures patient monitoring per policy. Ensures Restraint Audit Form is completed each shift.
  • DOCUMENTATION Documentation is complete and correct on all flow sheets and chart forms: Admission Assessment Pain scale assessment and reassessment before and after intervention Daily flow sheet Restraint flow sheet Diabetes flow sheet Room/unit orientation Plan of Care Identifies knowledge deficits related to diagnoses and care Uses and provides MICROMEDEX information to patients and families. Educational flow sheet Kardex Care Plan Risk Assessment & Reassessment upon Fall MAR Equipment & Supplies Intra and Inter Facility Transfer Forms Belonging Tracking Form Ensures orders are transcribed and signed off prior to the end of the shift. Completes 12h/24h chart checks
  • EDUCATION Provides patient/family education as needed • Room/unit orientation • Plan of Care • Identifies knowledge deficits related to diagnoses and care Uses and provides MICROMEDEX information to patients and families
  • TRANSFER & DISCHARGE • Collaborates with Case Manager and/or physician regarding discharge planning. • Ensures all transfer paperwork is completed. • Ensures belongings are sent with patient.
  • EQUIPMENT Utilizes patient care equipment appropriately and safely according to manufacture guidelines • IV pump • Feeding pump • PCA pump • Epidural pump • Sequential compression device • Wound VAC • Heating pad/pump

Liver/kidney/pancreas transplants, hepatobiliary. Open heart, heart and lung transplants. • Demonstrates the ability to manage advanced therapeutic modalities. Hemodynamic monitoring. Continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT, CVVHD). Ventriculostomy, intracranial pressure monitoring. Ventricular assist devices, balloon pumps.

Status post open heart, heart transplant, lung transplant. Status post liver/kidney transplants, orthopedics, hepatobiliary, general surgeries. Status post thoracic-forgut, gastric bypass, neurology, neurosurgery. • Demonstrates the ability to manage advanced therapeutic modalities. Ventilator care. Arterial/CVP lines. Ventricular assist devices. Lumbar drains.

title: Smed til sort og rustfrit stål i Hadsten
description:
Er du smed, og har du lyst til at udvikle dine faglige kompetencer i en virksomhed med en fyldt ordrebog og dygtige kollegaer?

Vi søger en smed til en spændende stilling i Hadsten. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor der er fokus på kvalitet, godt håndværk og et stærkt fagligt miljø. Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager ansvar for dit arbejde og ønsker at udvikle dig sammen med dygtige kollegaer.

Du får en alsidig hverdag med opgaver inden for smedearbejde i både sort og rustfrit stål, hvor du får mulighed for at bruge dine nuværende kompetencer og bygge videre på dem.

Det kommer du til at lave

  • Svejse og bearbejde emner i sort og rustfrit stål

  • Arbejde med TIG og MIG/MAG svejsning

  • Samling og tilpasning af emner

  • Arbejde ud fra tekniske tegninger

  • Montage og kvalitetskontrol af eget arbejde

  • Samarbejde med kollegaer om at finde gode løsninger.

Det lægger vi vægt på

  • Du er uddannet smed eller har erfaring fra branchen

  • Du har lyst til at arbejde med både sort og rustfrit stål

  • Erfaring med TIG og MIG/MAG svejsning er en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Du har lyst til at lære nyt og udvikle dine faglige kompetencer

  • Du arbejder omhyggeligt og har fokus på kvalitet

  • Du er mødestabil og bidrager positivt til samarbejdet.

Det tilbyder virksomheden

  • En fast stilling i en virksomhed med en fyldt ordrebog

  • Et stærkt fagligt miljø med dygtige og hjælpsomme kollegaer

  • Spændende og varierede smedeopgaver

  • Gode arbejdsforhold og moderne faciliteter

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine faglige kompetencer

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Har du spørgsmål, eller ønsker du at høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Møller hos BECH Personale, afdeling Byg og Metal, på telefon 72 10 85 47 i vores åbningstid:

Mandag - torsdag kl. 07:00 - 15:00
Fredag kl. 07:00 - 14:00.

BECH Personale står for rekrutteringen på vegne af vores samarbejdspartner. Alle ansøgninger og henvendelser behandles naturligvis fortroligt.

Vi har ikke behov for en ansøgning. Dit CV er nok til at komme i betragtning.

title: Senior Due Diligence Officer
description:
As a Senior Due Diligence Officer, you will be responsible for conducting risk-based periodic and event-driven Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) reviews of customers across the Company's portfolio, in line with UK and Latvian regulatory requirements and industry best practices. The initial scope of the role covers CDD/EDD requirements applicable under UK and Latvian regulatory frameworks. The scope may subsequently expand to additional jurisdictions and products.
  • Perform risk-based periodic and event-driven CDD and EDD reviews for clients across Company’s portfolio.
  • Analyse corporate documentation, financial statements, banking and acquiring transaction activity, licensing conditions, corporate registers, legal documents, sanctions and adverse media findings, beneficial ownership structures including complex structures, merchant website compliance, possible transaction laundering indicators and other relevant internal and external information sources.
  • Assess the customer's overall risk profile by combining KYC/KYB information with monitoring findings, including transaction behavior, fraud, chargebacks, refunds, declines, adverse media, licensing and regulatory risks, and determine whether the customer's actual activity remains consistent with its approved business model and expected transaction profile.
  • Prepare information requests within the scope of CDD/EDD activities and ensure appropriate follow-up.
  • Communicate with internal teams and other stakeholders to obtain relevant information and facilitate efficient completion of due diligence reviews.
  • Document due diligence findings in a clear, structured and evidence-based manner, including customer risk assessments and recommendations regarding customer acceptance, continuation or additional risk mitigation measures.
  • Identify and recommend appropriate risk mitigation measures consistent with the Company's risk appetite, regulatory obligations and operational capabilities.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of CDD/EDD methodologies, procedures, templates and guidance, ensuring alignment with evolving regulatory expectations and industry best practices.
  • Support implementation of regulatory changes and participate in compliance-related projects as required.
  • Prepare internal suspicious activity referrals for MLRO review.
  • More than 4 years of experience in AML and sanctions compliance with a focus on CDD/EDD analysis within a financial institution or fintech.
  • Strong understanding of multi-jurisdictional legal entity structures, beneficial ownership identification and complex customer risk assessments.
  • Ability to analyse both banking and acquiring transaction activity and assess customer risk from a holistic perspective.
  • Excellent understanding of CDD/EDD requirements and documentation, with the ability to produce clear, structured and evidence-based conclusions.
  • Good understanding of Visa and Mastercard requirements, merchant website analysis and transaction laundering indicators.
  • Experience working with UK and Latvian regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload and manage multiple cases simultaneously.
  • Ability to work independently while exercising sound professional judgement.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • A dynamic, ambitious environment where compliance is seen as an enabler of growth, not a blocker.
  • Enjoy flexible working hours, hybrid work options, private health insurance and generous paid time off giving you the balance you need to perform at your best.
  • Apple hardware and modern work tools to support your workflow.
  • Extra personal time off for rest and recharge: 12 additional days per year, plus your birthday off.
  • Private health insurance and wellness benefits.
  • Opportunities to grow, lead, and shape xpate's future-proof compliance ecosystem.
We’re building the financial backbone of the future — where payments move freely and businesses grow without barriers. If you want real impact, freedom to innovate, and work that drives change, xpate is the place for you.

title: Interior Systems Engineer Soft Trim

Ford’s Electric Vehicles, Digital and Design (EVDD) team is charged with delivering the company’s vision of a fully electric transportation future. EVDD is customer-obsessed, entrepreneurial, and data-driven and is dedicated to delivering industry-leading customer experience for electric vehicle buyers and owners. You’ll join an agile team of doers pioneering our EV future by working collaboratively, staying focused on only what matters, and delivering excellence day in and day out. Join us to make positive change by helping build a better world where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams.

In this position...
The Interior Systems Engineer will be responsible for concept development and detailed design of the cabin systems through multiple stages of development. You will Conceptualize, Design, Engineer, Develop and support the launch of full vehicle interior components.

What you'll do...

  • Create and develop Hard Trim System requirements and specifications while developing geometry and the engineering execution in conjunction with design, supply chain, and other core teams.
  • Create vehicle-aligned component and system targets for function, cost, weight and investment.
  • Develop 3D geometry and innovative designs concepts that solve challenging crash load cases while balancing construction, material, and manufacturing methods

  • Enable effective communications with Studio, Packaging, Advanced Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supplier activities to deliver optimal design solutions

You'll have...

  • 3+ years of experience using 3D CAD software collaboratively (NX, Catia, 3DX, etc.)

title: Junior Groomer
description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?


We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.


Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


  • Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

  • Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through distinct experiences, products, and services.

  • Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:


We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.



Your Petco Grooming Career:

Begin your Petco journey as a Junior Pet Stylist in Grooming!

During this ten-week training period as a Junior Pet Stylist, you will learn fundamental grooming tasks such as brushing, bathing, drying, cutting nails, and more! Gaining hands-on experience with guidance from seasoned groomers, our industry leading program is designed to develop essential grooming skills and set the foundation for your future career with Petco Grooming.

In addition to our commitment to continuous training, development, and career growth, we also offer:

  • Competitive base pay
  • Medical, dental, vision and more
  • 401k and more
  • Paid Time Off
  • Petco Discounts
  • All the supplies & equipment you need, including, brushes, nail trimmers, clippers, blades, shampoo, sprays, tools, etc.
  • State of the art equipment, including bathing system, kennels, tables, and dryers

Purpose:

The Junior Pet Stylist's primary purpose is to learn how to perform the following services: bathing, drying, brushing, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and gland cleaning, alongside seasoned groomers. In addition to bathing and drying services, the Junior Pet Stylist will assist in the grooming process, prioritizing the comfort, safety, and well-being of the pets in our care and delivering optimal customer services to pet parents. This is an excellent opportunity for those passionate about animals and grooming to start their career in the pet care industry.

Essential Job Functions:

The incumbent must be able to consistently perform all the following duties and responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Under close supervision of experienced groomers, perform limited grooming services including bathing, drying, nail trimming, brushing, ear cleaning, and gland cleaning according to the pet parents’ instructions and in adherence to company policies and procedures
  • Ensure the well-being and safety of every animal in the salon at all times
  • Interact professionally and effectively with pet parents, provide optimal customer service, address grooming related inquiries and provide timely resolution
  • Maintain a clean and safe grooming area and salon, disinfect and sanitize grooming tools and equipment, perform daily and weekly cleaning duties in the salon and in adherence to Petco hygiene and sanitation policies, other cleaning and maintenance tasks as assigned, including but not limited to cleaning air filters, vents, and drains
  • Schedule grooming appointments, manage paperwork, and maintain accurate grooming records
  • Learn and adhere to Petco's grooming policies, standards, and guidelines to ensure safety, quality, and consistency in all activities and areas of the grooming business

Training Program Outline:

  • Weeks 1-3: Learning and On-the-Job Training
    • Learn dog behavior, pet and self-safety, proper check-in/out procedures, customer service, grooming policies, and begin on-the-job training in bathing and drying techniques
  • Weeks 3-10: Performing and Achieving Productivity
    • Perform bathing and walk-in services while achieving weekly productivity goals

Education/Experience:

  • 0-1 year of animal related experience, including shelter volunteering or pet sitting, prior grooming salon assistance is preferred
  • High-school diploma or GED is preferred, though not required
  • Genuine passion for animals and a desire to pursue a career in pet grooming
  • Basic understanding of dog breeds, behavior, and common grooming practices
  • Capable of handling pets of all sizes and temperaments with care and empathy
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills for interactions with pet parents and grooming team members
  • Availability to work weekends, evenings, and holidays, as required by the Pet Care Center’s grooming schedule

Work Environment:

The majority of job duties are conducted indoors in the grooming salon. Position requires bending, kneeling, lifting (up to 30 pounds, as necessary) and standing for long periods of time. Position may require exposure to heights using a two-step ladder or other support tools, such as vacuums, to perform assigned cleaning and maintenance duties. A large amount of this partner’s time will be spent in direct contact with our pet parents and their dogs, and the remaining time will be with the other salon partners. The work environment can be noisy and wet.

Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

title: Senior Cloud Native Engineer
description:
För kunds räkning söker vi en Senior Cloud Native Engineer. Urval kommer att ske efter den 7 augusti.

Som Cloud Native Engineer på Enhet IT kommer du att arbeta med vår plattform och de lösningar som byggs ovanpå den. Du är med och utvecklar, driver och förbättrar en modern plattform där Kubernetes är centralt och där fokus ligger på developer experience, automation och self-service.

Vi söker dig som har några års erfarenhet inom IT och containerbaserade plattformar och som vill ta nästa steg. Du är en lagspelare som är nyfiken, engagerad och har ett starkt teknikintresse.

Du får möjlighet att växa i rollen och arbeta med moderna arbetssätt kring cloud-native-arkitektur, plattformsteknik samt DevOps och CI/CD i en microservices-miljö.

Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:

  • Förvaltning och utveckling av vår Kubernetes-plattform
  • Bygga och förbättra plattformstjänster och gemensamma förmågor
  • Arbeta med Infrastructure as Code och GitOps
  • Automatisering av drift och plattformsfunktioner
  • Stötta utvecklingsteam i hur plattformen används effektivt
  • Arbeta med best practices inom säkerhet, observability och resiliency

Kvalifikationer:

  • Några års erfarenhet av IT-miljöer
  • Erfarenhet av Kubernetes och containerteknik
  • God förståelse för nätverk
  • Erfarenhet av DevOps-arbetssätt och CI/CD

title: Social- og sundhedsassistent til plejehjemmet Egely
description:
Kunne du tænke dig at gøre en forskel for ældre borgere på Ballerups hyggeligste plejehjem?

Vi tilbyder en spændende stilling til den helt rigtige social og sundhedsassistent. Stillingen er i dagvagt med weekendvagt hver 3. weekend.

Dine vigtigste opgaver
Som medarbejder på Egely kommer du tæt på borgerne. Din indlevelse, din faglighed og din opmærksomhed på deres situation er afgørende for, at vi kan give dem en god livskvalitet og sundhed i en stabil og tryg hverdag. Som social og sundhedsassistent er det dit ansvar at sikre den sygeplejeagtige indsats bliver fulgt, bl.a. ved daglig triage, hvor du får indblik i beboerforløbene og i samarbejde med kollegaer og andre samarbejdspartnere.

Du skal være med til at sikre den røde tråd i dokumentationen og hjælpe og støtte vores beboere til at leve det liv som de ønsker sig.

Dine vigtigste opgaver at være faglig velfunderet, pædagogisk og imødekommende, og aktivt deltagende i plejeforløbene. Vi forventer, at du fremstår ansvarsfuld i alle henseender, der vedrører kerneopgaven.

Dine kompetencer
Du skal være åben og modtagelig for nye ideer og være en rollemodel som udviser klar og tydelig holdning til pleje og omsorg, der er i harmoni med enhedens vision, kerneopgave, mål og værdier

Derudover er det vigtigt at du:

  • Er god til at kommunikere, både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • Evner at se det hele menneske og tilrettelægge plejen derefter
  • Er nærværende og til stede hos beboerne
  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent.

Det får du hos os
Vi er et lille sted, hvor der er hyggeligt at være og hvor alle kender alle. Vi er 25 fastansatte faglærte personaler, både erfarne og nyuddannede og derudover har vi sekretær, aktivitetsmedarbejder og udviklingssygeplejerske to-tre dage/ugen, vi hjælper hinanden og har hver især flere ansvarsområder.

Hvem er vi
Vi synes, at Egely er et unikt lille sted hvor her både bor 14 beboere på vores plejehjem og her også er 18 ældreboliger. Som ansat på Egely har du din daglige gang begge steder og det giver mulighed for flere perspektiver på plejen og det liv der leves her. Vi har en stor smuk atriumgård som vi bruger som fællesrum, hvor beboere fra ældreboligerne mødes med beboerne fra plejehjemmet i forskellige aktiviteter.

title: Brolægger til flisebelægning og bundopbygning i Nibe
description:
Vil du have firmabil, frihed under ansvar og sjovt at gå på arbejde?

Vi mangler en brolægger til fliser og belægning i Nibe.

Du lander i en mindre flok, der tager både private opgaver, boligopgaver og erhvervsopgaver i Nibe og omegn. Belægning fylder rollen, men arbejdet hænger også sammen med forarbejde, bundopbygning og de små justeringer der får stenene til at ligge rigtigt. Du skifter mellem at arbejde selv, med makker og i sjak, alt efter opgaven. Kunderne skal kunne mærke at aftaler bliver holdt, og at der bliver talt ordentligt om løsningen fra start.

Firmabilen er en del af pakken, og du får frihed under ansvar i hverdagen. Rollen kræver, at du kan tage en plads, vurdere underlaget og sige til, hvis noget ikke stemmer. Her handler det ikke kun om at lægge sten hurtigt. Det handler også om at aflevere noget der holder.

Det får du

Løn: 150-220 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Nibe og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 5 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Flisebelægning, bundopbygning og skiftende makkersetup

Din hverdag

Arbejdet begynder med forarbejdet: underlag, fald og bundopbygning skal sidde, før stenene lægges. Når belægningen skal på plads, arbejder du med mønster, forbandt og kanter, så resultatet holder og ser ordentligt ud.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Laver forarbejde og bygger bunden korrekt op
  • Lægger sten i aftalt forbandt og mønster
  • Lægger fliser, sten og belægninger
  • Sætter kantsten og trapper

Her er frihed under ansvar noget, du bruger i praksis. Når en opgave ændrer sig undervejs, vurderer du løsningen og får meldt klart tilbage, så aftalerne stadig holder.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det, du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 5 års erfaring som brolægger
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og møde som aftalt
  • Har styr på forarbejde, bundopbygning og stenlægning
  • Taler ordentligt med kunder og kollegaer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet både private haver og erhvervspladser. Men det vigtigste er, at du møder stabilt og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: Lean Strategist
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

As part of our Manufacturing team, you’ll help build the world-class, state-of-the-art smart vehicles we're known for. In our plants around the world, we’re constantly developing new technologies and processes to further increase our efficiency. You'll get the satisfaction of making great products people use and love.

In this role…

As a Lean Strategist, you will be a key architect of Ford’s continuous improvement culture. You will be responsible for designing and implementing strategic frameworks that drive efficiency, quality, and safety across our manufacturing footprint. This role goes beyond simple tactical application; you will be expected to mentor cross-functional teams, integrate lean principles into new engineering product launches, and evolve the Ford Production System (FPS) to meet the challenges of the future. This role will travel 50% of the time.

What You’ll Do…

  • Ford Production System (FPS) Stewardship: Serve as the subject matter expert on FPS, ensuring all lean engineering activities align with corporate standards while driving the evolution of the system to improve throughput and reduce waste.
  • Model Area Development: Lead the creation and sustainment of "Model Areas" to serve as the gold standard for operational excellence, providing a blueprint for scaling improvements across Ford manufacturing plants.
  • Value Stream Mapping (VSM): Facilitate end-to-end VSM sessions across Ford manufacturing plants to identify "Current State" bottlenecks across engineering and design "Future State" maps that optimize material and information flow.
  • Kaizen Leadership: Organize and lead high-impact Kaizen events at Ford manufacturing plants, empowering operators and staff to generate and implement ideas (aiming for the high levels of operator engagement seen in our Lean Academies).

  • Cross-Functional Mentorship: Coach participants from diverse backgrounds (Finance, HR, Engineering, and Operations) on lean tools, including Yamazumi charts, Spaghetti diagrams, and 5-Why root cause analysis.

You’ll Have…
